0 tai/bheskyang paṃsado/ryā ) ( skumatsho )spuskedngha rṇasnye myukyusgyuci khyakto/ / zlo(5jize/māṃ/nusta tshesgo'itsu 1 kyezhuji( rdzornyermye rjo3trīsnyoṣa mya rketwokko ra

༷rshachi3 spro dku3 swā ge ri spre 4dku —byu cosgrudzha mmerngo) gurtsu pādku blosgodī 4ཿridheḍāpre rsha chitshotrepyishtsakāzhurngo —ricari rmi ༄ju co hrī— 4— tt+waṃdku ——ḍaladzwa5 rte ’yo rwa —sne gyi dwohūṃ rtse treji0risgotre—༄5 —sgori cadku5—) ske — dwadzosnye 〉dzo prerdo—tshe shrī — spredku rsha jidngha —trī —skosgyu—tswa 〉byutsholasne — lkedzos treswā lhardotho3lamo4 — skurngo —dnghari nee rwarme dzees rke dri ༷rī dngha— 4geribyu dzha 4rṣarā nedku2dzelto 3 zlo rshatre— ne rwacho— spya4 tho rketro —khu— tre ri snye phro dine ni ske ru~X4 kro)du—trīocheorgoo—ca— —sgo 4 — rjodzwa rke —spreg dkushā ne3trenee ༷rtsaX —rsha/ dzedzwa nghru— lodi —zistorjo 'i —tshotyā ju ho 7 juspretshu bhesnostseci/ tshesduri snyo rkeneeswāzherngu—༷phro spretho byesgebyādkurmorī kormi rjo— ༈ rdzoni dro ri — 4 ci4 ༄stastoṭwāṃ3 3lto — dze ༷〉( shā tso — tādngha ṅgāsdu— 5 rsha sngaci 1rnyice sgosto ri —— tsho— staXrngone —sku shaṅka rdza rka sgruspu byubyu 4 sgrorī)homo ༈ myatrīrdaslo dzā7 9kre milcemi kre skeX sgyu bye—༷4 skre she 0— 7 rdzo na slosna7 sta sna rdza— snye jishu rīngoci ge ༵ rdzoso dzesnyepo shlaudzña 7 ṣāshlaunyu to 8 — —rī (phyortsi sngolkol ca snophro tsho༈sko kṣe 7 4dku rucilnge sgordze tsho rngo dku me sgyu bhe 〉rmernosnralam̐hokhrisgoṅka mo rdolhupyeske — nā tsā

sgrig pa po'i gtam/slob dpon chen mo dmu dge bsamyo/ gtan rgya mtsho mchog ni/ deng dus bod mi rigs spyi'i gtsug tu mchod pa'i mkhas dbang chen po zhig red/ khong gis sku tshe gang bor rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la thugs zhen zab bzhes ngos nyams pa sor chud/ ma nyams gong 'phel/ shes rig yar rgyas kyi don du brtse gzigs zol med/ brtson pa lhod med/ gsung dbyangs 'gag med kyis rang nus gang yod phul ba'i bka' drin ni bsam brjod yul las 'das pa zhig red/ lhag par du khong gis nga tshor bzhag pa'i rig gzhung gi shul bzhag rin po che la bltas kyin bltas kyin mos gus mchi ma rab tu 'khrigs/ bsam bzhin bsam bzhin rin thang gzhal du med pa shes/ nga rang tsho mi rigs dpe skrun gyi las ka byed mkhan zhig yin pa'i ngos nas bshad na/ slob dpon chen mo 'di ba'i phyag rtsom mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig bsgrigs nas par du bskrun na ni rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas bang mdzod la rin chen nor bu zhig bsnan pa lta bu'i dge mtshan chen po ldan zhing / lar blo gsal gzhon nu'i tshogs la rig pa'i dngos po phun sum tshogs pa zhig mngon par bstabs pa'i phan yon shin tu mi dman pa zhig yod par 1

mthong nas de lugs kyi brtson/ pa lhur len pa'i 'dun pa drag po snying la bcags khar/ nye lam rje nyid kyi sku sring bde mchog skyid dang khong gi chi yang tsha grwa btsun bslab gsum rgya mtsho zung gis sa thag ring bo'i dka' sdug la ma 'dzem par rje nyid kyi gsung rtsom mtha' dag dre'u khal du longs pa zhig dngos su khur nas rang re'i dpe skrun khang du slebs shing / khyed dpe skrun khang gi rtsom sgrig spus tshad legs pas gzhan su dang gang la'ang ma sprad par khyed cag la gtad pa yin zhes gsung 'bum dpar skrun gyi dngos shugs dbang cha yod tshad nga tshor phul ba dang / khyad par du nged dpe skrun khang la ma dngul gyi 'khos ka zhan pa mthong nas/ gcen po'i gsung 'bum par du btab nas bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas la phyar ba gru 'degs kyi nus pa thon na de las che ba med ces gsungs te gcen rin po che'i brtsams yon skar gcig kyang med pa'i thog da dung gzhan las zhal 'debs dngul sgor khri gnyis tsam bsdus nas gun gsab kyi rogs skyor byas pa la nga tsho sems 'gul chen po dang skul ma chen po thebs te/gzhi nas khong gi gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig sgrig pa'i 'char gzhi dngos bstar byas pa yin/ da cha nga tshos par du bskrun pa'i gsung 'bum 'di la khyon bsdoms pod drug tu bkar/ pod dang po ni gtso cher rnam thar skor yin/ 'di'i kong du nga tshos de snga sus kyang mjal ma sdong ba'i mdo smad bstan pa'i 2

bdag po rje bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rnam thar lo rgyus mjal thub par ma zad/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi byung ba lo rgyus las mkhas chen dam pa zhig thos sbyang gi stobs ga 'dra zhig la brten nas 'tshar longs byung ba'i tshul la rgyus mnga' lon cing rang nyid la sbyang stobs che ru bskyed pa'i skul ma thebs nges yin/ pod gnyis pa ni gtso cher gzhung 'grel skor te/ 'di'i rnang naso rtsom pa po rang nyid nang don rig pa'i mkhas dbang zhig yin pa'i ngos nas deng gi 'chad grwa'i gzhung khrid kyi dka' gnad la dmigs nas tshig don gnyis gsal gyi 'grel bshad gnang yod/ pod gsum pa ni gtso cher lo rgyus skor te/ 'di'i nang du bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas dar tshul gyi lo rgyus sogs bkod yod pas/ nga tshos lo rgyus 'di dag las rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi phul byung grub 'bras mthong thub par ma zad/ mukhas pa gzhan gyi gsung na med pa'i legs bshad btso ma'i gser lta bu'ang mi nyung ba zhig zin rgyu yod do/ /pod bzhi ba ni gtso cher sgra snyan ngag skar rtsis kyi skor yin/ 'di'i nang du slob dpon 'di bas srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bslab bya so so rgyas bsdus 'tsham zhing go bde ba'i lam nas bkral yod pas las dang po ba rnams la nye bar mkho zhing 'jug bde ba'i gnas dam pa zhig tu 'khums so/ /pod lnga ba ni gtso cher sum rtags dag gsum skor yin/'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa po'i deng rabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i brda 3

sprod kyi gzhung lugs dang lta ba gsarasgyub/ lag len gyi rin thang ldan zhing nye bar mkho ba'i bshad pa gsar ba shes rtogs byed thub pa yin/ pod drug pa ni gsung thor bu'i skor te/ 'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa pos gdul bya'i blo gang la gang 'tsham du sbyar ba'i shes bya sna tshogs/ dri ba dris lan/ chab— shog sogs mjal thub la/ gsung tsag cig la snang chung mi byed par zhib tu bklags na ni bye ma'i gseb nas gser rdo rnyed pa lta bu'i dga' snang skye'ang srid do//mdor na/ khong gi gsung 'bum la brjod don zab kyang tshig 'grel gsal ba/ rig pa'i gnas la 'jug pa'i las dang po ba rnams kyi blor 'tsham zhing go sla ba/ gnas lnga rig pa'i snying bcud 'dus shing 'jug bde ba/ shes ldan rgan pas bklags na blo skyed gsar ba thob pa a gsar gzhon nus bklags na mos gus dbang med 'chor ba'i yon tan gyi mdzod chen po zhig yin pas/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi dge ba'i bshes dang brtse ba'i grogs su gyur cig gu// zhes 'di ga'i rtsom sgrig khang nas/spyi lo1996zla8tshes3la phul/

dkar chag dbyangs can zhal lung nyi ma prebum gyi 'od can zhes bya ba'i 'dru 'grel yang gsal snang ba'i mdzod rtses bya ba bzhugs so// (1)le'u dang po/bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo mchod par brjod pa dang rtsom par dam bca' ba bshad pa/ (6)ོsgodangaldanapa'ibastanabacosadangosabashadapa ( )//// snabasdo ———— — ———— ——7 / 121lho shar thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan bshad pa/ (28)le'u gnyis pa/rgyan gyi don dang dbye ba bshad pa/ (56)don rgyan so lnga so sor bshad pa/ (60)rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan/ — (60)dpe rgyan/ (66)gzugs can gyi rgyan/ (92)gsal byed kyi rgyan/ (103)bskor ba'i rgyan/ (112)'gog pa'i rgyan/ (114)1

don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ (126)ldog pa can gyi rgyan/ (132)srid pa can gyi rgyan/ (110)bsdus brjod kyi rgyan/ (143)phul byung gi rgyan/ (146)rab rtog gi rgyan/ (150)rgyu'i rgyan/ (155)phra mo'i rgyan/ (168)cha'i rgyan/ (171)rim pa can gyi rgyan/ (173)dga' ba'i rgyan/ (175)nyams ldan gyi rgyan/ (177)gzi brjid can gyi rgyan/ (182)rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan/ (184)kun phan gyi rgyan/ (186)rgya che ba'i rgyan/ (187)bsnyon dor gyi rgyan/ (188)sbyar ba'i rgyan/ (191)khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan/ (199)mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan/ (203)'gal ba'i rgyan/ (205)skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan/ (210)2

sdol bstod kyi rgyan/ (211)nges bstan gyi rgyan/ (214)lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan/ (216)yongs brjes kyi rgyan/ (218)shis brjod kyi rgyan/ (219)rab spel gyi rgyan/ (220)dgongs pa can sgyi rgyan/ (222) le'u gsum pa/ sgra rgyan gyi skabs mchod par brjod pa dang gzhung dngos bshad pa/ (229)bya sla ba dang bya dka' ba sogs zung ldan gyi rgyan/ (231)bya dka' ba'i khyad par gzhan bstan pa/ (264)dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' ba/ (269)gab tshig gi rgyan bshad pa/ (277)skyon sel gyi skabs bshad pa/ (288)bstan bcos 'di brtsams pa'i mjug gi bya ba/ (304)kun bzang 'khor lo tshan pa gnyis/ (313)dbyangs can sgra mdo'i tshig 'grel zla ba'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (317)—sngon 'gro/ (317)ming gi rab tu byed pa'i cho ga bshad pa/ (318)3

dbyangs kyi mtshams sbyor gyi cho ga bshad pa/ (323)dmigs bsal rang bzhin du gnas pa'i cho ga bshad pa/ (327)gsal byed kyi mtshams sbyor rnams bshad pa/ (328)rnam par bcad bya'i mtshams sbyor gyi cho ga bshad pa/ (332)si sogs rnam dbye nyer gcig dang de'i cho ga rnams bshad pa/ (335)dang po/ skyes bu'i rtags bshad pa/ (336)1 skyes bu'i rtags las a thung mtha' can bshad pa/ (336)2 skyes bu'i rtags i thung mtha' can bshad pa/ ji (339)3 skyes bu'i rtags i thung dmigs bsal can bshad pa/ (341)4 skyes bu'i rtags khri ring dang ā ring gi spyi'i mtha' can bshad pa/ (341)5 skyes bu'i rtags smi ring dang u ring gi mthā' can bshad pa/ (342)6 skyes bu'i rtags ṛ mtha' can bshad pa/ (342)7 skyes bu'i rtags i yig mtha' can bshad pa/ (343)8 skyes bu'i rtags o yig mtha' can bshad pa/ (343)gnyis pa/ bud med kyi rtags bshad pa/ (344)1 bud med kyi rtags las a yig mtha' can bshad pa/ (344)2 bud med kyi rtags las i yig dang u yig mtha' can bshad pa/ (345)3 bud med kyi rtags smi pa mtha' can bshad pa/ (345)gsum pa/ ma ning gi rtags mtha' can rnams bshad pa/ (346)1 ma ning gi rtags las a mtha' can bshad pa/ (346)2 ma ning gi rtags las āo ring mtha' can bshad pa/ (348)bzhi ba/ ha sa'i mtha' las skyes pa'i rtags can rnams bshad pa/ (349)4

lnga ba/ ha sa'i mtha' las bud med kyi rtags rnams bshad pa/ (357)drug pa/ ha sa'i mtha' las ma ning gi rtags rnams bshad pa/ (358)brjod pa'i rtags yuṣṭhadra asmadra gnyis kyi cho ga rnams bshad pa/ (359)mi zad pa'i sde rnams bshad pa/ (362)bud med kyi rkyen rnams bshad pa/ (364)rnam dbye rnams kyi don dang 'jug pa'i yul rgyas par ston pa byed pa can gyi le'u'i don bshad pa/ (367)tshig sdud kyi cho ga bshad pa/ (371)ming las ming gzhan du bsgrub pa de phan gyi rkyen rnams bshad pa/ (378)byings las tshig tu bsgrub pa kun bshad kyi rab tu bya ba rnams bshad pa/ (388)dngos po dang las kyi rab tu byed pa rnams bshad pa/ (401)smon pa'i don gyi rnam dbye rnams kyi cho ga rnams bshad pa/ (408)de ring ma yin pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi rnam dbye rnams kyi cho ga rnams bshad pa/ (409)bya ba shor ba'i don gyi rnam dbye rnams kyi cho ga rnams bshad pa/ (411)'das pa'am sngon byung ba'i rkyen gyi rnam dbye rnams bshad pa/ (411)byings byings su sgrub pa dang ming byings su sgrub par byed pa'i rkyen rnams kyi 'jug yul dang cho ga rnams bshad pa/ (415)phrang rkyen 'jig pa rnams kyi bya ba rnams bshad pa/ (417)5

byed pa'i don sogs byings byings su sgrub pa dang ming byings su sgrub pa'i rkyen rnams kyi bya ba rnams bshad pa/ (417)kun nas bsgyur ba'i cho ga rnams bshad pa/ (422)byings dang nyer bsgyur sbyor tshul sogs bshad pa/ (423)byings las ming du bsgyub pa kṛtra sogs kyi cho ga rnams bshad pa (429)mjug byang / (449)phar phyin mchod brjod kyi dbu'i sdeb sbyor gyi sgra skub ces bya ba bzhugs so// (451)byed mthun gyi nyi zla gza' 'dzin ri mo nag 'gros su bkod pa rigs ldan mchod pa'i me tog ces bya ba bzhugs so// (460)rigs ldan mchod pa'i 'od snang gi zur rgyan rin chen sgron me las chu mig klu mtsho'i re'u mig bsdus rpā gza' nyi'i khyi nor sogs bzhugs so// — (479)

༄༅ / /dbyangs can 'al lang nyi ma 'bam gyi sne — / / ri'i dze ra me 47'od can zhes bya ba'i 'bru 'grel yang gsal snang ba'i mdzod ces bya tsho ba bzhu/gas so // ༄༅/ /thugs bskyed 'dzin mar tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho 'ukhyil/ /sa lam sa brtol ljon pa'i kho lag rgyas/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i dpal/ /bshes gnyen dpag bsam ljon pa gtan gyi skyabs/ /rgyal kun mkhyen rab gcig bsdus shes rab ral gri yis/ /rmongs pa'i dgra tshogs 'joms dang chabs cig rgud pa 'joms/ /'phrin las dmar ser 'od kyis legs pa'i lam ston pa/ /brtan pa'i 'khor los mun tshogs lhag med zhi bar mdzod/ /zag med bde ba chen po'i thugs kyi dbyings rim nas/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgra rgyud mang sgra las drangs/ /snyan 'gyur stong gis mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud grol mdzad ma/ /ma/za ldan ma kye shes rgyud rig pa'i mdzod du sgyur/ /don ldan byung ba dbyangs can rgyud mang las/ /yongs su 'dren pa'i byed po dpa' bo dang / /rgyal bo dge dbang slob 1

dpon danḍi sogs/ /'phages yul mkhas dbang rnams la su mi gus/ /skyes/ sbyangaso brtson pa'i gru rdzings legs bsdams te/ /'phags yul rgya mtsho'i gling nas legs bshad nor/ /yongs su 'dren pa'i lo chen shong ston sogs/ /lo paṇa bka' drin can rnams phyag gi yul/ /nyin byed 'od kyis 'jig rten gsal ba bāzhin/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpal gyis thub pa'i bstan/ /gsal mdzad rigs gsum 'dus zhal tsong kha pa/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la snying nas 'dud/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs rgyud rgya mtsho las/ /lung rtogs padma dkar bo bzhad pa'i dpal/ /rgya bod mkhas grub kun la 'gran bzod pa/ /mkhas grub chen po kun mkhyen bla lka rgyal/ /gang de'i zhal gsung dbyangs can zhal gyi lung / /nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od can zhes bya ba/ /legs par bshad pa 'gran gyi do med par/ /nges kyang deng dus rdul khrod ngal gso bgyid/ /bdag 'dra'i ngag las legs bshad 'byung dka' yang / /nyi 'od rtsig ngos chu shel la phog pa'i/ /ldog pa'i 'od kyis snang ba ster ba bzhin/ /legs bshad snang ba'i rtse dga' cir yang ngom/ /bdag blo shes bya'i gnas la goms phyir dang / /kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' drin gzhal ba'i phyir/ /gzhung 'di'i 'bru 'grel yang gsal snang ba'i mdzod/ /blo gsal gzhon nu'i gzigs mor 'grem par bya//zhes snyan 'gyur dbyangs can 'phang 'gro'i rgyud las drangs pa'i 2

tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis sdurna bsus te gleng bar bya ba ni/ ji skad du/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rig pa'i ga nas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes bzung dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ drin lan bsabs pa'i mdo las/ rig pa'i dngos po lngar ma bslabs na nam du yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bam thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon byon rgyal ba rnams kyis rig pa'i gnas lnga sbyang ba mthar phyin pa yin gyi/gal te de dag gis rig pa'i gnas lnga bo dag la brtson pa lhur len gyis sbyang bar ma byas pa yin na/ 'phags pa mchog de dag gis kyang chos thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'gyur te/ zhes pa'am ma mkhyen par 'gyur te/ ma bslabs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste ma bslabs par shes pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de dag thams cad mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/de lta bas na rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub par 'dod pas log smra gzhan dag tshar gcod pa'i phyir du/ sgra rig pa dang / tshad ma rig pa la slob cing /skal ldan gyi gdul bya rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du bzo rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa la slob pa dang / bdag nyid kun shes par bya ba'i phyir nang don rig pa dang bcas pa rig pa'i gnas gcig kyang ma lus par de dang 3

de la brtson par byed dgos/ zhes pa'i don yin/ 'di lnga la rig gnas che ba lnga zer zhing / lnga bo 'di khong du chud pa la 'phags pa'i yul du ma hā partsi ta zhes grags so/ /rig gnas chung ba lnga ni/ skar rtsis/snyan ngagasdeb sbyor/mngon brjod/ zlos gar te lnga yin la/ de'i nang gi snyan ngag ni sgra rig pa'i khongs su'ang gtogs par bshad la thog mar slob dgos pa'i rig pa'i gnas yin te/ rgyal bo lang tshos dregs gyur cing / /rgyan med pa na skye bos gleng / /de bzhin snyan ngag mi ldan pa'i/ /bstan bcos mkhas la rtsis su med/ /ces gsungs so/rka /des na snyan ngag gi gzhung mchog tu gyur pa ni/ snyan ngag me long ma 'di nyid yin la/ 'di mdzad pa bo ni/ phyi rol pa'i partsi ta slob dpon dbyug pa can zhes bya ba phyi nang gnyis ka'i grub pa'i mtha' dang / rig pa'i gnas rnams la mkhas pa chen por gyur pa de yin zhing / gzhung 'di rgya gar du phyi nang gi mkhas pa kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin cing dar cha che la/ bod 'dir lo tsā ba shong dpang rnam gnyis kyis bsgyur cing zhus te 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab pa las dar rgyas chen po byung ngo / /gzhung 'di la 'grel ba mang bo mchis pa las kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos mdzad pa'i dbyangs can dgyes glu gzhir bzung nas/ kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes don 'grel tshigs— bcad ma snyan ngag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos dbyangs can zhal lung nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od can zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 4

rmad du byung ba 'di nyid mdzad/ 'dir rang blo legs bshad la goms par bya ba'i phyir rang blos dpag tshod tsam zhig 'grel ba la/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo dang / sgo de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos dngos bshad pa gnyis/

le'u dang po/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo mchod par brjod pa dang rtsom pasdo dam bca' ba bshad pa/ dang bo la/ mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis/ dang bo 'jam dpal dbyangs la mchod par brjod pa ni/ mkhyen rab ma lus 'dus pha'i gzugs sku'i mjos sdug rgya mtsho rdzogs/ /zab bagling yangs ldan gsung dbyangs res kyang zhing khams rab 'byams 'gengs/ /rnam med bde chen thugs kyi gting ni chos rnams kyis mi rdzogs/ /rgyal kun yab gcig lha kye daphyod ldan smra ba mchog grub mdzod/ /ces gsungs te/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab ma lus pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i rang gzugs gzugs sku'i mdzes sdug mtshan dpe'i rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs shing / ji lta ba ston pas zab cing brling ba ste gting dpag dka' ba/ ji snyed pa ston pas yangs shing rgya che ba ste zab rgyas nyis tshogs kyi brjod bya ldan pa'i gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs lta bu re res kyang mtha' yas pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams cig car du 'gengs par mdzad pa/ rnam med de rtog med kyi lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi thugs kyi gting mtha' ni chos rnams 6

kyis mi rdzogs pas chos rnams las kyang brgal ba'i/ rgyal kun yab gcig lha 'jam dpal dbyangs kye zhes thugs rgyud bskul ba'i 'bod tshig gsungs te/ rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros mchog dang ldan pa'i smra ba mchog ste smra ba'i dbang phyug tu bdag grub par mdzod/ ces sku gsung thugs gsum gyi yon tan la bstod de dngos grub zhus pa'o//dbyangs can ma la bstod pa ni/ gang zhig dran pa yis kyang mgrin ba'i sgrog grol gsung dbang byur du spyol/ /skal ldan mgrin par snyan tshig phreng marjes zla med spel la kun tu dgyes/ /gang 'tsham zhi dang drag po'i rnam par rol ston ye shes sku 'phrul mas/ /mgrin pa'i 'o mtshor 'jo sgeg gar stabs skur cig chu gter gyen 'thor bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang zhig dran pa yis te dran pa tsam gyis kyang mgrin pa'i sgrog ste/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud grol bar mdzad nas gsung gi dbang phyug gi dngos grub myur du stsol bar mdzad la/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi mgrin par snyan tshig gi phreng ba mdzes shing 'gran zla med pa spel ba la thugs shin tu dgyes pa/ gdul bya gang la gang 'tsham gyi zhi ba dang drag po'i rnam par rol cing sku'i rnam pa ston par byed pa/ thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes de nyid sgyu ma mkhan gyi 'phrul ltar lha sku bzhin lag girnam par shar ba lha mo dbyangs can mas/ bdag gi mgrin pa'i 'o ma'i mtsho ru gang 'dod 'jo ba'i nyams dang thugs zag med yon tan gyis khengs pa'i sgeg nyams kyi gar stabs sgyur cig ces chu gter chen po'i zegs ma gyen 7

du 'thor ba bzhin du gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes pa'o/ /rig gnas 'di'i rgyud 'dzin 'phags yul gyi paṇa chen rnams la mchod par brjod pa ni/ phul byung tshul 'di'i tshig smyor rmad byung gis/ /kun dga'i rgya mtsho 'dzin mkhas dpa' bo dang / /'dzin ma'i tshangs pacidage ba'i dbang bo'i zhabs/ /dbyangs can sras bo dakhyi ye ma bsngags/ /zhes gsungs te/ rig pa'i gnas phul du byung ba snyan tshig rig pa'i tshul lugs 'di'i tshig sbyor rmad du byung ba dag gis mkhas pa kun dga' bar byed pa'i rig gnas kyi rgya mtsho 'dzin pa la mkhas pa skyes rabs so bzhi ba rtsom pa bo slob dpon dpa' bo dang / 'dzin ma ste sa'i tshangs pa chen po dpag bsam 'khri shing rtsom pa bo rgyal bo dge ba'i dbang bo'i zhabs dang /dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung zhing mkhas pa chen po yin pas dbyangs can ma'i sras su gyur pa slob dpon danḍi rnams e ma ho rmad du byung ba'i mkhas pa yin gshis bstod bsngags brjod do//zhes pa'o/ / rig pa'i gnas 'di la bka' drin lhag par che ba'i lo chen rnams la mchod par brjod pa ni/ chos 'di bsgyur bshad rnam dkar gzi 'od kyis/ /gangs ldan khron yangs 'gengs mdzad sa'i nyi zla/ /shong dpang yab sras lo chen nam bzang zhabs/ /brgyud rsās ris med thub bstan bdud rtsi'i gter/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos 'di ste snyan ngag dang sgra rig pa'i gzhung sogs rig pa'i gnas legs sbyar las bod skad du bsgyur cing bshad rgyun spel ba'i rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las gzi 'od kyis gangs ldan 8

bod kyi sa'i khyon yangs shing rgya che ba de 'gengs par mdzad pa'i sa'i nyi zla shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa yab sras gnyis dang / lo chen nam mkha' bzang bo sogs brgyud par bcas pa rnams ni/ ris su chad pa med pa'i thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i bdud rtsi'i gter du gyur pa yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa rje bdag nyad chen po la mchod par brjod pa ni/ rmad byung rgyal kun 'phrin las gzugs can bzhin dang mtha' zal blo gros kun/ /nges par mkhas btsun bzang bo'i gzugs su rnams par rol pa'i gsang ba gsum/ /kun gsal zhags pas 'khud min grags snyan dkar bos phyogs kun nam mkha'i dbyings/ /khyab mdzad rgyal ba gnyis pa'i zhabs sen dbang rgyal spyi bor mchod la spro/ /zhes gsungs te/ spang rtogs mthar phyin pas rmad du byung zhing mchog tu gyur pa'i rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las thams cad gzugs can du grub pa bzhin du shar ba dang / pha mtha' bral ba'i rgyal ba dang de sras thams cad kyi blo gros kun/ zol bstod tsam min par nges par don dngos gnas la mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan pa'i dge slong gi gzugs su rnam par rol pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum po de nyid/ kun gsal zhags pa ste dgu tshigs zhags pas 'khyud min te bcings ma thub par grags snyan gyi 'od dkar bos phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kun gyi nam mkha'i dbyings mtha' dag khyab par mdzad pa'i rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi zhabs kyi sen mo nor bu rin 9

po che dbang gi rgyal bo de spyi bor mchod pa la spro ba rab— tu rgyas zhes pa'o /rje'i sras kyi thu bo rnams la mchod par brjod pa ni/yongs rdzogs rgyal bstan gser gyi thing rta che/ /rnam dbyod dpyang bas rab drangs lam srol che/ / skyong mdzad kun mkhyen mkhas grub lab sras sogs/ /thub bstaskaspog thing de dag la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs te/ mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa gser snye shing rta chen po de nyid/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyi dpung bas rab tu drangs pa'i dri bral gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu'i lam srol chen po de nyid skyong bar mdzad pa'i kun mkhyen mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang yab sras sogs thub pa'i bstan pa rin poce'i srog shing du gyur pa de dag la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /rgyal dbang rim byon rnams la mchod par brjod pa ni/ gangs tsan ljongs la rgyal ba'i nyin byed bdun/ /'byung bar lung bstan ji bzhin rim byon rje/ /dbyangs can bzhad dang bsod nams chu gter che//mthu stobs yon tan gter chen rnams la 'dud/ /ces gsungs te/ bka' gdams glegs bam sogs las/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mor byed pa bzhin gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyag na padmo'i sprul ba bdun 'byung bar lung bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin byon pa'i/ rje btsun dbyangs can bzhad pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / bsod nams chu gter che ste rgyal 10

ba bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / mthu stobs nus pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho rnams gus pas 'dud do/ /zhes pa'o/ /khyad par kun mkhyen rang gi dngos kyi bla ma kun gzigs lnga ba chen po la mchod par brjod pa ni/ dus gsum rnam 'dren kun gyi thugs rje gcig gyur ngag gi dbang phyug gang de nyid/ /ngur smrig rol pas blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i chos grid gdugs dkar grib bsil tsher/ /gnas lnga 'od gzi bkra bas 'dzin mar khrab byas rjogs ldan dga' ston gsar ba la/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rgyal kun dgyes ldan bsngags pa'i rje btsun khrod la snying nas gus/ /zhes gsungs te/ dus gsum gyi rnam 'dren rgyal ba kun gyi thugs brtse ba snying rje chen po gcig tu gyur pa'i ngag gi dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gang de nyid ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan gsol ba'i rnam par rol pas blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i chos srid kyi gdugs dkar bo'i skye 'gro yongs la gcig tu sman pa'i grib bsil chen po der/ rig pa'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyi gzi brjid kyis bkra bar mdzad la 'od gzi des 'dzin ma ste sa chen por khyab par byas pa'i rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston de la/phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mcho'i rgyal ba sras bcas kun rab tu dgyes pa dang ldan zhing bsngags brjod mdzad pa'i yul du gyur pa'i rje btsun lnga ba chen po khyod la snying nas gus pas 'dud do/ /zhes pa'o/ /chos 'brel dngos thob kyi bla ma rnams la mchod par brjod pa ni/thugs rje'i cha ni phyag na padma 'dzin/ /mkhyen ba'i thigs pa 'jam dbyangs 11

gzhon nur gyur/ /mthu nus gsang bdag la 'gran rigs brgya'i bdag /zla med yongs rdzogs bshes gnyen rnams la 'dud/ /ces gsungs te/ thugs rbartse ba snying rje chen po'i cha ni ste de'i cha nas phyag na padma ste spyan ras gzigs dbang la 'gran bzod la/ thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi thigs pa ste de'i cha nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'gran nus pa dang /mthu dang nus pa'i yon tan gyis gsang ba'i bdag po la 'gran bzod pa'i rigs brgya'i khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang ngo bo dbyer med pa'i thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la 'dud/ ces pa'o/ / bye brag tu yongs 'dzin khri chen rnam bzhi la mchod par brjod pa ni/rgyu skar dbus na bdud rtsi sbyin rgyas bzhin/ /kun la ma mongs 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yis/ /rab 'byams mkhas mang dbus na lham me ba/ /paṇa chen ma ti rnam bzhi rgyal gyur cig /ces gsungs te/ mkha' la rgyu skar bkra ba'i dbus na bdud rtsi sbyin te zla ba rab tu gsal zhing rgyas pa bzhin du/ chos kun la ma rmongs pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i yon tan gyi dbang gis rab 'byams mkhas mang ste mkhas pa mtha' yas pa'i dbus na lham mer khyad par du 'phags pa'i partsi ta chen po khri blo gros rgya mtsho sogs ma ti ste blo yi mtshan can rnam bzhi rgyal bar gyur cig /ces shis brjod dang 'brel bar mchod par brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' ba la/ rig gnas 'di la bsngags pa/12

dam bca' dngos/ zhar byung log rtog dgag pa dang gsum las/ dang bo ni/ gang zhig sgro ldan mang du 'dus pa'i tshe/ /mkhas dang mongs pa'i khyad 'byed gtan tshigs dang / /sgra rig 'khor bcas yin no khyad par du/ /mkhas pa'i zhal mjes snyan ngag kho na yin/ /zhes rigasungs te/ gang zhig ces spyi'i tshul du smras nas spyi las bye brag gi tshul du dngos bzung ba ni/ blo gros dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa mang du 'dus pa'i tshe/ mkhas pa dang rmongs pa'i khyad par 'byed byed kyi yon tan ni gtan tshigs rig pa dang / sgra rig pa 'khor bcas te rig gnas chung ba lnga dang bcas pa yin no/ /khyad par du mkhas pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi zhal sgo mdzes shing yangs par byed pa'i rig gnas ni snyan ngag kho na yin/ zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa dam bca' dngos ni/ bstan bcos 'di la mkhas smongs mang dag gis/ /'grel ba dper brjod dri can mang mod kyang / /tshig nyung don rdzogs dka' 'grel dbyangs can glu/ /de rjes 'brangs nas gsal byed bdag spro 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ snyan ngag gi bstan bcos me long ma 'di la/mkhas pa dang mi mkhas pa'i rmongs pa dag gis brtsams pa'i 'grel ba dang / dze dper brjod skyon gyi dri ma can mang mod/ tshig nyung zhing don yongs su rdzogs pa'i dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs 'di nyid/ mchog tu gyur par mthong ste de'i rjes su 'brangs nas snyan ngag me long ma'i don gsal bar byed pa'i don 'grel zhig bdag gis spro bar 'dod/ ces pa'o//13

gsum pa zhar byung log rtog dgag pa ni/ gang dag gzhan gyi bstan pa ston pa dang / /grub byed gtan tshigs ma lus gcor bkag pa'i/ sgyu/mdo 'grel thun mong yin na lugs de sun/ /'byin byed de'i yin ma smyos su zhig smra/ /de phyir de rjes 'brang rnams sab mis/ /btang ba'i lal ga dag la sdod par rlom/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang dag ste/ kha cig gis/ gzhan mu stegarme pa'i bstan pa dang ston pa dang de dag gi sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs rigs pa ma lus pa gtso bor mtha' chod par—bkag pa 'i tshad ma sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa phyi rol pa dad thun mong gi bstan bcos yin no/ /zhes smra'o/ /de ltar yin na/ phyi rol pa'i lugs de sun 'byin byed kyi bstan bcos de phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos yin zer dgos la/ de ltar ma smyos pa su zhig gis smra ste mi smra'o/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ smyo gtam 'dra ba de dag gi rjes su 'brang ba rnams ni/ rtsa bas btang ba ste rtsa ba rul zhing chad pa'i shing sdong gi yal ga dag la brten nas sdod par rlom pa dang 'dra bas 'gyel bar 'gyur zhes pa'o//sgo de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos dngos bshad pa/ gnyis pa sgo de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos dngos bshad pa la/ lus dang / rgyan dang / skyon sel gsum/ dang bo la mdor bstan/ dbye ba/skad rigs bshad pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/ dang bo la dngos dang /14snye

zhar byung 'khrul sel gnyis/ dang bo ni/ lus ni 'dod pa'i don can tshig gi phreje / /dbye na bcad smyag spel ma rnam gsum 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/snyan ngag gi lus ni/ rtsom pa bos brjod par 'dod pa'i don can gyi ming tshig yi ge 'dus pa'i tshig gi phreng ba'o/ /dbye na tshigs bcad 'ba' zhig pa dad / lhug pa rkyang ba dang / de gnyis spel ma ste rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ ces pa'o/ / gnyis pa zhar byung 'khrul sel ni/ tshigs bcad las gzhan rgyun chags med pa'i phyir/ /rgyun chags zur du 'byed pa shin rtu 'khrul/ /rgyun chags ma bcad sdeb smyor bzhin yin na/ /rkang bas gartsod dasto rang gi tshig dang 'gal/ /gang yang rkang bas ma bcad lhug pa la/ /ndeb smyor prastu mi 'byung tshigs bcad la/ rkang bzhi mi dgos mngon pas rgyas 'geb pa/ /zhwa dpe lham la 'geb pa kho nar zad/ /ces gsungs te/ legs sbyar gyi skad kyi sdeb sbyor gyi dbye bas nang gi sdeb sbyor rgyun chags la/ nges par tshigs bcad dgos pas/ tshigs bcad las logs su rgyun chags zhes pa zhig med mod/ sa paṇa gyi sdeb sbyor me tog chun por/ rgyun chags tshigs bcad las zur du 'byed pa ni/ shin tu 'khrul ba yin te/ sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung rnams las/ tshigs bcad rkang ba bzhi ba'i rkang ba re la yi ge nyi shu rtsa bdun yan chad yod pa la rgyun chags dang / rab bsags su bshad pa'i phyir/ sa paṇa mkhas 'jug las/ rgyun chags ma bcad pa ni sdeb sbyor rgyun chags dang 'dra la/ zhes gsungs pas/ rkang bas ma bcad pa'i rgyun 15

chags shig yod pa de sdeb sbyor bzhin yin na/ me tog chun por/ sdeb sbyor la rkang bas gcod dgos par gsungs pa'i sa paṇa rang gi tshig dang 'gal la/ gzhung gang yin yang rkang bas ma bcad pa'i tshig lhug la sdeb sbyor gyi prastu ra mi 'byung ste/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas su bṛta ta dang dzā ti gang la yang rkang ba med pa ste tshigs su ma bcad pa la sdeb sbyor gyi rnam gzhag ma mdzad pas so/ /'dir sdeb sbyor gyi tshigs bcad la rkang ba bzhi mi dgos pa'i sgrub byed du/ mngon pa kun btus kyi lung drangs te/des rgyas 'geb byed pa ni/ zhwa dpe lham la 'geb pa kho nar zad pas mi 'thad do/ /zhes pa'o/ / gnyis pa dbye ba la/ tshigs bcad bshad pa/ lhug pa bshad pa/ spel ma bshad pa dang gsum/ dang bo la/ dbye ba mdor bstan pa/ grol ba sogs so sor bshad pa/ sarga chen po'i mtshan nyid bshad pa dang gsum/ dang bo ni/ snyan ngag tshigs bcad rkang ba bzhi ldan de/ /dbye na sdeb smyor sgo nas bṛ dzwaganyis/ /rigs kyi sgo nas grol rigs mdzod 'dus bzhi/ /dang bo rab gces spros pa gzhan du tshol/ /ces gsungs te/ snyan ngag tshigs bcad rkang ba bzhi dang ldan pa de la dbye na/ sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas yi ge bgrang ba bṛta ta dang / phyi mo bgrang ba dzā ti gnyis yod la/ rigs kyi sgo nas/ grol ba/ rigs/ mdzod/ 'dus pa dang bzhi yod/ dang bo sdeb sbyor gyi rig pa de yang snyan ngag gi skabs 'dir rab tu gces shing mkho 16

bas/ bṛta ta dang dzā ti'i spros pa mtha' dag ni/ rin chen 'byung gnas dang / dmar ser can dang / rgyal ba'i lha'i gzhung rnams las tshol bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'o/ / gnyis pa grol ba sogs so sor bshad pa la/ bzhi las/ dang bo grol ba ni/ grol ba zhol ka gcig gis don rdzogs ston/ /zhes gsungs te/ grol ba ni sho lo ka gcig gis brjod bya'i don gang yin pa de yongs su rdzogs par ston nus pa de yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ rje gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod las/ 'dab stong rtse na zla ba'i me long ngos/ /ting 'dzin pir gyis bris 'dra tshangs sras ma/ /snyan 'gyur rgyud mang sgra las ngag gi dpyid/ /'dod dgur 'jo ba lhag pa'i lha der 'dud/ /yang /snyan 'gyur rgyud mang sgra dang sbyar ba yi/ /legs bshad rol mo rnam par spro ba'i gnyen/ /ngag la ngag gi dpal ster dbyangs ldan mas/ /sdeb legs tshig gi 'dod pa 'jo bar mdzod/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ / gnyis pa rigs ni/ yul gcig shol ka du mas rab blangs nas//bya tshig gcig gis thams cad ston nus rigs/ /zhes gsungs te/ bsngags brjod kyi yul gcig la sho lo ka du ma yod pa sho lo ka re re'i nang du don rdzogs pa min par/ sho lo ka du mas don de rab tu blangs nas/ bya tshig gcig gis don thams cad gsal bar ston nus pa de rigs yin/ zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ rje gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod las/ dkar 17

gsal ri dwags mtshan ma yi//mdzes sdug snyem pa 'phrog byed pa'i/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa/ /blo ldan yid kyi lcags kyu bzhin/ /yon por blta ba'i zur mig gi/ /'od kyi zhags pa ring bo yis/ /rna lung nor bu'i mjes sdug kun/ /dal gyis 'dren pa'i 'jab bu mkhan/༄/mchu sgros bim pa'i dga' tshal dbus//tshems phreng zla ba'i myu gu las/ /bsung zhim bsil zer spro ba yi/ /dbyangs ldan mthong bas dang ba 'phel/ /zhes pa lta ba'o/ /gsum pa mdzod ni/ gcod mtshams sna tshogs ngos nas shol ka dang / /bya tshig nges med brjod byas phyug pa mdzod/ /ces gsungs te/ gcod mtshams sna tshogs pa'i ngosanas sho lo ka dang / bya tshig mang nyung nges bzung med cing / brjod bya du mas phyug pade mdzod yin zhes pa yin la/dper na/ gung thang dpe brjod las/ dkar zhing gsal la dri ma med/ /mdzesasnyug dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs/ /zur mig ga bur zegs ma yis/ /yid kyi gdung ba sel byed cing / /dga' ba'i kun da khong nas rgod/ /'dzum dkar bdud rtsi'i 'od rlabs kyis/ /blo gros chu gter rgyas par byed/ /sgeg cing rab tu dgyes pa'i nyams/ /ri dwags gzugs kyis rnam par ngom/ /dbyangs ldan ma ni kho bo'i lha/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi ba 'dus pa ni/tshodon gcig shol ka bya tshig du ma can/ /'dus pa'o sargas bcings pa'i cha shas 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ brjod bya'i don gcig la sho lo ka du ma yod pa la bya tshig kyang du ma yod pa can ni 'dus 18

pa yin la/de 'dra ba'i tshigs bcad rgya che ba ni/ sargas bcings pa'i snyatshon ngag gi cha shas su 'dod pas/ de'i nang du 'dus pa yin/ zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ dmar ser sku yi nyin byed las/ /phyag g.yas mkha' la brkyangs pa ni/ /rab dmar glog gi rtse dga' yis/ /shes bya'i khor yug gzhal byed bzhin/ /nor bu'i snye ma g.yur za zhing / /sgra ldan gser sbyangs gdu bu yis/ /mkhrig ma'i phyogs su brgyan pa 'dis/ /srid zhi'i mdzes sdug bdag gir byed/ /gang gi yal 'dab rtse mo na/ /rtsen pa ral gri'i gdengs ka yis/ /kun rmongs mun pa'i dra ba dag /cig car nyid la gcod par byed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/sgro/ gsum pa sarga chen po'i mtshan nyid bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid/ sgo/srog mkhas pas bzhed tshul dang bzhi/ dang bo ni/ this sogs sgo dang nde bzhi sogs kyi srog /nyams dang 'gyur ba rgyan rnams dag gis spras/ /sarga ldan dang de mtha' tha dad ldan/ /snyan ngag che ba'i mtshan nyid / /ces gsungs te/ shis brjod dang sogs sgras bsdus pa mchod brjod dang dngos po nges bstan gsum ni snyan ngag chen po la 'jug pa'i sgo yin pas de gsum mam gang rung sngon du bkod pa dang / sde bzhi la sogs pa'i brjod bya'i srog dang ldan zhing / brjod bya de rnams brjod tshe rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa'i tshig gi nyams thon zhing / tshig gi nyams de las yid kyi 'gyur ba bskyed nus pa/ sgra dang don gyi rgyan rnams dag gis spras shing / sarga ste le'u dang 19

skabs rab byed lta bu ldan pas/ de dag gi mtha' rnams su tshig ring thung bcad lhug sogs tha dad pa ste mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dang ldan pa de/ snyan ngag chen po'i mtshan nyid yin/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa sgo ni/ der 'jug sgo/ /shis brjod phyag bya dngos po nges bstan gsum/ /shis brjod yul la srungs sogs shis par smon/ /phyag bya 'dud gus bsngags sogs ldan pa'i ngag /gzhung de'i brjod bya'i lus kyi cha bsdus nas/ /ston pa gang de dngos po nges par bstan/ /zhes gsungs te/snyan ngag chen po la 'jug pa'i sgo ni/ shis par brjod pa/ phyag bya ba/dngos po nges par bstan pa gsum yod pas de gsum gang rung re'i sgo nas bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa yin te/ shis brjod ni skyabs yul la bdag dang gzhan lta bu'i yul srungs shig dang sogs sgras bsdus pa rgyal dang / shis dang mdzod lta bu'i shis par smon pa yin la/ phyag bya ba ni bstod pa'i yul la gus pa dngasta bsngags pa dang skyabs 'tshol ba dang dngos grub zhu ba sogs dang ldan pa'i ngag go/ /dngos po nges bstan ni/ brtsam bya'i gzhung de'i lus kyi brjod bya'i cha thams cad bsdus nas ston pa gang yin pa ste/ lus mdor bstan yang zer la 'di gsum ni mi 'gal lo/ /de gsum ni/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/shis brjod ni/ 'grib med 'od kyi rtse dga' yis/ /dus kyi mun pa mthar mdzad pa/ /ye shes snang ba bla na med/ /tshe mtha' yas pas shis par mdzod/ /20

phyag ni/ thugs rje'i pi wang dang bo'i rgyud/ /brdung ba tsam gyis rmongs pa'i gzings/ /'joms byed dri za'i na chung ma/ /dbyangs can lha der snying nas 'dud/ /dngos po nges bstan ni/ bcad lhug spel ma'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ /sde bzhi'i gtam gyi ri bong mtshan mas mdzes/ /sgra don rgyan gyi 'od dkar dra ba can/ /legs bshad zla shel thub bstan mkha' la 'dren/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa srog ni/ sngon byung gtam dang sde bzhi la sogs pa/ /brjod bya'i don ni spog yin de yi phyir/ /lus la tshig don gnyis su 'byed rnams 'khrul/ /brjod bya spog dang bcad lhag spel ma lus/ /sgra don gab tshig mdzes bar byed pa'i rgyan/ /smra 'di khyad 'phags legs bshad yin par sems/ /zhes gsungs te/ sngon byung gi gtam skyes rabs dang / rig byed kyi gtam sogs dang / yang na chos ni mngon mtho nges legs sgrub pa'i rgyu/nor ram don ni rig byed mang du thos pa dang sa gzhi dang rin po che sogs gsog pa dang bsrung ba/ 'dod pa ni 'dod yon lnga'am lha mi'i yul la longs spyod pa/ thar ba ni 'khor ba las thar ba'i thar ba dang bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa/ de ltar chos nor 'dod pa thar ba bzhi la sogs pa'i snyan ngag gi brjod bya'i don la srog zer ba yin/ de'i phyir 'jam kha sogs kyis lus la tshig don gnyis su 'byed pa ni 'khrul ba yin te/ brjod bya la srog dang / tshigs bcad/ lhug pa/ spel ma'i gzhung ni — 21

lus dang / sgra rgyan don rgyan gab tshig rnams ni mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan yin zhes smra ba 'di ni/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i legs bshad yin par bdag gis sems so/ /zhes pa'o//'dir grong khyer rgya mtsho ri gsum la bsngags pa'i dpe brjod ni/dpe brjod de las/ dal zhing rgyu ba so ka'i nyin byed kyis/ /gnam sngon me long zhu ba smig rgyu'i chab/ /spang gshong yangs por 'khyil 'dra'i chu mtsho las/ /lbu ba'i skar tshogs mkha' la 'thor ba bzhin/ /sil sil 'bab pa gtsang ma'i chab rgyun can/ /ljang sngon nags tshal mdzes pas smad khebs shing / /sprin dkar stod g.yogs g.yo ba'i ri sul na/ /khu byug myos pa'i gsung snyan dal gyis sgrog /'od stong gzi byin ma bzod skar ma'i tshogs/ /sa la 'phos 'dra grong khyer chen po'i dbus/ /gser gyi rgyal mtshan phreng bas mdzes pa ni/ /nyi ma'i dmag tshogs rjes su bab pa bzhin/ /zhes pa dang /dus dang nyi zla 'char ba dang skyed tshal chu yi rol rtsed rnams kyi bsngags pa ni/ skyon bral ston gyi mkha' la rta ljang can/ /'bar ba'i ze ra gyis phye ba'i 'dab stong phreng / /tshar dngar skyedalatshal dbus kyi rdzing bu na/gzhon nu khrus kyi rtse dga'i rnam par rol/ /ces pa lta bu dang /chang 'thung 'khrig pa dus btab ma tshogs pa gsum ni/ chang gis myos pas zim zim lta byed cing / /dga' mgur rol pa'i bde bas spu long 22

rgyas/ /'on kyang da dung 'dod pa'i pho nya mo/ /gzhan dang dus btab las 'das gdung bas mnar/ /zhes pa lta bu dang /bag ma gtong len dang / gzhon nu skye 'phel ni/ yid kyi shing rta 'gro dang 'ong ba yis/ /nye bar mtshams sbyar dga' ba'i dga' ston che/ /dar ba'i rigs sras gsar ba'i ku mu da/ /'phel ba yar tshes zla ba'i myu gu bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu dang / g.yul bshams pa dang / rgyal bo'i mnga' thang dar ba'i tshul ni/ rta rmig gis bslang rdul gyis chu mthongs 'gog /ri bo ral byed glang bo'i dpa' sgra can/ /mi bzad g.yul gyi dgra sde'i dpung bcom tshe/ /rgyal bo'i sde bzhi'i mnga' thang ngang gis 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu dang /bya ba rtsom pa'i gros dang / pho nya'i 'gro 'ong dang / yul thag ring bor bgrod pa gsum ni/ rten 'byung mdun na 'don gyis gros btab ste/ /dpyad 'jog lta ba'i pho nya 'gro 'ong gis/ /dngos 'dzin btson ra bshig nas gnyug ma'i sems/ /pha rol zhi ba'i gling der dal gyis songs/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi ba mkhas pas bzhed tshul ni/ yul bsngags gzhan las rgyal zhes ṅgā ma ha /gzhan bsngags de las lhag bsngags dbyug pa can/ /zhes gsungs te/ thog mar bstod yul rgyal bo lta bu'i dpa' ba sogs kyi yon tan la rab tu bsngags nas/ de lta bu'i yon tan can de gzhan las rgyal 23

cho—lo zhes bstod pa'i snyan ngag gi lam 'di ni mdzes so zhes bhā ma ha bzhed do/ /rigs dang brtson 'grus mang du thos pa sogs kyis gzhan pha rol gyi dgra bo la bsngags pa brjod nas/ bstod yul gyi rgyal bo ni de las rgyal bas de las lhag go zhes bstod bsngags byed pa de ni snga ma las mdzes pa yin zhes slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis 'dod/ ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa lhug pa bshad pa/ rkang med tshig rgyun lhag pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /ming gis dbye na brjod pa gtam gnyis 'dod/ /don gyi dbye ba bhā ma has bzhed kyang / /dbyangs can mgrin par rol pa'i dakhyis bkag /ces gsungs te/ tshig rkang bzhi sogs su bcad pa med pa'i tshig gi rgyun de/lhug pa'i mtshan nyid yin la/ de la ming tsam gyi sgo nas dbye na/ brjod pa dang gtam gnyis yod par 'dod la/ don gyi dbye tshul la bhā ma has/rgyal bo lta bu rang nyid kyis rang la bstod pa byas pa lta bu ni brjod pa dang / gzhan gyis rgyal bo la bstod pa byas pa lta bu ni gtam yin zhes bzhed kyang / lha mo dbyangs can ma mgrin par rol pa'i slob dpon danḍis 'dod pa de bkag nas/ brjod pa dang gtam gnyis ni ming gi rnam grangs tsam las don tha dad pa med par bzhed/ ces pa'o/ /gsum pa bcad lhug spel ma bshad pa ni/ tshigs bcad lhag pa spel legs spel mar 'dod/ /dbye na bcad lhag spel cing kun dga' sogs/ /skad rigs bzhi 'dus zlos gar de dang ni/ /gcig brten bcad lhag spel ba'i tsam pū gnyis/ /zhes gsungs te/ chigs bcad dang tshig lhug spel te 24

legs par bsgrigs pa ni bcad lhug spel ma yin par 'dod/cide la dbye ba ni legs sbyar gyi dbang du byas na/ bcad lhug spel ma klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar lta bu skad rigs bzhi 'dus pa'i zlos gar dang / skad rigs gcig la brten pa'i bcad lhug spel ma skyes rabs so bzhi ba lta bu la tsam pū zhes brjod pa de dang gnyis yod/ ces pa'o/ /lus kyi sa bcad gsum pa skad rigs bshad pa la/ dbye ba/ so sor bshad pa/skad rigs kyis bcings tshul dang gsum/ dang bo ni/ snyan ngag tshigs bcad lhug pa spel ma'i lus/ /de dag legs sbyar rang bzhin zur chag dang / /'dres pa bzhi ru sngon gyi mkhas pas sbyar/ /zhes gsungs te/ snyan ngag gi tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug bcad lhug spel ma'i lus de dag kyang legs sbyar gyi skad dang / rang bzhin gyi skad dang / zur chag gi skad dang / de gsum 'dres pa ste bzhi ru rā ma sharma sogs sngon gyi mkhas pas sbyar ba ste gsungs/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa so sar bshad pa la/rdzo dang bo legs sbyar ni/ byings ske ming rsha rtags la kṛtra rkyen dang / /kun bshad tidrarshadang supra kyis bsgrubs pa yi/ /ming dang tshig dag skad mchog legs sbyar 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ legs sbyar gyi skad ni byings tsam las rtags la kṛtpa rkyen byin te bsgrubs pa'i ming dang ming tsam las rtags la kun bshad kyi tingu dang supra byin te bsgrubs pa'i ming dang ming las tshig tu grub pa dag ni/skad rnams kyi mchog saṃ skṛ ta ste legs sbyar gyi skad du 'dod/ ces ri 25

pa'o/ /rang bzhin ni/ rang bzhin legs sbyar de las skyes pa'i skad/ /yul 'khor che brten skad kyang de yi mchog /ces gsungs te/ rang bzhin gyi skad de ni legs sbyar gyi skad ma— yin na yang legs sbyar gyi skad de las skyes pa ste de las byung ba'i skad —yin la/ bzo gnas bco brgyad sogs tshang ba'i yul 'khor chen po la brten pa'i skad kyang rang bzhin gyi skad rnams kyi nang nas mchog yin/ zhes pa'o/ / zur chag ni/ phyugs rdzi sogs tshig snyan ngag la zur chag /ka tsan sogs las legs sbyar las gzhan 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ phyugs rdzi la sogs pa'i grong tshig rnams snyan ngag gi skabs 'dir zur chag tu gnas shing /ka tsan sogs kyi bstan bcos rnams las legs sbyar las gzhan pa'i skad rnams ni zur chag yin zhes 'dod/ ces pa'o/ /'dres ma ni/ legs sbyar rang bzhin zur chag gsum 'dres pa'i/ /ngag gi rang bzhin de 'dra 'dres mar bshad//ces gsungs te/ legs sbyar gyi skad dang rang bzhin gyi skad zur chag gi skad gsum 'dres pa'i snyan ngag gi rang bzhin gyi bstan bcos de 'dra la 'dres ma'i snyan ngag ces bshad do/ /zhes pa'o/ / gsum pa skad rigs kyis bcings tshul ni/ sngon byung gtam sogs de bzhi gang rung ngam/ /gnyis sam gsum mam thams cad 'dres pa dang / /26

legs sbyar 'ba' zhig gis kyang bcings pa yod/ /ces gsungs te/ sngon byung gi gtam la sogs pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos rnams skad rigs chen po de bzhi gang rung gis bcings pa dang / skad rigs gnyis 'dres pa dang / skad rigs gsum 'dres pa dang / skad rigs thams cad 'dres pa dang / legs sbyar gyi skad 'ba' zhig gis bcings pa yod/ces pa'o/ /'di skabs 'grel ba dag las legs sbyar 'ba' zhig las ri byas pa dpag bsam 'khri shing lta bu dang / rang bzhin gyi skad 'ba' zhig las byas pa skan dha ka sogs dang / zur chag gi skad 'ba' zhig las byas pa o sa ra sogs dang / 'dres ma'i skad las byas pa zlos gar sogs dang / sha za'i skad 'ba' zhig las byas pa'ange med pa min te/rmad du byung ba'i don— can brjod bya ston pa rgya chen zhes pa'i gtam dang / rin chen rab snang zhes bya ba yang 'byung bo'i skad kyi rang bzhin du brjod/gsungs so/ / —bzhi ba mjug bsdu ba ni/ snyan ngag dag la nyer mkho ba'i/ /lus srog sgo dang rtsom tshul gyi/ /gces bsdus 'khrul spang bla ma'i gsung / /nyi ma gsar ba slar yang bzhin/ /snyan ngag gi lus sogs kyi rab tu byed pa ste dang bo'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ snyan ngag gi gzhung dag la nye bar mkho ba'i snyan ngag gi lus dang brjod bya'i srog bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ rtsom tshul rnams kyi rnam gzhag gces bsdus kyi tshul du bkod pa'i 'khrul spang 'di ni bla ma'i gsung gi nyi ma gsar ba slar yang shar ba bzhin du gsal ba 27

yin/ zhes pa yin la/ lhag ma go sla'o// lho shar thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan bshad pa/rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa rgyan bshad pa la/ shis par brjod pa dang / rgyan dngos gnyis/ dang bo ni/ zla rgyas zhal la utpal sngon po'i srun/ /bim pa'i chu sgros 'dzum pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor/ /mdzees zla srid zhir ma rnyed rang nyid dper/ /ston mdzad dbang mos ngag gi mchog sbyin mdzod/ /ces gsungs te/ zla ba rgyas pa ste nya gang ba lta bu'i zhal la atpal sngon po lta bu'i spyan gyis spras shing / shing bim pa ltar dmar ba'i mchu sgros 'dzum pa dang ldan pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor de nyid mdzes pa'i dpe zhig srid pa dang zhi bzhi khams la/sa ma rnyed pas/ rang nyid mdzes pa'i dper rang nyid ston par/mdzad pa'i ngag gi dbang mo dbyangs can mas snyan ngag smra ba'i mchog sbyin par mdzod cig /ces 'bru mang bo'i tshig sdud dang / dpe rgyan nyer gsum pa thun mong min pa'i dpes brgyan pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyan dngos la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang bo ni/ sgeg rol stabs sogs blta bya'i don yin la/ /rgyud mang glu sogs mnyan bya'i don ldan gyi/ /༅mas las gnyis smyor don nyams kun la gces/ /zhes gsungs te/ lus sgeg pa dang / nyams kyi rol pa dang / rkang lag gi stabs la sogs pa'i nyams brjod pa ni gtso bor mig gis blta bya'i don 28

yin la/ rgyud mang dang glu dbyangs sogs kyi nyams brjod pa ni gtso bor rna bas mnyan par bya ba'i don dang ldan pa yin la/ de lta bu'i nyams gnyis las gnyis ka sbyor ba ni don rgyan gyi nyams dod tshul kun la gces par zungs shig /ces pa'o// ske gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan dang /thun mong ba'i rgyan gnyis/ dang bo la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ snyan ngag gi rgyu bshad pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/ dang bo ni/ snyo shar thun mong min pa'i lam dbye na/ /sbyar ba rab dwangs mnyam nyid snyan dang gzhon//don gsal rgya che bajid mjes ting 'dzin bcu/ /lho ba'i lam srog phal cher bzlog pa ni/ /shar ba'i lugs yin 'di dag gsal bar dbye/ /zhes gsungs te/ yi ge'i sbyor ba lci ba sbyar ba dang / 'jig rten na grags pa'i don can rab dwangs dang / yi ge 'jam rtsub kyi sbyor ba mnyam pa mnyam nyid/nyams khyad dang ldan pas snyan pa dang / yi ge 'jam pa shas che bas shin tu gzhon pa dang / don brtag mi dgos pas don gsal dang / khyad par du brjod bya'i yon tan rgya che bas rgya che ba dang / tshig sdud mang zhing lci yang do mnyam pas brjid pa dang / 'ud po che ma yin pa'i 'jig rten dang mthun pas mdzes pa dang / sems ldan gyi chos sems med la bkod pas ting nge 'dzin te/ bcu bo 'di ni lho phyogs bee daṭā bha'i lam gyi srog tu bshad pa yin la/ 'di dag phal cher go ldog pa ni shar phyogs go ḍa ba'i lugs kyi lam dag mtshon pa yin la/ 'di dag gsal bar dbye bar 29

bya'o/ /zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la bcu las/ /dang bo sbyar ba bshad pa la thog mar 'jam rtsub kyi yi ge ngos bzung ba ni/ spre lnga'i zla rtse mda' dang mthar gnas kyi/ /spogatsho chung bral te sde lnga'i mig chu bo/ /dro ba kṣa rnams / /zhes gsungs te/ legs sbyar gsal byed kyi yi ge'i ka sde tsa sde ṭa sde ta sde pa sde ste/ sde ba lnga'i zla ba ste dang bo ka tsa ṭa ta pa rnams dang / rtse mo ste gsum pa ga dza ḍa da ba rnams dang / mda' ste lnga ba nga nya ṇa na ma rnams dang /mthar gnas kyi yi ge ya ra la wa ste bcu dgu bo ni srog chung dang 'jam pa dang lhod pa dang mnyen pa'i yi ge zhes bya la/ 'di brjod pa'i tshe kha yi rlung shugs chung ba'i phyir de ltar brjod pa'o/ /lho ba'i sbyar ba ni srog chung de dag kho na sbyar ba'i lhod pa dang bral te/ sde ba lnga'i mig ste gnyis pa kha tsha ṭha tha pha rnams dang / chu bo ste sde ba lnga'i bzhi ba gha dzha bhā dha bha rnams dang / dro ba'i yi ge sha ṣa sa ha dang kṣa yig dang bco lnga bo rnams ni srog chen dang rtsub pa dang dam pa dang gyong ba yin zhes pa'o/ /de rnams mang du 'dus pa las grub pa'i tshigs bcad la sbyor ba lci ba zer/ zhes pa'o/ /'di ni legs sbyar skad kyi dbang du byas la/ bod skad kyi dbang du byas na rgya skad la med pa ca cha ja zha za 'a rnams kyi sgra gdangs sbyar tshul/ca cha ja gsum ni/ tsa tsha dza gsum dang 'dra la/zha za 'a gsum ni/ sha sa a rnams dang 'dra bas/ gsal byed sum cu las/ ka ga nga /ca ja nya/ ta da na/30

pa ba ma/tsa dza wa/ 'a ya ra la a nyi shu ni srog chung dang / kha cha tha pha tsha zha za sha sa ha bcu ni srog chen yin mod/ srog chung yin yang mgo can dang 'dogs can du song tshe srog chen du 'gyur ba dang / 'phul dang ming gzhi rjes 'jug gsum nang phan tshun srog che chung 'phrad pa'i dbang gis 'jam rtsub tu 'gyur la/ 'phul 'jug yod pa'i mgo 'dogs can ni shin tu rtsub pa dang sbyor ba lci bar 'gyur ba/ rang gis kha nas brjod pa'i tshe myong bas shes te/ dper na/ sgra bsgrags drag bskyod skra brdzes spyi dgra bsgral/ /lta bu rtsub pa dang / gang la yon tan mnga' ba de la dga'/ /zhes pa lta bu 'jam pa dang sbyor ba yang ba lta bu'o/ /legs sbyar la'ang skabs 'di'i sbyor ba lci yang dang / spyir yi ge lci yang mi 'dra ste/ skabs 'dir yi ge srog chen mang ba dang srog chen sha stag min yang yi ge lci ba mang ba'i dbang gis tshigs su bcad pa de brjod tshe kha ru sgra gyong bo 'byung ba la sbyor ba lci ba zer zhing de las ldog pa la sbyor ba yang ba zer/yi ge lci yang ni dbyangs can sgra mdo las/ pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ba sogs med pa'i thung ngu ni yang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ pha rol tu yi ge brtsegs ma dang / rnam bcad dang / nga ro rnams med pa'i dbyangs thung ngu dang dbyangs thung ngu can rnams ni yang ba yin la/ pha rol tu gsal byed dbyangs med ha lan ta'i mtshan ma can dang gsal byed brtsegs pa yod na de las tshu rol gyi yi ge de lci ba dang / dbyangs ring 31

cha dang 'greng bu rna ru can te ring bo rnams dang plu ta'i rtags can ni gnas skabs thams cad du lci ba yin pa dang / rnam bcad can dang rjes su nga ro can rnams kyang lci ba yin no/ / sbyar ba dngos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ mang 'dus las grub myi/ /sbyar ba'i mtshan nyid bee dar lha yi lugs/ /'dir spog che sbyar gnyis par sgra don sbyar/ /'dir ni smyor lci sdeb smyor yi ge lci/ /srog chung mang 'dus smyor ba phyod par bcas/ /yig bskor rjes su khrid bcas shar ba 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/gong du bshad pa'i yi ge srog chen du ma 'dus pa1ma srog chen dang yi ge lci ba mang bo 'dus pa las grub pa'i sbyor ba lci ba sde ṅge sbyar ba'i mtshan nyid du lho phyogs bee dar bha'i lugs yis la/ sbyar ba'i skabs 'dir srog che chung sbyar la gnyis pa rab dwangs kyi skabs su sgra'i sgo nas don go sla ba la sbyar ba dang / skabs 'dir ni sbyor ba lci yang dang sdeb sbyor gyi skabs yi ge lci yang sbyar ba'o/ /srog chung mang bo 'dus pa'i sbyor ba lhod pa dang bcas te/ —yi ge bskor ba rjes su khrid pa bcas ni ldog pa shar phyogs gau ḍa ba dag 'dod do/ /zhes pa'i don no//shar phyogs gau ḍa ba'i sbyar ba ni/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/padma'i rtse na snyan pa'i glu len ma/ /nyi ma'i mdangs bkra mu tig 'od ldan ma/ /ma ltar gus pas bsten no dbyangs ldan ma/ /ma g.yel brtse bas gzigs pa ma dor cig /'di yang / rab dkar ka ma la yi gdan steng na/ /dkar zhing mdzes 32

pa ngang ba'i bu mo dkar/ /'dzum dkar bsil ba'i ltad dkar spro ba yis/ /blo yi kun da rgyas pa'i mdzes sdug dkar/ /zhes snga ma ma yig bskor ba'i rjes khrid dang / phyi ma ka yig bskor ba'i rjes khrid yin la/ gnyis ka srog chung mang bo 'dus pas sbyor ba lhod pa'o//lho phyogs bai dar bha'i sbyar ba ni/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/shes rab chung yang khengs ldan mkhas rlom tshogs/ /'thad 'thad tshig gis phal cher mgo skor zhing / /tshig 'khri kho nas mi tshe chud gzon pas/ /tshang tshing khor yug khengs yang phan pa chung / /'di yang / shes rab med na khengs kyang mkhas pa min/ /khe tshong kho nar 'tham tshe btsun pa min/ /khe 'dod phugs su 'chang phyir bzang bo min/ /chos med chos pa'i gzugs kyis sa 'di khengs/ /zhes srog chen mang bo 'dus pas lhod pas ma reg pa ste sbyor ba dam pa'o/ /'di'i dpe brjod rtsa bar/ mā la tī dā ma lo ghi tai bhra ma riḥ (dzā ti'i me tog phreng /bung ba rnams kyis 'khor zhing ldang /) zhes pa'i nang du srog chen gyi yi ge gha dang bhra gnyis yod pa'i steng du yi ge lci ba mā/ tī/ dā/ lo/ tai/riḥ rnams tshogs pas sbyor batsho lci ba ste lhod pas ma reg pa'i dam par gyur pa'o/ /kha cig(bod mkhas)sbyar ba ni 'jam pa shas tshe la / 'jam ches pas lhod pa'i skyon med/ ces 'grel ba mi 'thad de shin tu gzhon pa dang khyad med par 'gyur ro/ / 33

gnyis pa rab dwangs la lho shar gnyis las/ dang bo ni/ grong ba'i nus zal 'jig rten grags don ldan/ /rab dwangs rgyan te lho ba'i mkhas rnams gsos/ /zhes gsungs te/ grong tshig gi nus pa bral ba ste des ma bslad par 'jig rten la grags pa shas che ba'i don dang ldan pa de rab dwangs kyi rgyan yin par lho ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyis gsal rgyas mdzad/ces pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ mtho zhing brjid chags shar ri'i rtse mo nas/ /sprin bral ston gyi nam mkha' dwangs pa la/ /dal gyis 'dzeg pa'i zla ba bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /mun pa'i gdung sel bsil ba'i dpal du shar/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /shar ba'i rab dwangs ni/ shar ba'i lngas tshig yod phyir grags mina'ang smyor/ /zhes gsungs te/ gau ḍa ba ni 'jig rten na shin tu grags che ba min yang nges tshig brjod rgyu yod pa tsam gyi phyir go dka' ba zhig la'ang 'dod/ces pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ ye shes me long ngos la mngon dga' ba/ /ngang ba'i bu mo'i mgrin pa'i rdza rnga yis/ /phul byung shis par bsgrubs pa'i yid mtsho las//sdeb legs tshig gi me tog mkha' la 'thor/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa mnyam pa la lho shar gnyis/ dang bo ni/ zed la srog chung 'jam dang zed la spog /che dang dzib ldan 'jam dzib mnyam pa'i phyir/ /mnyam pa'i rgyan de bee dar bha yi lugs/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshigs bcad gcig gi phyed la yi ge srog chung ste 'jam pa dang / phyed la yi ge srog chen 34

nam rtsub pa dang ldan pa ste 'jam rtsume do mnyam pa'i rgyan de ni bai dar bha'i 'dod pa'i mnyam pa'i rgyan yin/ zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu mi yi rol gar can/ /rgya'/ ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa yis/ /theg mchog mthar thug gsang chen dun rnyu bhi/ /brdung tshe mkhas rlom yongs kyi khengs pa 'phrog /ces pa lta bu/ shar ba'i mnyam pa ni/ gcig la spog che rkang ba gzhan gsum la/ /'jam ldan mi mnyam 'di 'dra shar bas smyor/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshigs bcad gcig gi rkang ba gcig la srog chen sbyor zhing / lhag ma rkang ba gzhan gsum la srog chung sbyar te 'jam pa dang ldan pa don la mi mnyam pa 'di 'dra ni shar bas mnyam pa la sbyor/ zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ kun gsal yangs pa'i do ra mdzes pa'i dpyid/ /'od dkar ga bur 'gyed pa kun da'i gnyen/ /tsha ba'i gdung 'phrog bsil ba'i mchog ster ba/ /lus can snying gi dga' ba gzugs can bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ / bzhi ba snyan pa la/ mtshan nyid/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang bo ni/tshig gi nyams che don yang nyams khyad can/ /mkha pa dga' byed snyan pa'i mtshan nyid 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ tshig gi nyams che bas yid 'gyur thub pa dang brjod bya don gyi dngos po la yang nyams khyad par can gnas pas tshig don gnyis ka'i cha nas/ mkhas pa rnams dga' bar byed nus pa'i 35

rgyan de ni snyan pa'i mtshan nyid du 'dod/ ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ sgra'i nyams/ don gyi nyams/ gnyis ka la grong tshig spang ba dang gsum/ dang bo la/ lho shar gnyis las/ lho ba ni/yig tshig gang la snga phyi'i gzugs dang gnas/ /phyi mo brtsegs mtshungs nyer gnas rjes khrid ldan/ /sgra yi nyams ldan snyan par lho ba bzhed/ /ces gsungs te/ sgra'i nyams kyi yi ge dang tshig gang dang ci la sbyar yang snga ma dang phyi ma'i gzugs dang gnas dang phyi mo dang / brtsegs pa'i tshig mtshungs shing nye bar gnas pas/ rjes khrid dang ldan pa de ni/ sgra'i nyams ldan gyi snyan par lho ba'i mkhas pa rnams bzhed do/ /zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ rgya che rgya mtsho ltar zab rgyal ba'i thugs/ /mkha' ltar yangs la nya rgyas zla ltar gsal/ /ma rmad phul byung spobs pa mi dpog pas/ /rnam kun rtogs pa'i stobs zhes rnam par bstod/ /ces rkang ba dang bo la ra la ga ya btags sbyar ba/ gnyis pa dbyangs gcig pa/ gsum pa skye gnas gcig pa/ bzhi ba brtsegs pa mtshungs pa'i rjes khrid do// gnyis pa shar ba'i 'dod pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/dang bo ni/ tshigs bcad rkang dang bcad lhug gnyis la yang / /tshig la dbyangs phi med kyang gsal byed gcig /yang yang bskor dang snga phyi cher mi ring / /rjes khrid sgra nyams snyan pa gi ḍa'i lugs/ /zhes gsubyas te/ tshigs bcad la ltos pa'i rkang ba rnams dang / bcad lhug gnyis ka la ltos nas 36

tshig rnams la dbyangs la nges pa med kyang / gsal byed kyi yi ge gcig yang yang bskor zhing / de yang snga phyi thag cher mi ring ba'i/ rjes khrid kyi nyams dang ldan pa de ni snyan pa shar phyogs pa'i lugs kyi sgra'i nyams yin/zhes pa'o//gnyis nga/ rgyas bshad la/ dbye ba dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis/dang bo ni/ dbye na rkang bar bskor dang tshig la bskor/ /ring thos shar ba kho na'i rjes khrid bzhi/ /zhes gsungs te/ sgra'i nyams de la/ rkang ba la bskor ba/ tshig la bskor ba/ ring bar thos pa/ shar ba kho na 'dod pa'i rjes khrid dang bzhi yod/ ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la/ dang bo rkang ba la bskor ba ni/ yi ge gcig sogs rkang ba'i thog lta bur/ /yang yang bskor bar rkang bar bskor ba ste/ /gsum par yi ge tshogs dgos mtha' rten sogs//gzugs gcig rkang ngasnga ma ji bzhin dgos/ /rjes khrid yig rkyang ba dang dbyangs nges med/ /mtha' rten sogs nges med pa'i khyad par gces/ /zhes gsungs te/ yi ge gcig pa'am yi ge gcig gis ming gzhi byas pa de/ sho lo ka de'i tshig rkang re'i thog ma lta bu la yang yang bskor ba de la rkang bar bskor ba zhes bya la/le'u gsum par zung ldan la yi ge'i tshogs pa 'dra dgos pas dbyangs dang sngon 'jug mtha' rten sogs gzugs gcig yin dgos pa dang /rkang ba snga ma'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang la yod na phyi mar yang ma 'chol ba zhig dgos la/ rjes khrid la yi ge rkyang ba yin min dang dbyangs 37

dang mtha' rten sogs la nges pa med pa'i khyad par gces dgos/ zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ mtha' yas gsung rab kun gyi snying bo'i don/ /mthar 'dzin nad kun sel ba'i sman gcig pu/ /mtha' bral zab mo rten cing 'brel 'byung lam/ /mthar gyis goms pas srid pa'i zug rngu gcod/ /ces tha yig bskor ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa tshig la bskor ba ni/ rkang ba rkang bar yi ge gzhan dang gzhan/ /ring min yang yang bskor ba tshig la bskor/ /zhes gsungs te/ sho lo ka gcig gi rkang ba dang rkang ba'i bar te tshig rkang re re'i nang du bskor rgyu'i yi ge mi 'dra ba gzhan dang gzhan yin la/rkang ba gcig gi nang du yi ge gcig bar thag ha cang ring bo min par yang yang bskor ba de ni tshig la bskor ba yin/ zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ bim pa'i tshal na bung ba'i na chung ma/ /snyan pa'i glu len sbrang rtsi'i snye mar rol /rab dga' rgyas pa'i ngo mtshar ri mo 'dis/ /srid pa'i bde la sred pa 'phel bar byed/ /ces rkang ba dang bor ba dang na bskor ba dang / gnyis par snya bskor ba dang / gsum par ra bskor ba/ bzhi bar sra bskor ba lta bu'o// gsum pa ring bar thos pa ni/ yi ge bskor ba'i bar du yi ge dag /dgu sogs mang bos chod gang ring bar bskor/ /zhes gsungs te/ yi ge bskor ba'i yi ge dag gi bar du yi ge dgu la sogs pa yi ge mang bos chod 38

pa gang yin pa de la ring bor bskor ba zer/ zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ ma lus mkhas pa'i snying la dpyid 'jo ba/ /dbyangs ldan ma khyod lhag pa'i lhar bsten na/ /brtse bas dgongs nas ma g.yel dus kun tu/ /'dzad med ngag gi dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /ces ma bskor ba'i bar du tsheg bar bcus chod pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi ba shar ba kho nas 'dod pa'i rjes khrid ni/ smyor ba chub mang brjod dka'i rjes su khrid/ /shar ba kho na'i 'dod de stod kyang smyor/ /rjes khrid de 'dra bee dar gha mi 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ tshig sbyor ba rtsub pa mang bo brjod dka' ba rjes khrid byas pa ni/ shar ba kho nas 'dod pa'i rjes khrid yin/ rtsub pa brjod dka' ba rjes khrid byas pa de bzhin du/lhod pa 'ba' zhig rjes khrid byas pa'ang shar bas sbyor la/ rjes khrid de 'dra ba lho bas mi 'dod ces pa yin la/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i dpe brjod kyi rgya dper/ sma raḥ kha raḥ kha laḥkān taḥkā yaḥko pashtsa naḥ kṛ shaḥphyed phyi ma tsu to mā no rnyi ko rā go mo ho dzā to sa po ga tāḥzhes phyed snga ma la rnam bcad mang bas sbyor ba rtsub par gyur pa dang phyed phyi ma o yig rjes khrid byas pas tsub pa'i ldog zla lhod pa sbyar ba'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/sgro bar las byung sgra dbyangs snyan sgrog cing / /sbrang rtsis sgregs pa'i bsung ldan bhra ma raḥ/ /'dab stong rtse na gar gyis rol pa la/ /ba mo'i reg pas gnod pa ma gyur tam/ /zhes rkang ba snga ma gnyis rtsub la/ phyi ma gnyis 39

lhod pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa don gyi nyams ni/ thun mong de min kun la don nyams gces/ /zhes gsungs te/ sgra'i nyams kyang snyan pa'i ro dang ldan mod/'on kyang thun mong ba'i rgyan dang de min thun mong ma— yin pa'i rgyan kun la don gyi nyams khyad par can de gtso che bas gces par zungs shig ces pa'o gsum pa gnyis ka la grong tshig spang ba— la/ don gyi grong ba spang ba/sgra'i grong ba spang ba gnyis/ deng bo ni/ glang rdzi sogs la grags don de'i ngag smras/ /grong ba'i don ldan skyon che de spong na/ /kun dang thun mong min pa'i tshig sbyor gyis/ /snyan ngag lam du men pa de yi zan/ /zhes gsungs te/glang rdzi sogs snyan ngag mi shes pa rnams la grags pa'i gtam bzhin du don de brjod pa'i ngag smras na/ grong tshig gi skyon dang ldan pas mi mdzes la/ skyon de spong 'dod na/ skye bo kun dang thun mong min pa'i legs pa'i tshig sbyor gyis snyan ngag gi lam lugs su blangs te smra ba ni skyon spong ba'i sman lta bu yin no//zhes pa'o/ /spang bya grong tshig dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ 'dod ldan snying du sdug pa'i bu mo khyod/ /mthong bas chags pa'i yid ni bzung bar dka'/ /mal stan bde bar 'o dang 'khyud pa yis/ /'khrig pa'i bde la spyod par mi byed dam/ /zhes pa lta bu/skyon de spong byed kyi nyams ni/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ me 40

tog mda' can srid las rgyal byed pa'i/ /ba dan lta bur dkar mdzes lus phra khyod/ /dga' ba'i grong khyer yangs por yid srubs kyi/ /dga' ston che la rol par mi byed dam/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ don snga ma dang 'dra mod/ grong tshig spangs te snyan ngag gi lam du drangs pa'o//gnyis pa sgra'i grong ba la/ dngos dang / dmigs bsal gnyis/ dang bo ni/ gcod mtshams log gam ming de thun mong ba'i/ /grong ba'i don ston sgra yi grong ba'ang skyon/ /zhes gsungs te/ sgra'i grong tshig zhugs tshul de yang /tshig gcod mtshams log pa'i dbang gis skyon zhugs pa dang / ngag tshig gcig la go bya'i don tha dad pa gnyis yod pa'i dbang gis ming de grong ba dang thun mong ba'i don ston par 'gyur ba'i sgra'i grong ba'ang skyon yin/zhes pa'o// gcod mtshams sam mtshams sbyor la skyon zhugs pa/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab rgyas rta ljang can/ /bsil zer ldan pa yis kyang mi phyed pa/ /cig car 'byed byed sgeg mo'i 'gram chang gis/ /'thor tshe ba ku la de rang dbang ci/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ rta ljang can dang / bsil zer ldan pa zla bas kyang mi 'byed ces pa yin mod/ gcod mtshams rta ljang can bsil zer ldan pa zhes go ba log 'gro ba dang /'gram chang gis phu btab nasatsang gi zil ba 'thor bar byas tshe/ zhes pa yin mod/ gcod mtshams log na/ 'dab ma 'thor tshe ba ku la de la rang 41

dbang ci yod ces par 'gyur bas skyon can du 'gyur ba'o/ /ngag tshig gis don la skyon zhugs pa ni/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ dmar ba'i bzhin ldan drag po'i dbugasa'abyin zhing / /pha rol lus la rdo rje'i gdengs ka yis/ /bsnun pa las skyes bzod dka'i zug rngu'i tshogs/ /kun rtog spros pa'i sde dngu lhan cig rgyas/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/lha dmar drag tu khros nas/ dgra bo la mtshon bsnun pa'i don yin mod/ngag tshig gi dbang gis 'khrig spyod la go 'gro bas/ 'di lta bu skyon can yin no// gnyis pa dmigs bsal ni/ming de gzhan la 'jug rung yin kyang der//skabs kyi de las 'osasmed grong min pa/ /dmigs bsal can yang 'dir khas mi len min/ /zhes gsungs te/ ming dang tshig de don gzhan pa la'ang 'jug rung yin kyang / skabs der de'i skabs kyi don de las 'os med pas grong ba'i skyon min pa'i dmigs bsal can yang snyan ngag gi skabs 'dir khas mi len pa min/ zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ chos la yid rton bu mo mtshan ldan ma/ /drin ldan pha ma'i 'dod pa sgrub byed cing / /'khor 'bangs tshogs la rjes su chags pa'i sems mi 'dor ya rabs ngang tshul mchog gis mdzes/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ tshig grogs kyi dbang gis mkha' 'gro'i mtshan ldan ma la go ba las mo mtshan dang ldan pa la mi go ba dang / snying rje'i sems la go ba las chags sems 42

la go tshul med do//lnga ba shin tu gzhon pa la/ lho shar gnyis las/ dang bo ni/ dzib min ma ge mang ba thin tu gzhon/ /thams cad gzhon pa stod pa'i skyon yin spangs/ /phyo ba'i lugs yin / /zhes gsungs te/ sho lo ka gcig po de'i nang du yi ge rtsub pa min pa 'jam pa mang shos yin pa de ni shin tu gzhon pa yin la/ thams cad gzhon pa ste 'jam pa yin na lhod pa'i skyon yin pas spangs dgos pa de lho ba'i lugs yin zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ pad dkar phreng bas mdzes pa'i skyed tshal na/ /ge sa ras myos bung ba'i na chung ma/ /sbrang rtsi'i snye ma 'chang zhing snyan 'gyur gyi/ /glu dbyangs len bzhin dal gyis rgyu bar byed/ /ces pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa shar ba'i lugs/ shaṛ ba'ang 'dod mod kyang / gtso bor brjod par dka' bas chub pa 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ shar phyogs pa dag skabs 'gar 'jam pa sbyor bar 'dod mod kyang / gtso bor brjod dka' ba'i tsub pa dag sbyor bar 'dod ces pa'o/ /brjod dka' ba dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ gtum drag rngam brjid gar gyis srid gsum khyon/ /'dar byed hūṃ sgra drag pos ri bo bsnyil/ /hrig hrig sdang mig g.yo bas dgra sde'i snying / /lkog mar 'bros byed khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ / ri drug pa don gsal la/ lho shar gnyis las/ dang bo ni/ don brtag 43

mi dgos rtogs nus don gsal mtshan/ gzhes gsungs te/ tshig gsal ba'i dbang gis/ don de gtan tshigs kyis brtag mi dgos par rtogs nus pa'i rgyan de don gsal gyi mtshan snyed yin/ zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ khyab 'jug yid kyi rol pa marka ras/rmo/chu mtshor bying ba'i sa chen 'degs pa na/ /rmig pa spu gris gdengs can tshogs kyi lus/ /bcad pa'i khrag gis chu gter dmar 'od 'dzin /yang na/ ma dros gdengs can bdag po'i mthu dpal las/ /'chi med rdzing ring ngos la sprin dkar gyi/ /bla re bres tshe sbra nga char 'bab mthong nas/ /char sdod bye'u dga' ba'i dbyangs kyis brel/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa shar ba 'ga'i 'dod pa ni/ shar ba kha cig sgra rigs lag 'gongs pa/ /smyor yang lho shar phal cher 'dir mthun 'jug /ces gsungs te// shar phyogs pa kha cig rjod byed mi gsal ba zhig la 'dod kyang de ni rjod byed kyi sgras ma zin cing rigs pas kyang sgrub rgyu med pas/ de gnyis ka las 'gongs pa ste 'das pa sbyor yang / lho shar gyi mkhas pa phal cher don gsal gyi 'dod tshul la mthun par 'jug go/ /zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ /dpe brjod de las/ yangs pa'i gser ldan ma 'di chu gter dbus/ /bying tshe 'jug pa bcu ba phag rgod kyi/ /rnam par rtsen pas gyen du btegs pa na/ /zla ba'i ma ma mtshams sprin mdangs kyis mdzes// 44

yang / 'jig rten skyong ba klu dbang tshogs kyi mthu/ /zhing ba'i bsod nams dpyid du smin pa las/ /mkha' dbyings chu 'dzin dra bas khebs pa na/ /tsa ta ka rnams dbyangs snyan glu ru len/ /zhes pa lta bu brjod bya snga ma dang gcig kyang / rjod byed kyi tshig sbyor mi gsal ba'i dbang gis go dka' ba'o/ / —bdun pa rgya che ba la/ lho shar gnyis las// dang bo ni/ tshig smyor gang du don 'ga' zhig brjod pas/ /de ldan khrad 'phags yon tan rtogs nus ngag /rgya che'i rgyan 'dod bee dar snyan ngag mgon/ /gnyis pa'i rgya che bsam 'byor gang rung las/ /brtsam dgos 'dir ni gang la sbyar kyang chog /ces gsungs te/ tshig sbyor gang du don 'ga' zhig dngos su brjod pa'i shugs la/ yul dngos po de dang ldan pa'i gang zag gi khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan rtogs nus pa'i ngag de rgya che ba'i rgyan yin par bee dar bha 'dod la/ bai dar bhas rgyen 'di snyan ngag kun gyi mgon te mchog yin par 'dod/ le'u gnyis pa'i skabs kyi rgya che ba'i rgyan de bsam pa dang 'byor ba gang rung las brtsam dgos mod/ skabs 'dir gang la sbyar kyang chog pa ni mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ro/ /zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjodade las/ mtshungs med 'dren pa nyin mor byed pa yi/ /zhabs skyes bkra shis rdul gyis gtsug mdzes tshe/ /gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis gang la 'ang / /snang ba gzhan la brten pa'i don ma mchis//yang / 'byor dang gtong ba zla med me long gdong / /gang la slong 45

ba'i skye bo de dag gi/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal lhag ma zad pa'i phyir/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa shar ba'i rgya che ba ni/ khrad par 'phags pa'i dpal brjod de'i shugs kyis/ /de ldan yon tan che rtogs nus pa'i ngag /rgya che'i rgyan du gi ḍa'i mkhas dag 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ bstod yul gyi khyad par du 'phags pa'i dpal gyi chos 'ga' zhig dngos su brjod pa de'i shugs kyis khyad chos de dag dang ldan pa'i yul de yon tan rgya chen po dang ldan pa rtogs nus pa'i snyan ngag de ni/ rgya che ba'i rgyan du shar phyogs gau ḍa ba'i mkhas pa dag gis 'dod/ ces pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ me tog 'khri shing rgyas/ pa'i dga' tshal na/ /rtsen pa'i na chungazhor bu'i 'og pag las/ /dpyangs pa'i dril chung sil sil 'khrol ba yis/ /drug skyes glu dbyangs snyan pa'i khengs pa 'phrog/ yang / rgyal phran stong gi zur phud gdengs ka yis/ /lan gcig min par gus pas bsten bya ba/ /sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba yis/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal khab che/ /zhes pa lta bu'o//brgyad pa brjid pa la/ spyi dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang bo ni/'dru mang la sogs tshig sdud mang sgrus ngag /bajid bar lugs gnyisaskyibazhed de bcad lhag gnyis/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'bru mang bo'i bsdu ba la sogs pa ka tsan dbyangs gsum gyi tshig sdud skabs nas byung ba'i tshig sdud mang bo yod pa de ni bajid pa yin par shar lho'i lugs gnyis kas bzhed la/ de 46

la bcad lhug gnyis ka yod/ ces pa'o gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la/ shar lho gnyis las/ dang bo ni/ prasgyu ra myi mang dang yang ba nyung / /phyed la de snog mtho dma'i rnam pa can/ /bajid par shar 'dod brjod dang gtam gyis spras/ /zhes gsungs te/ brjid pa de la prastu ra lci ba mang ba dang yang ba nyung ba dang / phyed la ste 'ga' la de las sdog ste lci ba nyung la yang ba mang ba spel bas mtho ba dang dma' ba'i rnam pa can te rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar 'khrugs shing / bsdu ba dang bcas pa ni brjid pa'i rgyan du shar ba dag 'dod la/ brjod pa dang gtam gyis spras shing sbyar ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/shāde gahūṃgs garūng rnob ra/ba 'dzums daṅka' garnod hūṃn/ /'askrel la tshul dzung rnom dajid zla/ dzul ba/ / /'adzdzags dzul smra/ darshang makṣas spob sdoge lergos dprel/ /'atrem dmeng mkhris pa/ ma/ hūṃs gahūṃg na/ masdis/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa lho ba'i 'dod pa ni/ brayā ra yi lci lang 'khrugs min par/ /mnyam pas marjes ldan tshig sdud bcas pa'i ngag /bajid pa'i ngo bor bee dar bha yis bzhed/ /snga ma tshigs bcad phyi ma lhug pa la/ /gartsor dgyes gnyis ka'i bcad lhag dag kyang 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ prastu ra lci yang 'khrugs pa min par do mnyam pas mdzes pa dang ldan pa tshig sdud rnams dngu bcas pa'i ngag de ni brjid pa'i ngo bor bee dar bhas bzhed/ snga ma shar ba rnams 47

gtso bor tshigs bcad la sbyar zhing / phyi ma lho ba rnams lhug pa la sbyar rgyur gtso bor dgyes shing / gnyis kas bcad lhug dag la sbyar bar 'dod/ ces pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ ji/ lta ji rnyed tstshas rnazlos ma hūṃs/ /thurgos su dzud pa/ hūṃl dṛ'i nyi ma/ /gro hūṃs ṅged rmi sgros byed sdi la/ /bhra/ ma rnoḥ yi/ dbyengs skyos ba|da do/ / yang / ku mu/ da rnyer daner dzñang gazlol la/ /mu/ ti ka bsnyin hūṃd rnob rephro ba/ / /ma rghaṃd rlong tstsha rnob dzus ma/ ma/ / /'asdid hūṃn dzñang la/ u prum wa/ ra/ /zhes pa lta bu/ prastu ra 'god tshul ni/ yi ge lci ba la ri mo 'khyog po dang / yi ge yang ba la ri mo drang bo 'bri la/ yi ge lci yang ni legs sbyar la sngar bshad pa ltar yin mod/ bod la lci yang gi tha snyad ma grags kyang / legs sbyar gyi rigs 'gre byas pa ni/ 'greng bu can dang / na ro can dang / mtha' rten can rnams lci ba dang / de las gzhan pa rnams yang ba yin pa sngon gyi mkhas pa dag gis bzhed/ des na gong gi dpe brjod rnams la sngar prastu ra'i ri mo med mod/ 'dir ngos zin sla ba'i ched du bdag gis bkod do//dgu ba mdzes ṅge'i yon tan la/ lho shar gnyis/ dang bo ni/ 'jig rten grags pa ma brgal 'ud mi che/ /mdzes pa'i ngo bor lho phyogs mkhas mang bzhed/ /sngon byung gtam dang bsngags sogs de brjod gzhi/ /zhes gsungs 48

te/ mdzes pa ni 'jig rten na grags pa'i don las mi brgal bar 'ud mi che bas/ mi dag gi blor shong ba de mdzes pa'i yon tan gyi ngo boryān par lho phyogs kyi mkhas pa mang bos bzhed la/ desnal sngon byung gi gtam rgyud brjod gzhi byas pa dang / yon tan la bsngags brjod sogs brjod gzhi byas pa yod/ ces pa'o/ /sngon byung gtam la sbyar ba/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ sprin dkar dal gyis g.yo 'dra'i sa srung steng / /'chi med bdag po'i lag nyal rdo rje yis/ /sbyin skyes g.yul ngo bzlog par mdzad pa na/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i grags snyan ldir//yang / blo bzang rgyal ba'i gsung gi mdzod phye ste/ /bstan pa'i gnad kun rdzogs par gsal ba yis/ /mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di yang / /dbus 'gyur zhes byaru grags pa don dang ldan/ /zhes pa lta bu/bsngags pa la sbyar ba/ yang de las/ mu tig 'khri shing yang dag rgyu ba bzhin/ /'dod ldan skye bo dga' byed dga' ma yis/ /zur mig 'od zhags spro ba'i rtse mo ni/ /rna lung phon po'i bar du rdzogs ma gyur/ /ces pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa shar ba'i 'dod pa/ 'jig rten grags pa las brgal 'ud chen pos/ /brjod 'dod blo yi/sa don gang phul byung bkod/ /mdzes pa'o gi ḍa ba tshim lho mi bzhed/ /'di yang gtam dang bsngags sogs dag las smyor/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'jig rten du yongs su grags pa las brgal te 'ud chen pos brjod 'dod kyi blos brjod bya'i don gang yin pa de phul du byung 49

bar bkod pa de shin tu mjes pa'o zhes shar phyogs gi ḍa ba rnams ni tshim par gyur la/ lho phyogs pa rnams ni gtso cher mi bzhed do/ /'di ba yang sngon byung gi gtam dang / yon tan bsngags pa sogs te de dag las snyan ngag sbyor bar byed/ ces pa yin la/ shar ba'i gtam la sbyar ba/dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ kai la sha ri'i dpal 'dzin gnyis 'thu nga gi/ /steng 'gying grags pa'i mu khyud rtse brgya yis/ /lhun po nyung dkar gnas la 'god byedan/ /nyams chung lha min bcom pa mtshar du ci//yang / 'jam mgon bla ma'i legs bshad 'od stong gis/ /mdo rgyud pad tshal rgyas pa'i gangs ljongs 'dir/ /'og min zhes byar grags pa'i rnga bo che/ /brdung ba des kyang bsgrun du ga la yod/ /ces dang /bsngags pa la sbyar ba/ sred ldan snying la kun dga' gsar ba'i ro/ /sbyin byed lang tsho ma yi zur mig gi/ /dkyus ring yid srubs 'phrul gyi nyag phran de/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mthar yang rdzogs ma gyur/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ / bcu ba ting nge 'dzin la/ spyi dang / dbye ba/ dogs slong gsum/ dang bo ni/ sems ldan gzhan gyi chos de sems med kyi/ /gzhan la 'jig rten lugs kyi rjes 'brang bkod/ /gang du sgra de yang dag 'dzin ldan ngag /ting nge 'dzin du sto phyogs mkhas mang bzhed/ /ces gsungs te/ sems ldan gyi chos gzhan zhig gi khyad chos de/ sems med kyi chos gzhan dag la/ 'jig rten 50

lugs kyi rjes su 'brangs te bkod nas/ tshig sbyor gang du rjod byed kyi sgra de yang dag par 'dzin par byed pa dang ldan pa de ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan du lho phyogs mkhas mang dag gis bzhed ces pa yin la/ dper na/dpe brjod de las/ dbang phyogs sa 'dzin rtse nas 'od stong can/ /dgyes pa'i rang zhal ngom tshe padmo rnams/ /dga' ba'i ge sar so phreng dgod pa na/ /phrag dog ldan pa'i ku mud zum par gyur/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ chos gcig bkod pa dang / chos du ma bkod pa gnyis las/ dang bo ni/ gzhan lang gcig dang du ma bkod pa gnyis/ /dngos bstan sems ldan skyug sogs bsgrib bya gcig /sgrib byed sems med la bkod btags pa ba'i/ /skyug sogs sgra de 'dzin ldan snyan ngag tshig /chos gcig bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin du bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ri chos gcig dang du ma bkod pa gnyis yod pa'i dang bo ni/ dngos bstan la bud med kyis chang 'thung nas bzi ste skyug pa de dngos su dmar bshad byas na mi mdzes pas bsgrib bya byas te/ sgrib byed nyi mas 'od zer skyugs pa rnams padmas bag med du 'thung nas ge sar gyi rdul dmar bo skyug par byed ces rtsa ba'i dpe brjod du bkod pa lta bu sems med la bkod nas/ btags pa ba'i skyug pa sogs lta bu'i sgra de 'dzin pa dang ldan pa'i snyan tshig de ni/skyug pa lta bu'i chos gcig bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan du bshad/ces pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ 'gram chang zegs mas bskyangs pa'i ba ku la/ /dga' zhing chags pas rab tu dgod pa na/ /rkang 51

gdub kyis bsnun mya ngan med pa yang / /khrel ba'i yid kyis cung zad dgod par byed// ri yang / mi bzang dgun gyi grang reg rgyas pa na/ /nyal 'gro ma rnams chab rom gur du mnal/ /khor yug mdzes byed ri bo'i phreng ba yang / /kha ba'i gur khang phug tu gnyid la yur/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa chos du ma bkod pa ni/ dngos bstan sems ldan nyal sogs du ma'i chos/ /sems med gzhan la bkab nas nyal ba sogs/ /du ma'i chos btags sgra de 'dzin pa'i ngag /du ma'i chos bkod ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan/ /zhes gsungs te/ dngos bstan sems ldan bud med mngal ldan ma grogs mo 'ga' zhig gi pang bar nyal ba sogs kyi chos du ma sems med gzhan sprin gyi phreng ba sogs la bkab nas nyal ba sogs du ma'i chos btags pa ba de'i sgra de 'dzin par byed pa'i ngag de ni chos du ma bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan yin/ zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ 'od stong chu lha'i pang bar mnal ba na/ /skar ma'i do shal legs bgos sngo bsang mar/ /dus btab zla ba gzhon nus bgrod pa'i tshe/ /skyengs ldan sprin gyis sgrib g.yogs ci yang byed/ /yang / nyin byed lho yi lam du bros gyur cing / /sa 'dzin kha ba'i thor tshugs bcings pa na/ /rtsi shing tshogs rnams shugs ring 'byin byed cing / /na chulnge nyal 'gro ma rnams sbubs su bros/ /zhes pa lta bu'o//gsum pa dogs slong ni/ 'di la dngos bstan lugs gnyis so so ru/ /52

mi gsal 'on kyang khyad par med 'dod na/ /thun mong rgyan 'gyur des na lam bcu bo/ /gartso bor stor bzhed 'ga' zhig thun mong chos/ /phal cher bablog dgos kun la min pa 'am/ /ting 'dzin dang bo stor lugs phyi ma rganyis/ /shar gyi bya 'am brtags par bya dgos nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ ting 'dzin gyi skabs 'dir rtsa ba'i dngos bstan la/ lho shar gyi lugs gnyis so sor mi gsal/ 'on kyang so sor mi gsal yang khyad par med do zhes 'dod na/ting 'dzin gyi rgyan 'di shar lho thun mong gi rgyan du 'gyur ro/ /des na shar lho thun mong ma yin pa'i lam bcu bo 'di/ gtso bor lho bas bzhed pa dang / 'ga' zhig thun mong ba yin pa dang / phal cher bzlog dgos pa las/ kun la lho shar gnyis bzlog dgos pa min zer ba'am/ yang na ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan/ dang bo lho phyogs pa'i lugs yin pa dang / phyi ma gnyis shar phyogs pa'i 'dod pa yin par bya'am/ gang yin brtags dgos pa nyid do/ /zhes pa'o//gsum pa snyan ngag gi rgyu bshad pa ni/ khrad par snyan ngag 'byung khungs mang thos dang / /skyes thob spobs mchog yin no tshe sngon gyi/ /bag chags dman kyang ngas/ dang ngag gi lha/ /thos dang skub bas 'bad na rjes bzung nas/ /mkhas mang go sa mthon po dag la lang / /bde blag nges 'god nag mo'i khol bo bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byung khungs te rgyu ni/ shes bya'i gnas mang du thos pa dang / skyes thob kyi spobs ba ste shes rab ni/ snyan ngag la mkhas pa'i rgyu'i mchog yin no/ /tshe rabs sngon 53
