zhar byung / 'di dag zung gi la nyid bskor bya mis/ /zung nyid skor tshe ma chod chod sogs 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ bar chod kyi zung ldan 'di dag gi zung gi ya de nyid bskor bya byas nas/ ya de yis zung nyid bskor ba ste ya de nyid mu mthud du gnyis brjod tshe/ bar ma chod la chod pa sogs kyi rgyan du 'gyur/ zhes pa ste/ 'di ni 'phro 'dir 'chad 'gyur gyi dpe brjod rnams kyis shes so//gsum pa chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan la/ spyi dang / dbye ba/ /don bsdu gsum las/ dang bo ni/ gang la ma chod zung gnyis bskyor ba'i bar/ /yi ge mang bos bcad ba ma chod chod/ /dngos su gsum gsungs dbye ba gzhan yang yod/ /ces gsungs te/ tshigs su bcad pa gang la bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gnyis bskor ba'i bar du yi ge mang borme bcad pa de la4 bar ma chod la chod pa'i zung ldan zer zhing / rdzo de la rtsa ba las dngos su dbye ba gsum gsungs la/ dbye ba gzhan yang yod pas rig pas dbye ba spros chogaces pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la gesum las dang bo ni/ ma chod zung gnyis snga phyi so sor bskor/ /byed zedabyu'adra ba'i ma chod chod pa'i zung / /zhes gsungs te/ma chod pa'i zung gnyis snga phyi so so ste bar du yi ges bcad pa bskor zhing /phyed snga ma rkang ba dang bo gnyis 'dra ba dang / phyed phyi ma rkang ba phyi ma gnyis 'dra bar bskor ba de la bar ma chod cing chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan zer/ zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ zab zab man ngag 242

gnad du grags pa can/ /zab zab gter gyi rgya yis bcings rnams las/ pe /mang mang rim byon mkhas pas bsten pa yi/ /mang mngagazhung lugs chen mo de dag zab/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin thog mtha' rigs gcig gzhan gnyis gcig /0chod chod pa'i snga mtha' bar 'dra can/ /zhes gsum̐ngs te/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis rigs gcig la gzhan bar ba gnyis rigs gcig pa de ni ma chod cing tstshad rbe'i zung lda—na gyi thog mtha' gnyis dang bar ba gnyis larī 'dra ba'i zung ldan zer/ zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ chil chil g.yo ba'i rlabs phreng dang 'grogs te/ /ling ling zlos gar bsgyur ba'i ngang rme rnams/ /ling ling 'phur zhing lding ba'i gshog rtse yis/ /chil chil lbu ba'i me tog mkha' lta 'thor/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ ma chod zung ldan gcig nyid thog bzhir bzlas/ /chod cing ma chod 'byung ba'i thog ma 'dra/ /zhes gsungs te/ ma chod pa'i zung ldan gcig po rkang ba bzhi'i thog ma bzhir bzlas pas chod cing ma chod pa — 'byung ba'i thog ma bzhi 'dra ba de ni/ /bzhi ga 'dra —ba'i chod la ma chod pa'i zung ldan yin/ zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ chem chem rol mo'i brda yis spyan 'dren na/ /chem chem sa gsum g.yo ba'i gom stabs kyis/ /chem chem myur du byon la dgra bgegs kun/ /chem chem thal bar rlogs shig sa ma yaḥ / /zhes pa lta bu/ 243

gsum pe de'i don bsdu ba ni/ bya bla rkang ba'i thog mar zung ldan gyi/ /gsal byed rnam rtog sa bon grung bo gang / 'khrul zal gshin sar btab pa'i snyan ngag gi/ /tshig smyor smin pa'i snye ma galur du za/ /zhes sgra rgyan las bya sla ba'i zung ldan gyi rab tu byed pa ste ༈ shu ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ bya sla ba rkang ba'i thog mar bkod pa'i zung ldan gyi rnam gzhag gsal bar byed pa'i rnam par rtog pā de nyid sa bon gyi gzugs su bkod de sa bon grung bo ste sa bon bzang bo de ni/ 'khrul ba dang bral ba'i rtsom pa bo gang gi thugs kyi sa gshis gshin po'i zhing sar btab pa las byung ba'i / snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i nywa gu smin pa'i snye ma g.yur du za'o/ /zhes gzhung 'di nyid snye ma'i gzugs su bkod pa sogs kyi gzugs can gyi rgyan yin la/ lhag ma go sla'o/tsho/ gnyis pa bya dka' ba gnas gzhan la yod pa'i zung ldan la shis brjod sogs dang / gzhung dngos la 'jug pa gnyis/ dang bo la tshigs su bcad pa gsum yod pa'i dang bo ni/ rab zab zab rgyas sku mnga' mnga' bdag lha/ /lha mchog mchog gi gsung dbang dbang phyug ma/ /ma bzhin bzhin 'dzum lha'i rje rje btsun yum/ /yum mchog mchog gi snyan ngag ngag 'dir stsol/ /ces gsungs te/ rab rkyo zab pa'i chos kyi sku dang zab cing rgyas pa ste rgya che ba'i gzugs kyi sku mnga' zhing / yon tan thams cad kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur pa'i lha/ lha mchog kun gyi mchog gi gsungari dbyangs la dbang ba ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ ma bzhin du zhal ras kyi bzhin 'dzum 244

pa'i lha'i rje rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i yum/ yum mchog dbyangs can mas mchog gi snyan ngag ste gsung dbyangs bla na med pa'i ngag gi dngos grub stsol cig /ces chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan gyis spras te dngos grub zhus pa'o//tshigs bcad gnyis pa ni/ dkar dkasdo zla 'od ma zan lha khrod tshems dkar dkar/ /'dzum 'dzum 'gro la rgyu med brtse ba'i bzhin 'dzum 'dzum/ /snyan snyan rgyud du bathung min drug ldan dbyangs snyan snyan/ /lhag lhag sgra rgyan bya dka' thogs med spyol lhag rtsag /ces gsungs te/ dkar ba las kyang ches dkar ba'i zla ba'i 'od kyi khu bas ma bran par lha khyod kyi tshems ni dkar zhing shin tu dkar ro/ /rgyun du zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu 'dzum pa dang ldan zhing 'gro ba mtha' dag la phan gdags pa sogs kyi rgyu med par ris med du brtse ba'i rang mdangs bzhin 'dzum pa las kyang lhag par 'dzum pa/snyan zhingarab tu snyan pa'i pi wang gi rgyud du brdung ba min par yan lag drug ldan gyi dbyangs snyan zhing rab tu snyan pa/ lhug lhug tu 'byung ba'i sgra rgyan gyi nang gi bya dka' ba'i rgyan rnams thogs pa med par stsol ba'i dngos grub lhugañtsāg tu 'byung bar byed pa'i lha mchog dbyangs can ma/dzha zhes ma chod cing chod pa'i sgra rgyan dang / yongs grags kyi rgyu bkag nas nang gi rgyu cung zad dang bcas pas 'bras bu ston pa'i srid pa can gyi don rgyan 'dres pa'i sgo nas lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sku dang gsung dang 'phrin las la bstod pa'o/ / rme sgyu ༷ tsho — 245

tshigs bcad gsum pa ni/ gter bzhin rnam dbye rnam mang zung ldan dag /ma spros rab bsdus rab tu byas te las/ /gnas gzhan la ldan zung ldan bya dka' dang / /mtha' thog zung byas zung ldan rnam gnyis dbye/ /zhes gsungs te/ sa'i rdul dang chu bo'i gter bzhin du rnam grangs dbyeb byas3 rnam par mang ba ste ha cang mang ba'iwung ldan dag gi dbye ba mang bor ma spros par/ rab rtsabasdus nas rab tu mchog tu gyur par byas te/de dag las gnas gzhan la ldan pa'i bya dka' ba'i rgyan dang mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan gyi rnam pa gnyis dbye bar bya zhes dbus na yod pa'i bar chod zung ldan gyis brgyan te rtsom par dam bcas pa'o / gnyis pa gzhung dngos la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyiso/ dang bo ni/ rkang bzhi'i dbus sogs gang du zung gnyis dag /ci rigs bskor ba gnasarnagazhan bya dka'i rgyan/ /dbye ba rkang bzhi'i dbus dang mtha' na dang / /bar mtha' gnyis dang thog bar mtshe ma dang / /thog mtha' mig dang gnas me lamed drug /re je'ang gnyis gye nyi ma'i grangs su 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang ba bzhi ga'i dbus sogs te bar mtha' ci rigs su yi ge 'dus pa bskor ba de la gnas gzhan la yod pa'i bya dka' ba'i zung rgyan zhes bya la/ de la dbye na/ rkang bzhi'i dbus na yod pa/ mtha' na yod pa/ bar mtha' gnyis na yod pa/ thog bar mtshe ma ste gnyis na yod pa/ thog mtha' mig ste gnyis na yod pa/ gnas me ste gnas gsum ga la yod pa dang drug drug po de re re la'ang chod cing ma 246

chod pa dang chod pa kho na gnyis re phye bas nyi ma'i grangs te bcu gnyis su 'gyur/ zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la drug las/ dang bo rkang bzhi'i dbus na yod pa gnyis kyi/ dang bo chod cing ma chod pa ni/ dbus bzhir zung gcig bzhir bzlas ma chod chod/ /cesagasungs te/ rkang ba bzhi ga'i dbus bzhi la bskor bya zung gcig bzlas pa ni ma chod cing chod pa yin/ zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ bde gshegs gsung rab rab 'byams dka' gnad kun/ /'byed pa'i mkhyen rab rab rgyas tsong kha ba/ /gang gi gsung rab rab gsal 'od snang gis/ /dri med shes rab rab rgyas dga' ston thob/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa chod pa kho na ni/ ya brgyad chod par dbus bkod chod cing chod/ /ces gsungs te/ bskor bya ya brgyad po de tshig gzhan gyis bar chod par byas te/ rkang ba re re'i dbus su gnyis re bzlas pa de chod pa kho na yin/ zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ ngo mtshar kun dga' kun nas rgyas pa'i dpyid/ /khor yug kun khyab kun bzang mdzad pa'i rlabs/ /lus can kun la kun dga' spro ba'i gnyen/ /'dren mchog kun la kun nas phyag bgyid do/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa mtha' na yod pa gnyis sdi dang bo chod pa ni/ mtha' bzhir rje bzhi bkod pa chod cing chod/ /ces gsungs te/ rkang ba bzhi'i mtha' 247

bzhi la bskor bya ya bzhi bkod pa de ni mtha' na yod pa'i chod pa'i zung rgyan yin/ zhes pta yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ kye ma rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal ba dkon/ /mjal kyang thos bsam tshul bzhin byed pa dkon/ /tshig tsam thos kyang nyams len byed pa dkon/ /sgrub la zhugs kyang mtha' ru 'khyol ba dkon/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa chod la ma chod pa ni/ de bzhin zung bzlas chod cing ma chod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ snga ma de bzhin du bzhi ga'i mtha' ru bskor bya zung bzlas pa de ni mtha' na yod pa'i chod la ma chod pa'i zung rgyan yin/zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ sdang mig khong las spros pa'i me 'ur 'ur/ /dri 'dzin lam du 'khruspu pa'i rlung 'ur 'ur/ /zhal nas drag sngags nga ro'i gdangs 'ur 'ur/ /stangs stabs gar gyis rol pa'i sgra 'ur 'ur/ /zhes pa lta bu/gsum pa bar mtha' gnyis na yod pa gnyis kyi dang bo ni/ bar dang mtha' ru la bzlas chod cing chod/ /ces gsungs te/ rkang ba'i bar dang mtha' ru bskor bya ya bzlas pa ni bar mtha' gnyis na yod pa'i chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan yin/ zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpejibarjod de las/rnam gsal mar me'i 'od kyis rang khyim gsal/ /'od gsal rta ljang can gyis 'jig rten gsal/ /zabyā gsal ting nge 'dzin gyis dmigs rten gsal/ /dkar gsal dbyangs kyi rgyal mos bdag yid gsal/ /zhes pa lta 248

bu/gnyis pa chod cing ma chod pa ni/ de bzhin ma chod zung bkod ma chod chod/ /ce sa gsungs te/ snga ma de bzhin du bar mtha' gnyis la bskor bya ma chod pa zung ste gnyis bkod pa de ni ma chod cing chod pa'i bar mtha' gnyis na yod pa'i zung rgyan yin/ zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ dbyangs can gsung snyan snyan pa'i dbyangs snyan snyan/ /gdub 'khrol— sil snyan snyan pa'i sgra snyan snyan/ /rgyud mang skad snyan snyan pa'i gdangs snyan snyan/ /chos kyi gtam snyan snyan sgrog grags snyan snyan/ /zhes pa lta bu/bzhi ba thog bar gnyis na yod pa gnyis kyi dang bo ni/ thog dang b.racedu ya bkod chod cing chod/ /ces gsungs te/ rkang ba re re'i thog ma dang bar du bskor bya ya bkod pa ni thog bar gnyis na yod pa'i bar du chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan yin/ zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/rnam dkar legs byas rnam brgyas bskrun pa'i sku/ /rnam mang legs bshad lkernam par sgrog pa'i gsung / /rnam pa thams cad rnam kun gzigs pa'i thugs/ /rnam 'dren dam pa rnams la snying nas 'dud/ /ces pa lta bu/gnyis pa chod cing ma chod pa ni/ gang la mi mnyam mtshe ma'i thog mtha' (byas/ /mnyam pa 'khrig pa'i thog bar zung bskor ba/ /de 'dra'i rkang ba spel byas ma chod chod/ /ces gsungs te/ rkang ba mi mnyam pa mtshe ma ste dang bo 249

dang gsum pa gnyis kyi thog mtha' dang / mnyam pa 'khrig pa ste gnyis pa dang / bzhi ba gnyis kyi thog bar du bskor bya zung bskor ba lta bu de 'dra'i rkang ba spel mar byas pa nyid la ma chod cing chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan zer/ zhes pa yin la/ ('di la dpe cha dpar mar mnyam dang mi mnyam pa'i thad yig nor 'dug pa bcos so/ /) dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ mtshar mtshar srid pa'i bde 'byor ngo mtshar mtshar mtshar mtshar skad cig yal ba'i mtshar mtshar bo/ /mtshar mtshar da dung sgrub la yid mtshar mtshar/ /mtshar mtshar byed pa 'di 'dra mtshar mtshar snyam/ /zhes pa lta bu/lnga ba thog mtha' gnyis na yod pa gnyis kyi dang bo chod pa ni/ thog mthar lang yang la bzlas chod cing chod/ /ces gsungs te/ rkang ba bzhi ga'i thog ma dang tha mar yang dang yang bskor bya ya bzlas pa de ni thog mtha' gnyis na yod pa'i chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan yin/ zhes pa yin la/dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ snyan 'gyur rol mo'i khrod na rgyud mang snyan/ /snyan pa'i hūṃ la dri za'i mgur dbyangs snyan/ /snyan tshig gzhung la danḍi'i legs bshad snyan/ /snyan pa kun las rgyal ba'i grags pa snyan/ /zhes pa lta bu/ tre —gnyis pa chod cing ma chod pa ni/ der gnas zung bzlas chod cing ma chod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ der gnas te gong du bshad pa ltar/ rkang ba 250

bzhi ga'i thog mthar bskor bya zung bzlas pa de chod ning ma chod pa'i zung rgyan yin zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ /gsal gsal nyi ma'i 'od kyis kun gsal gsal/ /gsal gsal lha yi mdun sar snang gsal gsal/ /gsal gsal me long ngos na gzugs gsal gsal/ /gsal gsal yid mtshor dbyangs can dkar gsal gsal/ /zhes pa lta bu/drug pa gnas gsum ga la yod pa gnyis kyi dang bo chod pa ni/ rkang ba'i thog mtha' dbus gsum ya bzlas chod/ /ces gsungs te/ rkang ba bzhi ga'i thog mtha' bar gsum du bskor bya ya bzlas pa de gnas gsum gar yod pa'i chod pa'i zung ldan yin/ zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ mdzes pa'i zhal khyim mdzes sdug lan bus mdzes/ /mdzes pa'i thor tshugs mdzes byed tog gis mdzes/ /mdzes sdug rgyan phreng mdzes par bstar bas mdzes/ /mdzes pa kun bsdus mdzes ldan lha mo mdzes/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa chod la ma chod pa ni/ de gsum zung du bzlas pa ma chod chod/ /ces gsungs te/ gong du bshad pa'i gnas de gsum du bskor bya zung du bzlas pa de gnas gsum du yod pa'i ma chod cing— chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan yin/ zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ ldem ldem pad dkar ldem ldem 'dar ba dang 'grogs rlabs phreng sngo ldem ldem/ /ldem ldem ngang mo ldem ldem g.yo zhing 'phur lding rol pa'i gar ldem 251

ldem/ /ldem ldem gom 'gros ldem ldem dal gyis rgyu ba'i gnyis 'thung lhod ldem ldem/ /ldem ldem rkyal zhing ldem ldem rtsen pa'i na chung bde ba'i 'gying ldem ldem/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ / gsum pa mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan la/ dngos dang / thun mong du mjug bsdu ba gnyis/ dang bo ni/ gang gi rkang ba'i mtha' thog zung de'i ya/ /bkod pa bsgrig pa'i zung du 'ong ba gang / /mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan rgyan du bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ tshigs bcad gang gi rkang ba snga ma'i mtha' dang / phyi ma'i thog ma gnyis kar bskor bya'i ya re bkod pa bsgrig pa'i zung du 'ong ba gang yin pa de ni mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan du bshad/ ces pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis grags pa'i ba dan mchog /mchog tu mdzes pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul/ /yul gru phal ba gzhan gyi do zla min/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ dam dam rdo rje bzhin dka' dka' gnas dag /dag dag dbyod la blo tshim tshim byed 'di/ /'di 'di kho na zhes 'dod 'dod de la/ /la la 'khrul phyir mkhas 'dod 'dod pa tsam/ /zhes sgra rgyan las bya dka' dang mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan gyi rab ngu byed pa ste nyer gcig pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ dam pa las kyang ches dam pa'i rdo rje bzhin du gcod dka' ba'i dka' ba'i gnas 'di dag dag cing yang dag pa'i blo yis dpyod par byed pa la blo tshim par byed pa'i tshim byed kyi man ngag ni 252

gzhung 'di yin la/ 'di dang 'di kho na yin no zhes rang 'dod kyis 'grel ba'i 'dod pa de dag la nges pa med de/ la la ni 'khrul ba'i phyir mkhas pa'i grags pa 'dod kyang 'dod pa tsam las 'bras bu med do/ /zhes pa yin la/ lhag ma go sla'o/ /bzhi ba kun tu zung ldan la/ klad kyi don dang / gzhung gi don gnyis/dang bo la shis par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis/ dang bo ni/ gang gi mkhyen rab bdud rtsi'i 'od zeng tshogs/ /'dab ldan 'khor lo snying la brgyar bran pas/ /de'i mgrin snyan tshig sngon med ku mu da'i/ /g.yo ldan phreng mjes mdzod cig mtsho ldan ma/ /zhes gsungs te/ lha gang gi mkhyen rab de bdud rtsi'i 'od phreng ste zla ba'i 'od zer gyi gzugs su bkod nas/bdud rtsi'i zer phreng des/ 'dab ma brgyad dong ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i snying kha 'dir lan brgya phrag tu bran pas/ bran yul de'i mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i snyan tshig gi sngon med pa'i me tog ku mu da'i phreng tshogs mdzes par mdzod cig sgra dbyangs lha mo mtsho ldan ma/ zhes gong du gang zhes spyi'i tshul du smras pa bye brag mtsho ldan ma zhes spyi las dmigs su bzung ba'o/ /gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ kun dang 'dres dang ldog pa'i zung ldan dag /gcig tu mkhas rnams rol pa'i phul min zhing / /snyan 'jebs phul byung ro dang ldan min yang / /rnam grangs mkhas pas bshadade cung zad dbye/ /zhes gsungs te/ zung ldan bzhi ba kun tu zung ldan dang 253

lnga baho'adres pa'i zung ldan drug pa ldog pa'i zung ldan 'di dag mtha' gcig tu mkhas pa rnams dga' bas rol pa'i gnas phul du byung ba zhig min zhing / snyan zhing 'jebs la phul du byung ba'i ro dang ldan pa zhig kyang min mod/ 'on kyang rig pa'i sgo 'phel ba dang rnam grangs 'byed pa la mkhas pa'i ched du/ 'di dag gi rnam grangs mkhas pa snga mas bshad pa de dag cung zad dbye bar bya/ zhes pa'o/ / gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang bo ni/ tshigs su bcad dang de gyed rkang ba dag /ci rigs bzlas pa kyan ngu zung dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs te/ bzhi ba kun tu zung ldan 'di la/ tshigs su bcad pa bzlas pa dang / de'i phyed de tshigs bcad kyi phyed rkang ba dag ci rigs par bzlas pa sogs kun tu zung ldan yin/ zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ rkang ba bzlas pa la/ phyed bzlas yang dag sbyor ba dang / gzhan rkang ba bzlas pa gnyis las/ dang bo ni/phyed dang zed du bzlas pa lang dag sbyar/ /gsum yod / /ces gsungs te/tshigs bcad kyi phyed rkang ba gnyis 'dra bar bzlas pa dang lhag ma phyed kyi rkang ba gnyis 'dra bar bzlas pa yang dag par sbyar ba yin la/ de la dbye na gsum yod ces pa'o dbye ba gsum gyi dang bo ni/ zla rtser bzlas dang mig 'byung bzlas/ /zhes gsungs te/ zla ba ste dang bo dang rtse mo ste gsum pa bzlas pa 254

dang mig ste gnyis pa dang 'byung ba ste bzhi ba bzlas pa ni/ dper na/dpe brjod de las/ dkar gsal(zla ba)dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa yis/ /mi bzad('dod ldan)snying gi gdung ba sel bar byed/ /dkar gsal(dbyangs can ma)dkyil 'alta'iri yongs su rdzogs pa yis mi bzad(blo ldan)snying gi gdung ba sel bar byed/ /ces pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ bse ru 'khrig par me ni rig byed bzlas/ /zhes gsungs te/ bse ru ste dang bo dang 'khrig pa ste gnyis pa bzlas pa dang me ste gsum pa dang rig byed de bzhi ba bzlas pa ni/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ mdzes shing yid 'ong ngang ba'i(ngang mo)bu mo dkar/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong ngang ba'i(dbyangs can ma)bu mo dkar/ /snyan 'gyur mgrin rnga sgrog pas kun dgar byed/ /snyan 'gyur mgrin rnga sgrog pas kun dgar byed/ /ces pa lta bu/('di la dpar mar gong 'og nor 'dug)gsum pa ni/ gzugs ni mtsho ru mig ni me ru bzlas/ /zhes gsungs te/gzugs te dang bo dang mtsho ste bzhi ba bzlas pa dang mig ste gnyis pa dang me ste gsum pa bzlas pa ni/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ mkha' la dal gyis rgyu bar byed/ /rab dkar mdangs ldan(ngang ba'i rgyal bo)gnyis skyes rgyal/ /rab dkar mdangs ldan(zla ba)gnyis skyes rgyal/ /mkha' la dal gyis rgyu bar byed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /'di'i gsal bshad ni/ yang dag sbyar 'dir rkang bzhi'i zung dang zung /255

bzla dgos ced dam gsum sogs bzlas tsam min/ /zhes gsungs te/ rkang ba gnyisarī yang dag par sbyar ba'i rkang ba bzlas pa 'dir rkang ba bzhi'i zung dang zung ste gnyis gnyis bzla ba ste skor dgos kyi/ tshigs bcad kyi phyed tsam zhig bzlas pa dang rkang ba gsum tsam zhig bzla ba min/ zhes pa'o lke gzhan rkang ba bzlas pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang bo ni/ rkang ba tsam zhig bzlas pa de yi zung / /de ni gcig gnyis gsum du bzlas rnams so/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshig rkang tsam zhig bzlas pa de'i zung rgyan de ni/ lan gcig bzlas pa/ lan gnyis bzlas pa/ lan gsum bzlas pa rnams so/ /zhes pa'o/ / gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ dang bo lan gcig bzlas pa la drug yod pa ni/ gzugs ni mig bzlas gzugs ni rtse mor bzlas/ /gzugs ni bzhir bzlas mig ni rtse mor bzlas/ /mig ni bzhir bzlas me ni chu bor bzlas/ /de dag gcig bzlas rnam dbye drug tu bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ dang bo gzugs dang mig bzlas pa ni/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ thub bstan gangs ri skyong ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /thub bstan gangs ri skyong ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /'jam mgon bla ma blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ /sras kyi thu bo mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa gzugs ni rtse mor bzlas pa ni/ dpe brjod de las/256

mtha' bral lam bzang ji bzhin gsal mdzad pa/ /'phags mchog klu sgrub smra ba bla na med/ /mtha' bral lam bzang ji bzhin gsal mdzad pa/ /'jam mgon bla ma gangs can bstan pa'i bdag /ces pa lta bu/gsum pa gzugs ni bzhi bar bzlus pa ni/ dpe brjod de las/rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang mdzod 'dzin/ /mthu stobs dbang thophyug bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag /mi brjed gzungs thob gnas brtan dku dga' bo yang / /rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang mdzod 'dzin/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi ba mig ni rtse mor bzlas pa ni/ dpe brjod de las/ rgyal kun yab gcig rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul/ /'dzad med ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i lha/ /'dzad med ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i lha//rgyal yum dbyangs kyi dbang phyug dga' mar dgyes/ /zhes pa lta bu/lnga ba mig ni bzhi bar bzlas pa ni/ dpe brjod de las/ sna tshogs sprul ba'i rol pa pha mtha' yas/ /gdul bya'i mos pa ji bzhin cir yang 'char/ /de bzhin gsung gcig nyid du gsungs pa yang / /gdul bya'i mos pa ji bzhin cir yang 'char/ /zhes pa lta bu/drug pa me ni chu bor bzlas pa ni/ dpe brjod de — pres // bla ma mgon po gnyis su sa mchis par/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /las nyon bar chad ma lus bsal du gsol/ /las nyon bar chad ma 257

lus bsal du gsol/ /zhes pa lta thu ste/ de dag ni lan gcig bzlas pa'i dbye ba drug tu bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa lan gnyis bzlas pa la gsum yod pa ni/ bse ru lag pa 'jig rten dag tu bzlas/ /zla ba rtse mo chu bo nyid du bzlas/ /mtshe ma yon tan mtsho ru bzlas dang gsum/ /rkang ba gnyis bzlas dbye ba dag tu 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ bse ru sogs kyi don/ dang bo gnyis pa gsum pa rnams bzlas pa ni/ dpe brjod de las/ deng nas byang chub bar du skyabs mdzod cig /deng nas byang chub bar du skyabs mdzod cig /deng nas byang chub bar du skyabs mdzod cig /skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa dkon mchog gsum/ /zhes pa lta bu/ zla ba sogs kyi don/ dang bo gsum pa bzhi ba rnams bzlas pa ni/dpe brjod de las/ rnam par dkar zhing rab mdzes kun dga'i dpyid/ /pad dkar ji bzhin zla dang dbyangs can ma/ /rnam par dkar zhing rab mdzes kun dga'i dpyid/ /rnam par dkar zhing rab mdzes kun dga'i dpyid/ /ces pa lta bu/ rmomatshe ma sogs kyi don/ gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi ba rnams bzlas pa ni/dpe brjod de las/ mgon khyod yi dam chos srung mkha' 'gro ru/ /bsten no de bzhin bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig /bsten no de bzhinā bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig /bsten no de bzhin bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig /ces 258 —

pa lta bu ste/ de dag ni rkang ba lan gnyis bzlas pa'i dbye ba dag tu rmedod/ gsungs so/ /gsum pa lan gsum bzlas pa ni/ rkang ba zhi gzugs gcig de ni gsum bzlas yin/ /'di la rkang bar zung med dgos pa nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ rkang ba bzhi bo de gzugs sgra gcig 'byung ba de ni rkang ba lan gsum bzlas pa yin pa 'di la rkang bar zung de rkang ba re'i nang du bskor bya bskor ba med dgos te/ zung ldan chen po dang khyad par yod dgos/ zhes pa yin 'i/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ dbang mchog de yis gong du smin par byed/ /dbang mchog de yis gong du smin par byed/ /dbang mchog de yis gong du smin par byed/ /dbang muchog de yis gong du smin par byed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ / tshigs bcad bzlas pa ni/ tshigs bcad gang zhig mig tu bkod byas dag /tshigs bcad bzlas pa'o dbye ba 'dir ma bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ rīritshigs su bcad pa gang zhig lan gnyis su bkod pa ni tshigs bcad bzlas pa yin la 'di la dbye ba rtsa ba me long ma'i gzhung 'dir ma bshad/ces pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ sngon bsags(yon tan)bsod nams dge ba'i mthu las byung / /sde bzhi'i phun tshogs sgrub pa'i gzhi dang rten/ /skye bo rnams yid mngon par dga' byed cing / /gang la ldan pa de yi don rnams 'grub/ /sngon bsags(nor)bsod nams dge 259

ba'i mthu las byung / /sde bzhi'i phun tshogs sgrub pa'i gzhi dang rten/ /skye bo rnams yid mngon par dga' byed cing / /gang la ldan pa de yi don rnams 'grub//ces pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa zung ldan chen mo la/ dngos dang / khyad par bshad pa gnyis/ dang bo ni/ rkang bzhir zung ldan rnam pa gcig byas ngag /zung ldan chen por bshad de / /zhes gsungs te/ rkang ba bzhi gar zung ldan gyi rnam pa gcig byas pa'i ngag de ni/ zung ldan chen po yin par bshad de/zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung (dpag bsam shing)dgos 'dod kun 'byung(nor bu)/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung(smon lam)dgos 'dod kun 'byung(byang chub kyi sems)/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byungahūṃsangs rgyas)dgos 'dod kun 'byung(chos)/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung(dge 'dun)dgos 'dod kun 'byung(bla ma)/ /yang na/ chags pa med pa(rten byang sems)chags pa med(longasu spyod la)/ /chags pa med pa(phyi bshol)chags pa(chog 'dzin)med/ /chags pa med(lan)pa chags pa(rnam smin)med/ /chags pa med(rnam rtog)pa chags pa(rnam g.yeng)med/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa khyad par ni/ der bzlas lhag /med do 'di dang rkang ba gsum bablas pa'i/ /rnam dbye smra la ljags ring skyong mkhas pa//smras pa 'di la rkang ba re re yang / /zung ldan yin no rkang ba gsum bzlas la/ /rkang bar chung med gces pa'i khrad par sems/ /zhes gsungs te/ rkang ba lan gsum 260

bzlas pader bzlas pa las lhag pa zung ldan chen po 'dir med do zhe na/zung ldan chen po 'di dang rkang ba gsum bzlas pa'i rnam par dbye ba smra ba la ljags ring bor rkyong bar mkhas pa bdag gis 'di ltar smras pa yin te/ zung ldan chen po 'di la rkang ba re re la yang zung ldan byas pa yin te/rkang ba gcig gi nang bskor bya gcig lan gnyis su bskor ba yin la/rkang ba gsum bzlas pa la rkang ba re rer zung med pa ste tshig rkang gcig gi nang bskor bya gcig lan gnyis bzlas pa med pa ni gces paradzo'adzin dgos pa'i khyad par yin par sems/ zhes pa'o/ /lnga ba 'dres pa'i zung ldan ni/ thog mtha' sbyar dang dbus bkod zung rnams gzugs/ /mi gcig mi gcig spel ba 'dres par bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ thog mtha' sbyar ba'i zung ldan dang rkang dbus su bkod pa'i zung ldan rnams/ gzugs mi gcig pa la yang de dang mi gcig pa zhig spel ba de 'dres pa'i zung ldan yin par bshad/ ces pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ e ma ngag la ngag gi dpal ster ma/ /ma khyod 'grig 'grig tshig gi sbyor ba kun/ /kun dgar 'jo bas longs spyod 'khor lo mchog /mchog tu grub pa'i dga' ston grub par mdzod/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ / drug pa bzlog pa'i zung ldan la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ thun mong du mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang bo ni/ tshigs bcad de gyed rkang ba 261

ci rigs pa/ /lugs las bsgrog byas zung ldan lugs las bablog /rkang bablog phyed bzlog rdigs bcad bzlog ba gsum/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshigs bcad dang tshigs bcad de phyed dang rkang ba ci rigs pa lugs 'byung las lugs bzlog byas pa de la zung ldan lugs bzlog zer zhing / de la dbye na/rkang ba bzlog pa/ tshigs bcad phyed bzlog pa/ tshigs bcad bzlog pa gsum yod/ ces pa'o/ /dang bo rkang bzlog ni/ rkang ba snga ma lugs bzlog las bkod pa/ /rkang ba bzlog ste / /zhes gsungs te/ rkang ba phyi ma'i skabs rkang ba snga ma lugs bzlog byas pa las bkod pa de ni rkang ba bzlog pa yin/ /zhes pa ste/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ rgyal sras rgyal ba dam pa 'dren mchog mkhas/ /mkhas mchog 'dren pa dam pa rgyal sras rgyal/ /lha yi lha mchog skyabs mgon 'gro 'dren rnams/ /rnam 'dren 'gro mgon skyabs mchog lha snga yi lha/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa phyed bzlog ni/ de bzhin tshigs bcad zed/ /lugs las bzlog byas tshigs bcad phyed pa bzlog /ces gsungs te/ snga ma de bzhin du tshigs bcad kyi phyed phyi ma de phyed snga ma las lugs bzlog byas pa de tshigs bcad phyed bzlog yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ dkar zhing mdzes ldan dbyangs mchog lha mo skeg /gzugs mdzes rab bkra rnam mang rgyan sdug mtshar/ /mtshar sdug rgyan mang rnam bkra rab 262

mdzes gzugs/ /sgeg mo lha mchog dbyangs ldan mdzos shing dkar/ /zhes pa lta bu/ ci rigasum pa tshigs bcad rangs por bzlog pa ni/ tshigs bcad snga ma bzlog nas gnyis pa ru/ /bkod pa de 'dra tshigs bcad bzlog par 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ tshigs bcad gnyis yod pa'i snga ma go bzlog nas tshigs bcad gnyis pa ru bkod pa de ni tshigs bcad bzlog pa yin par 'dod/ces pa ste/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ mchog gyur dpal ldan dge legs bde ster muchog /mchog brnyes grub dbang smra la mkhas shing btsun/ /btsun zhing dul ba spyod tshul tshangs ldan mdzes/ /mdzes ldan khrims dag rnam kun skyon bral brjod/ /brjod bral skyon kun rnam dag khrims ldan mdzes/ /mdzes ldan tshangs tshul spyod pa dul zhing btsun/ / btsun zhing mkhas la smra dbang grub brnyes mchog /mchog ster bde legs dge ldan dpal gyur mchog /ces pa lta bu'o// gsum pa thun mong du mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar kun gyi longs smyod 'khor lo la/ /rtag par gnas kyang myang dka'i zung ldan gyi/ /dka' gnas nyung ngus rjen par ston byed mkhan/ /dbyangs can mgrin 'khyud dakhyi yin bar nges/ /zhes sgra rgyan las kun rtu zung ldan sogs kyi rab ngu byed ba ste nyer gnyis pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar skye bo kun gyi mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo la rtag par gnas kyang / ngo bo myang dka'u ba ste shes dka' ba'i zung ldan gyi dka' gnas rnams/ nyung ngu mdor bsdus pa'i tshig gis 263

gsal rjen du ston par byed mkhan 'di ni/ dbyangs can mas mgrin par 'khyud pa'i slob dpon danḍi yin par nges so/ /zhes pa yin la/ lhag ma go sla'o// bya dka' ba'i khyad par gzhan bstan pa/gnyis pa bya dka' ba'i khyad par gzhan bstan pa la/ shis brjod dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba/ gzhung dngos gsum/ dang bo ni/ mgrin mtshor ldem ldem 'dab brgya la bzhugs nas/ /lham mer bdud rtsi'i 'od dang snyan pa'i ngag /mi 'chi'i gsos thabs smra ston lha khrod kyis/ /ro 'dzin che mngar zang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan mdzod/ /ces gsungs te/ bdag gi mgrin pa'i pad mtshor ldem ldem du g.yo ba'i 'dab ma brgya phrag tu rgyas pa'i pad gdan la bzhugs nas/ lham mer gsal zhing bdud rtsi'i 'od shes rab kyi dngos grub dang rab tu snyan pa'i snyan ngag gi dngos grub ste thun mong gi dngos grub dang / mchog gi dngos grub gtan du mi 'chi ba'i bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang thob byed kyi lam 'chi gsos kyi sman lta bu sogs thabs tshul sna tshogs smra zhing ston pa'i lha mchog mtsho ldan ma khyod kyis/bdag cag gi ro 'dzin te ljags 'di ni ches mngar ba'i snyan ngag gi ro bcud dang ldan pa'i sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan te padma'i dga' tshal du mdzod cig /ces pa'o/ /264

gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ bya dka' ba lang gcin dang 'khor can dag /dbyangs sogs yi ne nges ba'i bya dka' rnams/ /ji bzhin 'khrul ba'i mun brtsom legs bshad cha/ /yongs rdzogs blo gsal kun da'i gnyen de rjo/ /zhes gsungs te/ bya dka' ba la yang ba lang gcin dang /phyed 'khor kun 'khor dag dang / dbyangs sogs yi ge nges pa'i bya dka' ba rnams yod pa man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du 'khrul ba'i mun tshogs bcom nas legs par bshad pa'i cha yongs su rdzogs pa blo gsal zhing don du gnyer ba'i ku mu da dag gi gnyen zla ba'i 'od zer de spro bar bya/zhes pa'o/ / cigasum pa gzhung dngos la/ ba lang gcin/ phyed 'khor/ kun 'khor gsum las/ dang bo ni/ gang zhig zed kyi tha ge bkod pa rnams/ /gcig gis bar chod dkyus dang 'og ma nas/ /'phar te klog pa'i gzugs gcig bya dka'i gcin/ /steng 'og dang bo gnyis gcig de rjes min/ /gsum pa gnyis gcig bzhi ba gnyis min sogs/ /'og ma'i mi gcig gong ma gong ma'i spel/ /ba lang 'gro ba'i gcin bzhin bkod zir gcin/ /zhes gsung te/ tshigs bca5 gang zhig gi phyed de tshig rkang gnyis kyi tshig rkang snga ma'i yi ge rnams steng dang phyi ma'i yi ge rnams 'og tu re'u mig tu bkod pa rnams/steng 'og gi yi ge dang bo gnyis 'dra ba dang de'i 'phror mi 'dra ba gcig gis bar du chod pa rim par yod pa rnams dkyus su klog pa dang 'og ma nas 'phar te klog pa'i gzugs gcig 'byeng ba de la bya dka' ba'i ba 265

'di'i gru bzhi'i gru nas dbus su 'khor ba dang g.yas su 'khor ba'i kun 'khor yang mkhas pas byas pa'ang yod/ 'di skor thams cad mkhyen pa nges pa don gyi rgyal ba'i dbang bo'i tog lnga ba chen mo ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs su gang gi bka' lung dang dpe brjod ya mtshan pa mang du gnang ba ngo mtshar ba'i phreng ba dag tshar du dngar bas der blta bar bya/ zhes pa'o/ /dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' ba/gsum pa dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' ba la/ spyir bstan pa dang bye brag so sor bshad pa dang mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang bo ni/dbyangs gnas yi ge ci rigs nges pa gang / /dbyangs la sogs pa nges pa'ibya dka' 'dod/ /de gsum bzhi sogs dka' dang lnga sogs sla/ /dbye ba dbyangs nges gnas nges yi ge nges/ /gsum ste re re'ang bzhi sogag bzhi bzhi 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ dbyangs nges pa gnas nges pa yi ge nges pa sogs ci rigs nges can byas pa gang yin pa de la/ dbyangs la sogs pa nges pa'i bya dka' ba zhes 'dod pa dang / de gsum ga la bzhir nges pa gsum du nges pa gnyis su nges pa gcig tu nges pa rnams ni bya dka' ba dang lnga la sogs pa ste lnga phan chod ni bya sla ba yin la/ dbye ba ni dbyangs nges pa dang / gnas nges pa dang / yi ge nges pa dang gsum yod la/ de gsum re 269

re la'ang bzhi bzhi ste bcu gnyis yod par 'dod/ ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag so sor bshad pa la gsum las/ dang bo dbyangs nges pa ni/ /dbyangs mag bzhi sogs nges byas dbyangs nges te/ /zhes gsungs te/ dbyangs yig bzhi dang gsum dang gnyis dang gcig tu nges par byas pa de la dbyangs nges pa'i bya dka' ba zer/ zhes pa yin la/dbyangs ni/ legs sbyar skad kyi dbang du byas na/ ka lā ba las/ bcu bzhi rnams dbyangs so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ a ā/ i smi/ u u/ ṛ rī/ lo lī/ e i/ o au/ rnams yin la/ bod skad kyi dbang du byas na/ rtsa ba sum cu ba las/ ā li gsal byed i sogs bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/dbyangs bzhi ni/ gug gu/ zhabs kyu/ 'greng bu/ rna ru/ bzhi las med mod/'dir bod kyi dbyangs nges kyi dpe brjod 'jog tshe/ dbyangs bzhi bo gang yang med pa'i yi ge dang ming tshig la/ 'phags yul gyi a srog zhugs kyi tshab byas te/ dbyangs a gcig pur nges pa zhes dpe brjod snga ma dag gis bzhag pa ltar bya dka' ba'i skabs de ltar byas chog go/ /dbyangs nges bzhi'i dang bo ni/ rkang bzhi'i re rer a sogs dbyangs re rṣa/ /nges pa can gang dbyangs mag bzhir ṅgā 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/tshigs bcad kyi rkang ba re re la a dang sogs sgras bsdus pa dbyangs gang rung re res nges pa can du byas pa de ni dbyangs yig bzhir nges pa'i bya dka' ba'i rgyan du 'dod/ ces pa yin la/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/270

gang la rab dang ldan pa mtha' dag la/ /blo gros dngos po mchog stsol 'khor lo'i mgon/ /dge legs gter chen spel byed ye shes che/ /phul byung lhun grub dus gsum kun tu 'jug /ces pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ a sogs gsum gyis rkang ba yon tan byas/ /bzhi bar de gsum spel ba gsum nges dang / /zhes gsungs te/ rtsa ba'i dpe brjod ltar/a sogs dbyangs bcu bzhi bo gang rung gsum gyis rkang ba yon tan te gsum gyi srog byas shing / rkang ba bzhi bar dbyangs de gsum ga spel ba ni dbyangs gsum nges pa'i bya dka' ba'i rgyan yin/ zhes pa yin la/ sgra sor yang ba'i dbang du btang na dbyangs gsum yod pa'i tha snyad tsam gyis chog ste/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ dkar gsal cha shas rab gang dbyangs can zhal/ /mi shigs snying dkyil ting 'dzin pir gyis bris/ /rnam pa thams cad bzlas pa la 'bad na/ /bden zhen sreg byed ye shes me chen spel/ /zhes pa lta bu'o// gsum pa ni/ phyed la yo dang phyed la a lta bu'i/ /nges byas de 'dra dbyangs yig gnyis su nges/ /zhes pa ste/ tshigs bcad phyed la o yig dang phyed la a yig sbyar ba lta bu'i nges par byas pa de 'dra ba ni dbyangs yig gnyis su nges pa'i bya dka' ba yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ yang dag lta ba gsal bar mdzad pa la/ /phul byung (jo bo rje)klu sgrub gzhung kun thugs su chud/ /ngag la dbang mdzad 'jam dbyangs bla ma 271

gang / /mun 'khrul drung phyung tshul lugs zur du bzung / /zhes pa lta bu/bzhi ba ni/ dbyangs mag gcig gis rkang ba bzhir nges pa/ /de ni dbyangs yig gcig ngu nges par bshad/ /ces pa ste/ dbyangs yig gcig gis rkang ba bzhir nges par byas pa de ni dbyangs yig gcig tu nges pa'i bya dka' ba'i rgyan yin zhes pa ste/ dper na/ dpe brjod de las/ rtag chad mtha' las 'das pa yang dag lam/ /yang yang bsam pas lta ngan rang sar 'gag /gnad rnams mtha' dag lam lam shar ba na/ /dga' dang dad pas rab gang a la la/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ / ('di yan gyi dpe brjod mtshungs pa gsal byed dang / yon tan brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed/ rdzas brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed kyi dpe brjod bdag gis bsnan pa las/ gzhan tshang ma gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs rje dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod las drangs pa'o ) gnyis pa gnas nges pa la/ spyir bstan dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang bo ni/ mgrin rkan lce rtse so mchu sbyi bo rnams/ /ci rigs skye gnas nges de gnas nges so/ /zhes gsungs te/ skye gnas mgrin pa/ rkan/ lce rtse/so/ mchu/ spyi bo rnams ci rigs kyi skye gnas nges can byas pa de la gnas nges pa zer zhes pa yin la/ yi ge'i skye gnas ngos 'dzin tshul ni/ legs sbyar gyi dbang du byas na/ tsan dra ba'i yi ge'i mdor/ a ku ha ṅka rnam par 272

bcad pa rnams kyis mgrin pa'o/ /ri ṭu ra ṣa rnams kyis spyi bo'o/ /lo tu la sa rnams kyis so'o/ /i tsu ya sha rnams kyis rkan no/ /u pu wa hpha mchu dang nye ba can rnam kyis mchu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ge rnams skye gnas lngas bsdus par bshad la/ ku zhes pas/ ka kha ga gha nga ste ka sde go dgos pa bzhin du/ ṭu tu tsu pu rnams kyis rang rang gi sde ba go dgos pa shes par bya'o/ /bod skad kyi dbang du byas na/ kā li sum cu tham pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsal byed sum cu las/ ka kha ga nga ha a 'a rnams ni mgrin pa las byung ba dang / ca cha ja nya zha sha ya rnams rkan las byung ba dang / ta tha da na la rnams so las byung ba dang / pa pha ba ma wa rnams mchu las byung ba dang / tsa tsha dza zwa sa rnams ni so dang rkan las byung ba dang / ra ni spyi bo las byung bar bshad/ 'di dag gi byed pa dam lhod sogs bdag gis blo gsal dga' ston du bshad yod pas der blta bar bya'o/ /gong du drangs pa'i tsan dra ba'i lung ltar na/legs sbyar la/ mgrin pa/ spyi bo/ so/ rkan/ mchu lnga las med mod/ gzhung 'dir/ mgrin rkan lce rtse so mchu spyi bo rnams/ /zhes lce rtse yang byung yod pas/ de ltar na/ ta tha da na la rnams kyi byed pa ni/ lce'i rtse mo'i byed pas skyed pa dang / tsa tsha dza zha sha rnams lce'i rtse mo dang mchog tu nye bar bshad pas/ de dag la dgongs nas/ 'dir gnas nges pa'i skabs su drug tu bsdus nas gsung bar mngon/ de ltar byas tshe/ ta tha da na la rnams ni so 273

dang lce rtse las byung ba zhes gnas gcig tu bsdu ba dang / tsa tsha dza zha sha rnams ni rkan dang lce rtse las byung bar byas te/ gnas drug byas chog snyam mo/ /lce'i rtsa ba dang lce'i sked kyi byed pas skyed pa yang yod mod/ lce rtse ltar gtso mi che bas ma bgrangs par mngon no/ / gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la bzhi las/ dang bo skye gnas bzhir nges pa ni/ sngar spuzhin skye gnas bzhi mas rkang ba rnams/ /so sor nges byas gnas bzhir nges bar 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ sngar dbyangs nges pa'i skabs bzhin skye gnas bzhi yis rkang ba bzhi so sor nges par byas pa ni gnas bzhir nges pa yin par 'dod/ ces pa ste/ dper na/ gnas mgrin so mchu rkan bzhir nges pa/ khong gis bkas mngags gang bkod ngas/ /da lta 'di nas lag tu len/ /pha mtha' bral ba'i pha ma la/ /sha zhen zhe sa yang yang zhu/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa gnas gsum du nges pa ni/ skye gnas gsum gyis gsum dang bzhi ba spel/ /gnas gsum nges par 'dod de / /zhes gsungs te/ skye gnas gsum gyi yi ges/ rkang ba gsum la nges shing bzhi ba la'ang de gsum spel ba de gnas gsum du nges pa yin par 'dod/ ces pa yin la/dper na/ gnas mchu mgrin lce rtse gsum du nges pa/ padma spungs pa'i pad phung spor/ /gur khyim 'od kor 'khyil dkyil a/ /mdzes shing mdzes la 'tsher zhing 'tsher/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer med dngos/ /zhes pa lta bu/274

gsum pa gnas gnyis su nges pa ni/ de bzhin du/ /rkye gnas gnyis kyis sgyed zed nges byas pa/ /gnas gnyis nges so / /zhes gsungs te/ snga ma de bzhin du yi ge skye gnas gnyis re res sho lo ka phyed phyed nges par byas pa de skye gnas gnyis su nges pa yin/ zhes pa ste/dper na/ gnas mgrin mchu gnyis su nges pa/ ha ha sgrog mkhas khro rgyal mgon/ /mgrin sngon sgrol mkhas mkha' 'gro'i mgon/ /'phags ma'i sprul ba dpal ma mos/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i sprul ba spros/ /zhes pa lta bu/bzhi ba gnas gcig tu nges pa ni/ skye gnas gcig pa yis/ /rkang rnams nges par byas de gnas gabyug nges/ /zhes gsungs te/ skye gnas gcig gis/ tshigs rkang rnams la nges par byas pa de ni gnas gcig tu nges pa/ zhes bya ste/ dper na/ gnas lce rtse gcig pur nges pa bde gshegs thub de'i bstan de la/ /gtan 'dun don du zhe nas brtsi/ /brtsi stangs tshad med 'dzin de la/ /zhi bde'i legs thob tshad las 'das/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa gsal byed kyi yi ge nges pa la spyir bstan pa dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang bo ni/ ka sogs bzhi sogs nges byas yi ge nges / /zhes gsungs te/ ka la sogs pa'i gsal byed bzhi dang sogs sgras bsdus pa gsum dang gnyis dang gcig tu nges par byas pa rnams ni yi ge nges pa yin/ /zhes pa'o// 275

gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang bo bzhir nges pa ni/ 'bab ldan yi ges rim bzhin rkang ba rnams/ /nges par byas gang yi ge bzhi ru nges/ /zhes gsungs te/ yi ge 'bab ldan te yi ge bzhis rim bzhin du rkang ba bzhi bo nges par byas pa gang yin pa de ni yi ge nges pa yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ la la lung lung le lor lus/ /kha kha kha kher kha 'khob 'khum/ /gyong gyong gum gum gyog gyog gyos/ /de dag de der dur dur 'dus/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa gsum du nges pa ni/ yi ge me yis rkang ba gsum dang bzhi/ /nges byas de ni yi ge yon tan nges/ /zhes gsungs te/ yi ge me ste yi ge gsum gyis rkang ba gsum dang bzhi ba la yang nges par byas pa de yi ge gsum du nges pa yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ci'aphral 'phral 'phrul 'phel phying phrug 'phel/ /pha phyug phyugs phrug phyogs phyogs 'phel/ /mi dmangs mang mang ma smad rmad/ /dga' dga' gus gus glu sgra sgrogs/ /zhes pa lta bu/gsum pa gnyis su nges pa ni/ yi ge mtshe mas rkang ba nges byas gang / /yi ge gnyis su nges par mkhas pas bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ yi ge mtshe ma ste yi ge gnyis kyis rkang ba rnams nges par byas pa gang yin pa de yi ge gnyis su nges pa yin par mkhas pas bshad/ ces pa ste/ dper na/btsurā brtse brtson rtsod rtsom gtsigs gtsi/ /btsan gtse btson btsogs rtsub bcir btsog /tshwa tshong tshod tshong tshos tshil tshong / /tshong tshogs tshab tshub 'tshangs tshad tshegs/ /zhes pa lta bu/276

bzhi ba gcig tu nges pa ni/ yi ge bse rus rkang rnams lngas byas pa/ /de 'dra yi ge gcig tu nges pa can/ /zhes gsungs te/ yi ge bse ru ste yi ge gcig gis rkang ba rnams nges par byas pa de 'dra ba de yi ge gcig tu nges pa can yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ zha zha zhum zhum zhabs zhu zhu/ ‘/zhwa bzhin zhu zhing zhim zhim zhu/ /bzhed gzhung zhu zhes zhi zhing zhu/ /gzhung bzhin zhu zhing zhib zhib zhu/ /zhes pa lta bu'o// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ 'bad kyang rnam daphyod yul du 'gyur dka' de dag kyang / /khams gsum rnam 'dren nyid kyi zhal lung dri med la/ /brten nas 'khrul ba bral ba'i ngag tsam smra ba'i phyir/ /'jam dbyangs bzhad rdor daṇi me long la bzhin zhugs/ /zhes sgra rgyan las bya dka' gzhan sogs kyi rab ngu byed pa ste nyer gsum pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'bad brtson byas kyang rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyi yul du 'gyur dka' ba'i rgyan de dag kyang / khams gsum rnam 'dren kun gzigs lnga ba chen po nyid kyi zhal lung dri ma med pa dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs la brten nas 'khrul ba bral ba'i ngag tsam smra ba la zhugs pa'i phyir/ bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje slob dpon danḍi snyan ngag me longartsom pa la zhugs pa bzhin du gyur to/ /zhes pa yin la/ lhag ma go sla'o//gab tshig gi rgyan bshad pa/thun mong gi rgyan gyi sa bcad gsum pa gab tshig gi rgyan bshad pa la/277

mchod par brjod pa/ rtsom par dam bca' ba/ mdor bstan pa/ dbye ba so sor bshad pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang lnga/ dang bo ni/ rnam med lhan skyes brjod bral chos dbyings dang / /ngo bo gcig gyur thugs rje'i zlos gar las/ /ma zhes lha mo'i sgyu 'phrul skur bstan kye/ /dbyod ldan smra la skal ba mchog deng tsul/ /ces gsungs te/ gnyis snang gi rnam pa med pa'i lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i ye shes te/ smra bsam brjod bral gyi chos dbyings dang / ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i thugs snying rje chen po'i zlos gar las ye shes kyi lha mo'i skur bstan pa lha mo dbyangs can ma kye/ zhes thugs rgyud bskul nas/rnam dpyod dang ldan pa dag snyan ngag smra ba la skal ba mchog gi dngos grub deng skabs 'dir stsol cig /ces pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ gang yang chu bo dag gis rgya mtsho bzhin/ /ngoms zal mkhas rnams rtsed dgyes ched sogs dang / /mkhas rlom stong bar sbos rnams 'jusnyeba'i sman/ /gab tshig nye bar mkho de lang dag 'chad/ /ces gsungs te/gang yang chu bo dag rgyun du 'bab pas mi ngoms pa'i rgya mtsho chen po bzhin du/ yon tan gyis ngoms pa dang bral ba'i mkhas pa rnams rtsed mo sogs kyi mdun sar bzhad gad dang dgyes pa'i ched sogs dang /mkhas par rlom yang yon tan gyis stong bar gyur pa nga rgyal gyis sbos pa rnams kyi khengs pa 'ju ba'i sman la gab tshig nye bar mkho bas de yang dag par 'chad par bya/ zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa mdor bstan pa ni/ dpe dang cha sogs tsam min bsgrib bya 278

gang / /sgrib byed tshig smyor lhar len khrad par gyis /gab par byas de gab pa'i tshig gi rgyan/ /yang dag 'chad 'dod ltar snang bcu bzhi bor/ /kun rtu tshogs dang slu byed rim bral dang / /rab bcom mthun gzugs rdzab go dang ni grangs/ /ྈba btags ming 'dus sgrib dang mthun pa'i sgra/ /rmongs dang yongs su 'phrog dang gcig sgrib dang / /gnyis ka sgrib dang yongs su 'dres bcu drug /ceri ṭa gsungs te/ dpe dang cha sogs tsam gyis bsgrib bya sgrib pa min par/ bsgrib bya gang yin pa de sgrib byed tshig gi sbyor tshul lhur len pa'i khyad par gyis bsgrib bya gab par bya ba de la gab tstshag gi rgyan zer/ gab tshig ngan pa bcu bzhi bo sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis brjod mod/ rtsa ba me long mar yang dag pa kho na 'chad par 'dod nas ltar snang bcu bzhi bor ba ste dor ba yin la/ yang dag pa'i gab tshig bcu drug ni/ kun tu tshogs pa'i gab tshig slu byed kyi gab tshig rim pa dang bral ba'i gab tshigarab bcom gyi gab tshig mthun gzugs kyi gab tshig rtsub rme'i gab tshigagrangs kyi gab tshig rab btags kyi gab tshig ming du 'dus pa'i gab tshigasgrib pa'i gab tshig mthun pa'i sgra'i gab tshig rmongs pa'i gab tshigayongs 'phrog gi gab tshig gcig sgrib kyi gab tshig gnyis ka sgrib pa'i gab tshig yongs 'dres kyi gab tshig dang bcu drug go/ /zhes pa'o//bzhi ba dbye ba so sor bshad pa las/ dang bo kun tu tshogs pa'i gab tshig ni/ rnam dbye mtsharmes sbyor la sogs tshig gi mtshams/ /sbyar bas sgra 'dres don sbas kun tu tshogs/ /zhes gsungs te/ rnam dbye dang mtshams 279

sbyor sogs kyis tshig gi mtshams sbyar bas sgra 'dres te don sbas pa ni kun tu tshogs pa'i gab tshig yin/ zhes —pa lta bu'o/ /dper na/ bris legs snyan tshig bu mo rab mdzes ma/ /lags par gzhan gyi sems la dga' ster ba/ /ma yin yin nges pa dag lkog la yur/ /'di 'dra dus kyi mkhas dbang dga' ston lags/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa slu byed kyi gab tshig ni/ gzhan grags sgra yis gab bya brjod nus kyang / /gab byed la 'khrul slu ba slu byed do/ /zhes gsungs te//dngos po gzhan la grags pa'i sgra stobs ldan mdzes par brjod nus pa lta bu dag gis gab bya brjod nus kyang / gab byed la 'khrul 'gro bas slu bar byed pa ni slu byed kyi gab tshirge go/ /zhes pa yin la/ dper na/ rnam mang rgyu yis legs bskrun yan lag can/ /tshad med legs pa'i zad med 'bras bu rgyas/ /mthong ba'i mod la mchog sred rgyas pa na/ /srid pa'i ljon pa phal la yi ga log /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa rim pa dang bral ba'i gab tshig ni/ ri phyi ma gnyis kyi mjug dag mas rim bzhin/ /yas rim so sor snga ma dag gi mgor/ /smyor ba lta bu'i rim 'khrul rim pa bral/ /zhes gsungs te/ rkang ba phyi ma gnyis mas rim nas rim bzhin/ rkang ba dang bo gnyis yas rim gyis brtsis pa'i snga ma rkang ba dang bo dang rkang ba gnyis pa la so so'i mgor sbyor ba de rim pa bral ba'i gab tshig yin/ zhes pa ste/ mdor na/ rkang ba tha ma'i mjug rkango 280

ba dang bo'i mgor 'ong zhing / rkang ba gsum pa'i mjug rkang ba gnyis pa'i mgor 'ong ba ste/ dper na/ ra~X tu bsten pas mi yi skyon mtshang kun/ /radi tu 'joms shing gtam gyi sbyor ba dag /rgyalda par byed la dge ba'i dpal dang stobs/ /'phel bar byed pa chang gi btung ba che/ /zhes pa 5 ci 1 lta bu/ —bzhi ba rab bcom gyi gab tshig ni/ bsgrib bya sgrib byed sgra don ci rigs pa/ /sbyar ba'i rtogs dka'i sgrib byed la ni kha/ /'phangs byas rab bcom gdam nga'i tshig ldan legs/ /zhes gsungs te/ bsgrib bya dang sgrib byed de gab bya gab byed gnyis sgra dang don ci rigs sbyar bas don rtogs dka' bar byas te/ sgrib byed la kha 'uphangs par byas pa de ni rab bcom gyi gab tshig yin la 'di la gdam nga'i tshig dang ldan na legs/ zhes pa'o/ /('di dang gong 'og tu dpar mar sgrub ces zhabs kyu byas pa yi ge ma dag pa'o/ /)dper na/ gtsang dwangs bsung ngad can gyi 'dab ldan gnas/ /ci dgar longs su spyod pa yongs btang nas/ /phyi sa'i dri ngad 'khor ba'i 'dam gyi khrod/ /ngal ba lhur len 'dab ldan de ni gang / /zhes pa lta bu/lnga ba mthun gzugs/ kyi ga/ba tshig ni/ gab bya gab byed la brtags don bkod pa'i/ /tshig gis don go ndebs pa mthun pa'i gzugs/ /bsdus brjod mtshungs dang spre/ mtshungs la sogs can/ /'dir ni don mthun bstan du yod tsam rigs/ /zhes gsungs te/ gab bya de nyid gab byed de yin par sgro 281

btags pa'i don de bkod pa'i tshig gis don go bar byed nus pa'i tshig bsdebs pa de mthun gzugs kyi gab tshig yin la/ bsdus brjod la khyad gzhi khyad chos mtshungs mi mtshungs sogs kyi dbye ba yod/ 'dir ni don mthun pa bstan rgyu yod pa tsam gyis rigs par bya/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/srid 'dir kha dog sna tshogs 'tshor ba yi/ /mching bu dag la mi dag mngon chags mod/ /tshad med 'od zer 'bad med 'dod dgu dag /'byung ba'i rin chen bcu phrag kho bos rnyed/ /ces pa lta bu/drug pa tsub mo'i gab tshig ni/ rtsab mo'i tshig ldan mtshan nyid yod pa tsam/ /phi tshig tsam gyis bsgrib byos rtsub mo 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ rtsub mo'i tshig dang ldan zhing mtshan nyid bshad rgyu yod tsam mam/ nges tshig ste sgra bshad yod tsam gyis don bsgrib par byas pa de ni rtsub mo'i gab tshig yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ chu skyes las byung drod kyis bskyangs pa'i mthus/ /ge sar dar legs srog ldan rol de yis/ /'ga' yi yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog na yang / /mi gtsang rdzas kyis gang ba'i rkyal ba nyid/ /ces pa lta bu/bdun pa grangs kyi gab tshig ni/ gang du grangs la gab pa'i brda byas nas/ /gab bya sbas par byas pa grangs kyi 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshig sbyor gang du rjod byed yi ge'i grangs de nyid la gab pa'i brda chad byas nas gab bya sbas par byas pa de ni grangs kyi gab tshig yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper 282

na/ 'jig rten mig gis thog drangaso rig byed mtha'/ 4 /zla ba'i lag pa yis kyang rmetha' ru skyor/ /de 'dra'i gdon gyis nad rigs bzhi brgya yi/ /dmag sna 'dren pa'i tshul la mi 'jigs sam/ /zhes pa lta bu/brgyad pa rab btags kyi gab tshig ni/ gang du gab bya'i don dang ngag de dag /gzhan du rnam par snang byas de rab btags/ /zhes gsungs te/tshig sbyor gang du gab bya'i don dang de rjod byed kyi ngag tshig de dag gzhan gab byed kyi rnam par snang bar byas pa de ni rab btags kyi gab tshig yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis mkha' la thogs med rgyu/ /dmar ser 'od kyis 'jig rten mun pa sel/ /dge mtshan lo tog smin pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /'od stong can des bdag nyid ma dor cig /ces pa lta bu/ gab bya 'jam dbyangs/ gab byed nyi ma/yang na/ 'jig rten mtsho ru skyes shing de ru g.yeng / /srog chags 'bu srin mang bos rgyun du gtse/ /dal med mgo lcog ldem pa'i mtsho skyes la/ /dmar ser 'od stong spro bas gzigs par 'tshal/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ gab bya bdag dang 'jam dbyangs/ gab byed padma dang nyi ma/dgu ba ming du 'dus pa ni/ gang du ming la sna tshogs don ldan ming / /du mas bsgribs pas btags de ming du 'dus/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang du gab bya gab byed dag gi thun mong du rgyur pa'i ming la sna tshogs pa'i don dang ldan pas ming du mas bsgribs pas sam sna tshogs pa'i don du mar sgro 283

btags te gab bya gab la de ni ming du 'dus pa'i gab tshig go/ /zhes pa ste/ dper na/ me tog mda' can dbang phyug che/ /gzhan yid 'gugs pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /srid pa'i smag chen rab 'joms pas/ /bdag la 'dod pa'i dngos po stsol/ /ces pa lta bu ste/ gab bya rig byed ma/ gab byed 'dod lha/ dbang phyug chen po/ mdzes ma/ nyi ma rnams so/ /yang na/ gang gis/ bsten pa'i me tog mda' can lha// /khams gsum dbang phyug che zhes 'bod pas na/ /gang la 'dren byed g.yo ba'i lha de ni/ /'dod lha ma yin mgrin sngon can yang min/ /zhes pa lta bu/bcu ba sgrib pa'i gab tshig ni/ tshig ni sgrib byed chos mtshungs la reg pas/ /der 'khrul don gzhan bsgrib bya bsgribs pas sgrib/ /ces gsungs te/rjod byed tshig ni sgrib byed kyi chos mtshungs pa la reg pas/ sgrib byed der 'khrul nas don gzhan bsgrib bya de bsgribs pas na sgrib pa'i gab tshig zer/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ smag rum stug por 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba la/ /rnam gsal 'od kyis legs pa'i lam ston zhing / /lo 'bras phun tshogs spel la grang sogs kyi/ /sdug bsngal sel de 'jig rten mgon yin no/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ gab bya 'jam dbyangs/ gab byed nyi ma/ 'jig rten mgon ni gnyis ka'i ming / yang na/ gting mtha' mi mngon srog chags gdug pas gang / /las rlabs g.yo bas 'jigs pa tshad las 'das/ /sems ldan dal med 'khor 284

ba'i gnas chen de/ /'od dkar ri bong can gyi ma ma yin/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ gab bya 'khor ba/ gab byed rgya mtsho'o/ /bcu gcig pa mthun pa'i sgra 'i gab tshig ni/ sgra sbyar rnam grangs bkod pas bsgrib bya'i don/ /rtogs dka' bsgrubs pa dag ni mthun pa'i sgra/ /zhes gsungs te/ sgra sbyar ba'i don gyi ming gi rnam grangs bkod pas bsgrib bya'i don rtogs dka' bar bsgrubs pa’dag ni mthun pa'i sgra'i gab tshig go/ /zhes pa ste/ dper na/ dkyil 'khor rdzogs shing ri dwags kyi/ /mtshan mas rab mdzes zhal ras can/ /snang ba'i dngos grub ster mdzad pa/ /mtsho byung 'od dkar can la dga'/ /zhes pa lta bu dang /yang na/ nus pa'i ming mthun myong bya'i ming 'dzin gyi/ /gnas las 'phos pa sbed min bcos yin pa'i/ /rin chen dbang gi rgyal bo las gzhan la/ /mi sim rnam par 'joms pa'i nus pa bral/ /zhes pa lta bu ste /snga ma'i gab bya dbyangs can ma/ gab byed zla ba/ dkyil 'khor sogs sgra sbyar ba yin la/ phyi ma ni/ nus pa'i ming mthun ni thub pa/ myong bya'i ming ni ro/ de 'dzin pa ni ljags/ de'i gnas ni zhal/ sbed min ni bstan/bcos yin ni bcos te/ thub pa'i zhal las 'a phos pa'i bstan bcos de rin chen dbang rgyal gyi gzugs su bkod/ mi sim pa ni sdug bsngal te ming gi rnam grangs kyi sgo nas rmongs par byas pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa rmongs pa'i gab tshig ni/ gang zhig brjod don dngos su snye 285

brjod byas kyang / /tshig de nyid kyis rmongs phyir rmongs pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs telha/ tshig sbyor gang zhig gis rang gi berjod don dngos su brjod par byas kyang / tshig de nyid brjod tshul gyis rmongs pār byas te 'khrul ba skyed pa ni rmongs pa'i gab tshig go/ /zhes pa ste/ dper na/ sger sems doranas spyi sems kho na yis/ /'dod pa'i rgyal srid dpal la dbang bsgyur te/ /rang gi grags pa nyams par dogs pa yis/ /lag pas lag pa dag kyang dgra ltar gzhom/ /zhes pa dang /ya nga na/ yang dag spyod pa mi 'dor rgyal bo che/ /rang skyong so sor lta ba dang 'phrad tshe/ /rang gshis mi 'dor ngo tsha khrel bor nas/ /ya nga'i khrims la sbyor ba'i spyod pa ston/ /zhes pa lta bu/bcu gsum pa yongs 'phrog gab tshig ni/ gang la tshig gi sbyor phreng bdag nyid can/ /ring byas snga ma snga ma la brten nas/ /phyi ma'i gab bya go dgos yongs 'phrog go/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang la tshig gi sbyor ba'i phreng ba'i bdag nyid can ni skor thag ring bor byas nas snga ma snga ma la brten nas/ phyi ma'i gab bya go dgos pa de la yongs 'phrog gi rgyan zer/ zhes pa ste/ (rigs byas zhes pa yig nor ro/ /)dper na/ rkyal ldan 'dab chags zas gnas skyes gdan la/ /'gro byed mi 'gro zung gis phan tshun 'khyud/ /kha 'joms dgra chen las byung nyin min mgon/ /mdun min brten pa'i lha des tshe thag bzung / /zhes pa lta bu ste/ tshig snga ma'i don 286

tshig phyi mas 'phrog pa ltar byas pas yongs 'phrog ces brjod do/ /bcu bzhi ba gcig bsgribs kyi gab tshig ni/ gang du rten ni sbas min brten pa ni/ /tshig gis sbas pa gcig bsgribs gab pa'i tshig /ces gsungs te/ tshig sbyor gang du rten ni sbas pa min par gsal bar byas te/brten pa ni tshig gis gsal bar ma byas par sbas pa de ni gcig bsgribs kyi gab tshig yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ gang zhig bsgrags pas lus med skem byed cing / /lus can sim pa'i ljon pa rlan par byed/ /de yi byin rlabs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /skal bzang skye bo dag gi gsos su smin/ /zhes pa lta bu/bco lnga ba gnyis ka bsgribs pa ni/ dmigs 'dzin spangs nas sbyi sgras rten brten pa/ /gnyis ka sbas te gnyis ka bsgribs pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/dmigs su mi 'dzin par spyi sgra tsam la brten nas rten dang brten pa gnyis ka sbas pa de ni gnyis ka bsgribs pa'i gab tshig yin/ zhes pa ste/dper na/ gang gis gang la 'khor lo bskor tsam gyis/ /la las bcu drug bden pa khong du chud/ /slar yang bden pa'i 'khor lo de dag ni/ /mi min brgya khri sogs la yongs su 'khor//zhes pa lta bu/ bcu drug pa yongs 'dres kyi gab tshig ni/ gang du sngar bshad gab tshig phyogs dang mda'i/ /mtshan nyid 'dres pa yorpā su 'dres par 'dod/ /ces gsungs te/ tshig sbyor gang du sngar bshad zin pa'i gab tshig phyogs mda' 287

ste bco lnga bo ci rigs kyi mtshan nyid 'dres pa de ni yongs 'dres kyi gab tshig yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ 'khor lo 'jig rten ri rna can gyi ltor/ /rgyu sas 'jam pa'i mda' can snying rtsa 'dar/ /theg pa yon tan rang 'od 'tsher ba na/ /sna nag ma yi ming yang khung bur yib/ /ces pa lta bu ste/grangs/ rab bcom/ rtsub mo sogs 'dres pa'o//lnga ba mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar gab pa'i tshig don stong 'khun dar/ /nyams brgya'i ri mo ngo mtshar mang bkra ba/ /gab byed rdule phran la gnas de rigs nas/ /kun la ya mtshan ston no rgyal ba bzhin/ /zhes gab tshig gi rab tu byed pa ste nyer bzhi ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong du bshad pa de lta bu'i gab pa'i tshig dang don shar phyogs stong 'khun rgyal bo'i mdzod las drangs pa'i dar gos de la snyan ngag nyams brgya'i ri mo ngo mtshar ba mang du bkra zhing / gab byed sa'i rdul phran gyi grangs dang ldan par gnas pa de dag ci rigs nas dpyod ldan kun la snyan ngag gi rig pa 'i sgo nas tshig byu don ya mtshan pa ston par byed pa ni bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i rgyal ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhin no/ /zhes pa yin la/ lhag ma go sla'o//skyon sel gyi skebs bshad pa/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa skyon sel la/ shis brjod/ dam bca'/ra bstan/ rgyas bshad/ mjug bsdu dang lnga las/ dang bo ni/ rdul phran 288

las 'das rnam med ye shes las grub lhan grub rgyun mi 'chad pa'i sku/ /nam yang 'gag med sna tshogs brjod pa kun la sgrog mdzad drug cu'i gsung dbyangs can/ /smra bsam las 'das so sor rang rig bde chen dbyings las rtag tu mnyam bzhag thugs/ /sku thugs ro gcig gsung dbang ma kye mkha' la nyi bzhin mdzod cig bdag gi blo/ /zhes gsungs te/ rdul phran gyi grangs las 'das pa'i gnyis snang gi rnam pa med pa'i kun mkhyen ye shes las grub pa'i 'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'i longs sprul gyi sku mnga' zhing / nam yang 'gag pa med par bden gnyis blang dor sna tshogs pa'i brjod par bya ba dag ris med kyi gdul bya kun la sgrog par mdzad pa'i yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs can/ smra bsam brjod pa las 'das pa'i chos kyi dbyings la mnyam par bzhag pa'i so sor rang rig gi lhan skyesu bde ba chen po'i dbyings las dus rtag tu mnyam bzhag las bzhengs pa med pa'i mnyam rjes ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i thugs dang ldan la/ sku thugs ro gcig tu gyur pa'i gsung gi dbang phyug lha mo dbyangs can ma kye zhes 'bod tshig gis thugs rgyud bskul nas/ nam mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin du bdag gi blo gros 'di nyid the/sa bya kun 'a gsal bar mdzod cig /ces pa'o/ / gnyis pa dam bca' ba ni/ gang yang sngar battad rnarma sa la skyon 'di bcu/ /spangs te yon tan rab rgyas bgyid 'dod la/ /skyon yon 'bod grogs dngos brnyan 'byed byed kyi/ /legs bshad ha nu man tha spyo bar bya/ /zhes 289

gsungs te/ tshig sbyor gang yin yang sngar bshad pa'i rgyan dag sbyor ba rnams la skyon 'di bcu bo spangs te rgyan gyi yon tan rab tu rgyas par bgyid par 'dod pa rnams la/ skyon yon ngos zin dka' ba 'bod grogs te srin po'i rgyal bo'i garmyegs su bkod nas de'i snang brnyan 'bum phrag shar ba'i nang nas de'i —gzugs dngos ni 'di'o zhes khyad par 'byed byed kyi legs bshad spre'u ha nu man tha spro bar bya/ zhes rtsom 'gyur skyon sel gyi legs bshad 'di spre'u ha nu man tha'i gzugs su bkod pa'o/ /gsum pa mdor bstan pa ni/ don nyams don 'gal don gcig the tshom can/ /rim pa nyams dang sgra nyams gcod mtshams nyams/ /sdeb smyor nyams dang mtshams smyor bral ba dang / /yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rten lung rigs 'gal/ /mkhas pas de bcu spangs te ngag rnams smyor/ /zhes gsungs te/ don nyams pa/ don 'gal ba/ don gcig pa/ the tshom can/ rim pa nyams pa/ sgra nyams pa/ gcod mtshams nyams pa/ sdeb sbyor nyams pa/ mtshams sbyor bral ba dang dgu'i steng du/ yul dang / dus dang / sgyu rtsal dang / sna tshogs pa'i 'jig rten dang / lung dang / rigs pa dang 'gal ba ste drug po 'di gcig tu byas pa'i skyon bcu yod la/ mkhas pa rnams kyis skyon de bcu spangs te snyan ngag gi tshig rnam par dag pa sbyor dgos/zhes pa'o/ / bzhi ba rgyas bshad la/ dang bo don nyams ni/ tshig tshogs brjod byas stong ba don nyams te/ /sems ldan smyos pa min pas smra ba min/ /sems nyams 290

byis pa'i ngag rnams 'dir skyon min/ /zhes gsungs te/ rjod byed kyi tshig gi tshogs pa la brjod bya'i don gyis stong ba de ni don nyams pa yin te/sems dang ldan pa'i nang gi smyos pa ma yin pas de lta bu mi smra mod/sems nyams pa ste sems rnal du mi gnas pa dang byis pa bsam med kyis brjod pa'i ngag rnams ni 'dir snyan ngag mkhan po su zhig gis skyon du 'dzin pa min no/ /zhes pa ste/ dper na/ mi 'dis ri rab zasnyi bar byed/ /nga ni de ring glo bur rgas/ /zla ba'i ma ma rgya che 'o/ /nyi ma 'di ni bsil la 'jam/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa don 'gal ni/ snga phyi'i ngag rnams phan tshun 'joms byed pa'i/ /'gal ba'i don ldan don 'gal skyon yin te/ /chags sogs skabs su phul byung tshig nyes med/ /ces gsungs te/ tshig sbyor gang gi snga phyi'i ngag tshig rnams kyis phan tshun gcig gi nus pa gcig gis 'joms par byed pa'i ṇḍig nang 'gal gyi don dang ldan pa de 'gal skyon yin la/ dmigs bsal chags pa sogs rgyas pa'i skabs su de lta bu'i 'gal ba phul du byung ba'i tshig lab rdol kha nas thal srid mod/ de ni snyan ngag gi tshig nyes su mi brtsi/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ dpon khyod gzhan don kho na sems/ /gzhan gyi nor dag rku zhing gsog /gzhung don kho na byed 'dod nas/ /gzhung gi rgyu rdzas yal bar 'dor/ /zhes pa lta bu/de'i dmigs bsal dper na/ bud med gzhon nu'i lus phung 'di/ /291

mi gtsang rdzas kyi rkyal ba rid/ /'di yi zhal gyi padma la/ /spyod pa'i sbrang mar gyur na 'dod/ /ces pa lta bu chags pa'i dbang gis lab rdol smras pa dag snyan ngag gi skyon du mi brtsi'o/ /gsum pa don gcig skyon ni/ dgos khyad med par sgra dang don ci rigs/ /sngar bshad slar yang brjod pa don gcig skyon/ /dga' sogs brjod 'dod yang brjod skyon min rgyan/ /zhes gsungs te/ dgos pa khyad par can med par rjod byed sgra dang don ci rigs pa sngar brjod zin pa slar yang brjod pa de don gcig skyon yin la/ rjes su brtse ba sogs kyi khyad par las/ dga' ba sogs kyi gtam brjod par 'dod nas yang yang brjod pa skyon min par rgyan yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ snyan ngag mkhan pos snyan tshig brtsams/ /snyan ngag mkhan pos dpe brjod brtsams/ /snyan ngag mkhan pos tshig sbyor brtsams/ /snyan ngag mkhan pos snyan gzhung brtsams/ /zhes tshig don gnyis ka la zlos skyon byung ba lta bu/de'i dmigs bsal/ dper na/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje yis/ /gzhung tshig nyi ma gsar bas mun chen bsale/ /tshig don sgeg mo'i bzhin ras gsal bar bstan/ /daṇḍi'i gzhung don nor bu lhang nger gsal/ /zhes pa lta bu/ dzobazhi ba the tshom can ni/ nges pa'i don du rab sbyar tshig nyid kyis/ /gal te the tshom 'dres na the tshom skyon/ /'dra ba'i the tshom slad du smras pa dag /rgyan yin skyon min de kun khas len nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ nges pa can yin 292

pa'i don du sbyar ba'i tshig sbyor de nyid kyis gal te the tshom 'dren pa'i tshig 'dres na the tshom gyi skyon yin la/ gang yin 'dra ba'i 'dam nga'i the tshom gyi slad du tshig smras pa dag ni skyon smren par rgyan yin par rnam pa kun tu khas len dgos/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ 'dod pa'i chags pa rgyas pa dang / /gnyen po dag kyang ma bsgoms pa'i/ /sred ldan mig la mdzes ma'i bzhin/ /mdzes sam mi mdzes 'phyang mo nyug /ces pa lta bu/de'i dmigs bsal/ dper na/ blo ldan skye bo'i ngang tshul yin pa 'am/ /yang na col chung g.yeng ba'i skyon yin rung / /lnga phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi gzhung lugs la/ /sbyang bar 'dod pa'i blo de 'dor mi nus/ /zhes pa lta bu/ lnga ba rim pa nyams pa ni/ don rnams mdor bstan rim bzhin rgyas bshad du/ /ma byung go rim 'khrug pa rimonyams skyon/ /dgos tshogs 'brel ba'i slad du 'bad pa yis/ /mdo rgyas rim pa bzlog kyang skyon ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ bshad bya'i don rnams snga mar mdor bstan gyis bstan pa'i go rim bzhin du rgyas bshad kyi skabs su ma byung na go rim 'khrug pa yin stabs rim pa nyams pa'i skyon du 'gyur la/ dmigs bsal/ dgos pa tshig tshogs snga phyi 'brel ba'i slad du tshig sbyor la 'bad par byas te mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad kyi rim pa bzlog kyang skyon min/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ skyes stobs shugs kyis stong ba'i mkhar rgyu ba'i/ /bsil ba'i zer dang 293

tsha zer spro ba can/ /rta ljang can dang zla ba'i rang 'od la/ /kun da padma dag gis 'dzum gyis bsu/ /zhes pa lta bu/ —de'i dmigs bsal/ dper na/ rnga gsang sgra dang rnga bo che yi sgra/ /snyan 'jebs ko ku la yi dbyangs gsum gyi/ /thog mtha' gnyis ni dpyid kyi dga' ston dpal/ /bar ba kho na kha ba'i dus su'ang grags/ /zhes pa lta ri bu/ drug pa sgra nyams pa ni/ don der rjod byed rnam dbye rkyen la sogs/ /thob tshod bzhin min sbyar ba sgra nyams skyon/ /brtags pa'i cho ga dag las dmigs bsal 'ga'/ /lung zin mkhas pas sbyar ba skyon min nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ brjod bya'i don de la rjod byed kyi rnam dbye dang rkyen la sogs pa thob tshod bzhin min par de dang mi mthun pa sbyar ba ni sgra nyams pa'i skyon yin la/ dmigs bsal brtags pa'i cho ga ste brda sprod pa'i gzhung gi sgra sgrub kyi cho ga dag las dmigs bsal 'ga' gsungs pa'i lung gis zin pa dag mkhas pa rnams kyis sbyar ba ni skyon min/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ sna tshogs 'od can de yi 'od zer de/ /mtsho las skyes pa'i 'dab brgya ba de skyongs/ /mtshan mor sad pas ku mu da de yis/ /mtshan mor rgyu bas zla ba gzhon nus skyongs/ /zhes pa lta bu/de'i dmigs bsal/ rta ljang can gyis zer brgya yis/ /mtsho skyes 'dab ldan dga' bar byed/ /ri bong can gyis bsil zer gyis/ /zla ba'i 294

gnyen dag dga' bar byed/ /ces pa lta bu ste/ rta ljang can dang ri bong can gyis zhes gsum pa byed pa sbyar ba skyon min pa bzhin no/ /bdun pa ngal gso nyams pa ni/ tshigs bcad rnams la ngal gso nges pa'i gnas/ /tshig gi gcod mtshams ngal gso rigs dgos par/ /de nyams gcod mtshams ming ma rdzogs pa ru/ /ngal gso ba ni gcod mtshams nyams pa'i skyon/ /rnam dbye'i stobs kyis mtha' phyis tshig yin bzhin/ /rnam dbye mtshams smyor rnam 'gyur mtha' lang tshig /yin phyir kāchu skya sogs ming dbus ltar/ /snang yang skyon min 'on kyang rna bar rtsab/ /ces gsungs te/ tshigs bcad rnams la ngal gso thob pa'i gnas ni/ tshig gi gcod mtshams su ngal gso thob par rigs pas/ de ltar dgos pa las/ de nyams nas tshig gcod mtshams kyi ming ma rdzogs par ngal gso ba ni gcod mtshams nyams pa'i skyon yin la/ dmigs b.ri5la legs sbyar gyi rnam dbye byin pa'i stobs kyis tshig mtha' phyis pa'i lhag ma tshig yin pa bzhin du/ rnam dbye mtshams sbyar ba dang rnam khadkur gyi mtha' yang tshig yin phyir/ rtsa ba'i dmigs bsal gyi dpe brjod du/ bya dang bya min ma tshang med la lung nyid kyis ni lta byed cing / /zhes pa'i bya dang bya min zhes pa'i skad dod kāryā kārsā tta zhes pa'i kārmā phyi ma'i ya la ngal gsos pa ni/ ming gi dbus su ngol gsos pa ltar snang yang skyon min te/ bya min gyi skad dod a kārsā ming dang / tma rnam dbye mtshams sbyar ba yin pas/ a kārpā ming gi cha yin no/ /de ltar na'ang rna bar rtsub pas snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyis mi sbyor/ zhes 295

pa'o/ /dper na/ mtsho las skyes padma dag gi/ /bcud 'thung ba'i sbrang ma rnams kyi/ /mchus bsnun pa'i padma rnams kyi/ /mgo'i 'dab ma rnams lhung bar byed/ /ces pa lta bu dang / dmigs bsal/ dper na/ gser ldan ma yis gnas pa'i rten byed la/ /chu skyes kyis kyang sbrang ma'i lus stobs gso/ /mtsho ldan mas kyang ngag gi dngos grub kyis/ /skal bzang mkhas par bsgrub pa 'di rmad byung / /zhes pa lta bu/ji brgyad pa sdeb sbyor nyams pa ni/ yi ge chad lhag lci yang smyor dgos rnams/ /ji bzhin min byas sdeb sbyor nyams pa smad/ /yi ge mang nyung gyur pa lhag chad skyon/ /ta dang dza sogs sdeb sbyor rang rang gi/ /yang lci go rim 'khrugs nas ta ru na/ /la ru ga sogs lci yang nyams pa'i skyon/ /zhes gsungs te/ sdeb sbyor nyams pa ni yi ge chad lhag byung ba dang / legs sbyar la lci yang sbyor dgos pa rnams ji bzhin byas pa min pa la sdeb sbyor nyams pa zhes bya la/ de ni shin tu smad pa'i gnas yin no/ /tshigs bcad kyi tshig rkang la yi ge mang nyung shor ba la lhag chad kyi skyon zer/phyo legs sbyar skad kyi sdeb sbyor gyi ta mtha' yang ba dang dza dbus lci ba sogs sdeb sbyor rang rang gi yang ba dang lci ba'i go rim 'khrugs nas/ ta mtha' yang ba'i tshab tu na kun yang ba bkod pa dang / la yang ba'i tshab tu ga lci ba bkod pa sogs ni yi ge lci yang nyams pa'i skyon yin/ zhes pa ste/ yi ge chad lhag shor bas ring thung gi skyon ni/ dper na/ slob sbyong mi byed 296

g.yeng bas khyer/ /chang dud bud med dag la/ /'dzem med rgyun du dga' zhing spyod par bye(da/ /de 'dras don gnyis 'grub pa sa steng dag na med/ /ces pa lta bu/ 3dgu ba mtshams sbyor nyams pa ni/ a sogs mtshams smyor mi 'dod rgyu med par/ /ya ba phyis sogs mtshams smyor nyams pa'i skyon/ /shad gong a dang phyi ma'i a i sogs/ /mtshams smyor bral kyang skyon med dmigs kyis bsal/ /zhes gsungs te/ a i sogs mtshams sbyor byed mi 'dod pa la rgyu mtshan med par mtshams mi sbyor ba dang / sgra ṭīka las/ spyir btang phyis pa la slar mtshams sbyor bya ba ma yin la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar phyis pa la spyir mtshams sbyor mi thob kyang / tshig mtha'i ya dang ba phyis pa sogs kyi tshig mtha' dgos pa med par mtshams sbyor ba yang sdeb sbyor nyams pa'i skyon yin la/ tshigs bcad phyed snga phyi'i bar shad kyi gong gi a dang / phyed phyi ma'i mgo'i a dang i sogs lta bu mtshams sbyor bral ba ste mtshams ma sbyar yang skyon med pa dmigs bsal yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ byams mgon 'jam dbyangs las brgyud gdams pa mchog /shān ta de ba a ti sha yi srol/ /ji bzhin gsal mdzad blo brazang grags pa zhes/ /snyan pa'i cigrags pa skabs gsum lha yis bsgrags/ /zhes de ba'i ba'i a dang a ti sha'i a gnyis mtshams ma sbyar ba skyon yin pa lta bu/de'i dmigs bsal ni/ dper na/ 'khor 'das rang bzhin med kyang rgyu 'bras kyi/ /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i sha sa na/ /a ti sha yis 297

spel ba'i gdams pa mchog /snying gi bdud rtsir sim pa'i skyes bu skyid/ /ces na'i a dang a ti'i a gnyis mtshams ma sbyar yang skyon min pa bzhin no/ / bcu ba yul 'gal ba sogs kyi skyon la/ mdor bstan pa/ so sor bshad pa/ gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu 'gal yang skyon med par bstan pa dang gsum/ dang bo ni/ ri sorges yul dang nyin mtshan dbyar sogs dus/ /'dod yon la brten glu sogs khyu rtsal te/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i snod bcud 'jig rten no/ /rigs pa gten tshigs rtog ge'i bdag nyid can/ /thos khacas gsung ba'i phyi nang rjod byed lung / /de dag drug las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ /min par snyan ngag mkhan po bag med kyis/ /zhugs na yul sogs 'gal ba'i 'dam du 'bying / /zhes gsungs te/ ri dang / nags dang / yul 'khor la sogs yul dang / nyin mtshan dang / dbyar sogs dus drug la sogs dus dang / 'dod yon lnga la brten pa'i glu sogs sgyu rtsal te/ 'byung bo sems can rgyu ba dang / mi rgyu ba bem po rnams te snod dang bcud dag ni— 'jig rten yin no/ /rigs pa gtan tshigs rigs pa rtog ge'i bdag nyid dang /thos pa rig byed dang bcas pa gsungs pa'i phyi nang gi rjod byed ni lung yin la/ de dag drug las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin min par snyan ngag mkhan po bag med kyis rtsom pa la zhugs na/ yul dus sogs dang 'gal ba'i 'dam du bying bar 'gyur/ zhes pa'o/ / gnyis pa la drug las/ dang bo yul dang 'galab ni/ ma la ya yi nga298

bur gangs can du/ /skyes pa'i rnam rgyal gser mdog yul 'gal dag /ces gsungs te/ dper na ma la ya yi ga bur zhes pa dang / bod gangs can du skyes pa'i a ru rnam rgyal gser mdog ces pa lta bu ni yul 'gal ba dag yin/ zhes pa'o/ / gnyis pa dus dang 'gal ba ni/ nyin par ku mud mtshan dus padmo bzhad/ /ston dus rma bya dga' rnams dus 'gal lo/ /zhes gsungs te/dper na/ nyin mo ku mud bzhad ces pa dang mtshan dus su padmo bzhad ces pa dang / ston dus su rma bya dga' zhes pa lta bu rnams dus 'gal ba yin/ zhes pa'o/ / cigasum pa sgyu rtsal dang 'gal ba ni/ dpa' dang sgeg pa spro dga'i khyad yin par/ /khro dang la mtshan byas pa sgyu rtsal 'gal/ /zhes gsungs te/ dpa' ba dang sgeg pa'i nyams kyi rgyur gyur pa'i sems kyi khyad par bstan pa ni spro dga'ashin pa ste/ spro bas dpa' ba'i nyams dang / dga' bas sgeg pa'i nyams 'byung ba dang / khro bu'i yid byed las drag shul gyi nyams dang / ya mtshan pa'i yid byed las rmad byung gi nyams 'byung dgos pa la/spro dga'i yid byed las khro ba'i nyams dang ya mtshan gyi nyams byung bar byas pa ni sgyu rtsal dang 'gal ba yin/ zhes pa ste/ dper na/ lcug phran gzhon nus me tog 'dzum ngom pa'i/ /yid 'ongs skyed mos tshal du slebs pa na/ /rab tu dga' zhing mig 'obur rab bgrad de/ /ku co drag pos 299

'jigs rung zil shugs ston/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi ba 'jig rten dang 'gal ba ni/ glang bo'i ral ba chu shing snying bo sogs/ /'di 'dra snod bcad 'jig rten 'gal ldan can/ /zhes gsungs te/dper na glang bo che'i ral ba zhes pa dang / chu shing gi snying bo zhes pa lta bu sogs 'di 'dra ni snod dang bcud kyi 'jig rten dang 'gal ba yin/zhes pa'o// lnga ba rigs pa dang 'gal ba ni/ 'dus byas rtag sogs nang ba'i rigs pa dang / /'jig rten tshangs pas byas min phyi rigs dang / /'gal ba de 'dra der ltos rigs pa 'gal/ /zhes gsungs te/ dper na 'dus byas rtag pa yin zhes pa sogs nang ba'i rigs pa dang 'gal ba dang / 'jig rten 'di tshangs pas byas pa min zhes pa phyi rol pa'i rigs pa dang 'gal ba de 'dra/ phyi nang so so la ltos pa'i rigs pa dang 'gal ba yod/ ces pa'o drug pa lung dang 'gal ba ni/ phyi nang rang rang gzhung las bshadapasna dang / /'gal ba'i ngag rnams lung dang 'gal ba ste/ /me bzhag min par bram ze'i mchod sbyin dang / /bslab nyan med par spob mar dbang lung bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ phyi rol pa dang nang ba sangs rgyas pas rang rang gi gzhung las bshad pa dang 'gal bar byas pa'i snyan ngag rnams ni lung dang 'gal ba yin te/ dper na/ phyi rol pa'i lung dang 'gal ba ni/ me bzhag pa min par bram zes mchod sbyin byed pa'o/ /zhes pa lta bu dang / 30)

nang ba'i lung dang 'gal ba ni/ dper na/ gtsug lag rig pa ma bslab par gzhan la 'chad par byed ces pa dang / bla ma las dbang lung ma nyan par gzhan la dbang lung ster ro/ /zer ba lta bu yin/ zhes pa'o//gsum pa gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu 'gal yang skyon med par bstan pa la drug las/ dang sdo ni/ skabs 'gar skyon med dag kyang 'dod 'di ltar/— /gang gi mthu las mi yul lha'i longs spyod/ /'byung bar brjod kyang skyon med yul gyi 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ spyir 'gal yang gnas skabs 'gar skyon med pa dag kyang yod par 'dod pa ni 'di ltar/ dper na/bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa gang gi mthu las/ mi yul 'dir lha'i longs spyod 'byung ngo / /zhes brjod kyang skyon med pa ni yul dang 'gal yang skyon med pa yin/ zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa/ de bzhin bzang ngan ltas kyis dus gcig tu/ /'grogs min 'grogs par bstan kyang dus mi 'gal/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong gi de bzhin du bzang ngan ltas kyi dbang gis dus gcig tu 'grogs mi srid pa'i dngos po 'grogs par bstan kyang dus dang 'gal ba'i skyon med/ ces pa'o/ /('dir dpar mar bzang ngan ltos zhes pa ma dag go/ /)dper na/rgyal bo 'chi ba'i snga ltas kyis/ /ka dam pa yi me tog dang / /'dab ma bdun pa'i me tog gnyis/ /dus gcig shar ba'i mtshan ma byung / /zhes pa lta bu/ 301

gsum pa/ gar byed me tog lhang yang chags ldan la/ /yid 'ongs brjod kyang sgru rtsal las mi 'gal/— /zhes gsungs te/ dper na gar byed pa'i bu mo'i rgyan gyi me tog rnying zhing rnyid par gyur kyang / gar gyi tshe ldem ldem du g.yo ba chags ldan myi skye bo'i mig lam dudhe yid du 'ongs par 'char zhes brjod kyang sgyu rtsal dang 'gal ba'i skyon med/ ces pa'o/ / bzhi ba/ lasakyis bsil byed 'dis kyang 'ga' zhig la/ /grang min byed kyang 'jig rten dang mi 'gal/ /zhes gsungs te/ dper na las kyi dbang gis bsil byed de zla ba 'dis kyang yi dwags lta bu'i skye bo 'ga' zhig la grang min te tsha ba'i gdung ba ster bar byed/ ces brjod kyang 'jig rten dang 'gal ba'i skyon med/ ces pa'o/ /('dir yang nyin byed ces pa ma dag go/ /) lnga ba/ 'gag med longs smyod rdzogs pa'i sku sogs kyi/ /khyad par brjod kyadzeerigs par 'gal ba ci/ /zhes gsungs te/ dus gtan du 'gag pa med pa'i lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sogs kyi khyad par gyi chos brjod kyang rigs pa dang 'gal ba'i skyon yod pa ci ste med do/ /zhes pa ste/ dper na/ lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gzugs kyi sku/ /'khor ba sa stong bar du rtag bzhugs nas/ /dag pa'i 'khor tshogasi theg chen rigs can la/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i chos dag rtag tu ston/ /zhes pa lta bu ni/ 'dus byas thams cad skad cig la 'jig pa'i rigs pa dag dang 302

'gal ba'i skyon med do/ / drug pa/ nyon mongs mang ldan so skyes tshe gcig la/ /sgrib gnyis bdud bzhi bcom nas 'tshang rgya sogs/ /lung 'gal 'gal yang skyon med yon tan rgyas/ /zhes gsungs te/ dper na nyon mongs mang bo'i 'ching ba kun ldan gyi so so skyes po dag gsang sngags zab mo'i thabs lam la brten nas tshe gcig la sgrib gnyis spangs bdud bzhi bcom nas 'tshang rgya zhes brjod pa sogs ni/ 'tshang rgya ba la bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogarme bsags dgos par gsungs pa'i lung sogs dang 'gal ba ltar snang yang lung 'gal gyi skyon med par ma zad gsang sngags kyi khyad chos ston pa'i yon tan rgyas pa yin/ zhes pa'o//lnga ba skyon sel gyi mjug bsdu ba ni/ rgyas so tshig gi rab byed 'dab brgya'i 'dab/ /don gyi dzrang rtsi mngar ba de dag kyang / /de bzhin snyan ngag rgyan ldan ches dga'i glu/ /mchog bstan nyin byed 'od dang lhan cig rgyas/ /zhes skyon bcu spangs nas yon tan rab rgyas spel ba'i rab tu byed pa ste nyi shu rtsa lnga ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyas so zhes thog ma'i gsal byed bkod nas gang rgyas she na tshig gi rab byed kyi 'dab brgya ste padma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa yin la/ tshig gi 'dab ma rgyas pa tsam du ma zad/ don cigyi sbrang rtsi rab tu mngar ba de dag kyang rab tu rgyas so/ /de bzhin du 'di brtsams pa la brten nas/ snyan ngag gi rgyan dang ldan pa'i ches cher dga' ba'i glu yang mchog tu bstan pa'i din byed kyi 'od dang lhan cig tu rgyas so/ /zhes pa 303

yin la/ lhag ma go sla'o/ / dze ribastan bcos 'di brtsams pa'i mjug gi bya ba/bstan bcos 'di brtsams pa'i mjug gi bya ba ni/ 'dir smras pa/tshogs gnyis chu gter las 'ongs dbyangs can bdud rtsi'i gter/ /thub bstan ral ba'i byu gu de ni sngon bsags kyi/ /legs byas rgyu skar phreng ba la chags 'dir 'ongs nas/ /skal bzang yid mkha' mdzes byed mtsho la padmas bzhin/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshogs gnyis chu gter gyi gzugs su bkod pa dang dbyangs can ma bdud rtsi'i gter du gyur cing / thub bstan ral ba'i gzugs su bkod pa de'i myu gu ste zla ba'i gzugs su bkod/ skal ldan gyi sngon bsags legs byas rgyu skar gyi phreng riba'i gzugs su bkod de dbyangs can ma zla ba de ni de la chags nas 'dir 'ongs pa zhes rab btags kyi rgyan dang / skal bzang gi gdul bya'i yid nam mkha'i gzugs su bkod de/ dbyangs can ma zla bas de mdzes par byas pa ni mtsho la padmas brgyan pa bzhin no zhes dpe'i gzugs can gyi rgyan no/ /'dis dbyangs can ma snying la zhugs pa'i yon tan bstan to// mchog gi gsung rab 'od kyi thigs pa dag /mang 'dus rin chen phreng ldan phra zhib srun/ /srid las brgal kyang rdzogs pa min pa yis/ /mes po'i yid brtan 'gog pa 'di las gang / /zhes gsungs te/ mchog tu gyur pa'i gsung rab 'od dang 'od de nyid thigs pa'i gzugs su bkod de 304

gzugayocan 'phar ma dang / de lta'i gsung rab mang du 'dus pa ste mang du mthong ba'i rin po che'i phreng ba lta bu'i phra zhib gzigs pa'i spyan zhes 'bru mang bo'i tshig sdud can gyi dpe rgyan dang / spyan de nyid kyi dkyus sam gzigs pa 'jig rten srid pa las brgal kyang da dung rdzogs pa min pa zhes mdzes rgyan gyis spras te/ des mes po tshangs pa'i yid kyi brtan pa 'gog pa ste yid 'phrog par byed pa rab byed 'di las gzhan gang du yod/ces bstan bcos rab byed nyer lnga ba 'di'i che ba brjod pa'o//'phrog byed 'jug pa bcu yis ma thob la/ /mes po'i nor lha'i snyan gyis ma gsan cing / /dbang bos spyan stong bgrad kyang ma mthong ba'i/ /dbyangs can rgyud mang brdungs 'di skal bas thobra/ /ces gsungs te/ 'phrog byed 'jug pa bcu ste khyab 'jug gis ma thob la/ mes po tshangs pa'i nor lha'i snyan de yis kyang ma gas na cing / lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyis spyan stong bgrad nas bltas kyang ma mthong ba'i lha mo dbyangs can ma'i rgyud mang ste pi wang brdungs pa 'di ni bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes bsod nams kyi skal bas thob po zhes 'gal ba'i gzugs can gyis spras te bstan bcos 'di brtsams pa'i che ba brjod pa'o//khyad 'phags don gyi bzhin ldan me long ma/ /ka ye byis pas 'khrul spyad gos hrul skyur/ /gsar bshad snyan 'arjebs du ku la yi gos/ /rgyan la rmad byung —'dzum pa'i dpal ngoms shig /ces gsungs te/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i brjod bya don bzhin gyi gzugs su bkod nas/ de ldan gyi gzhung me long 305
