gzung dri ba rgyu'i don gyi de ni dang / sangs rgyas ni skyabs kyi mchog lta cibu'i ni la/ tu/ hi/ ta bsra rnams las hi byin/ padma dkar bo'i skad dod puṇḍa rī ka la/ si byin/ i phyis/ sra rnam bcad/ sa ma mtshungs pa la/gsum pa'i mang tshig gi bhisra byin/ sra dra dag gi rnam bcad dos sra rnam bcad/ ā las a ba la dbyi 'os gong gi rnam bcad phyis/ drangs pas/ sa ma bhiḥ grub/ bhi'i gug gu lci ba'i rtags kyis ma'i mgor ded pa e yin snyam/ bod tshig gam bod pa la/ i he la/ si byin/—i phyis/ sra rnam bcad/rgyal ba'i skad dod dza ya la/ rnam dbye drug pa'i mang tshig gi āmra byin/āpo la nuṭu dang / nām la'os sngon ma ring bo/ nāmra gyi ring cha chad/ ngo mtshar ba'am rmad du byung ba'i skad dod/ a ho/ si byin/ mi zad pa las 'jig drangs pas/ ldushā zha / 4 1 / 3 snye / dzo' 'asasdo /she2 rū ba.u ba tāha pucherāka samalhaḥ.ahaḥ jaribhā.a / /zla dral khyod sna padi dkar 'dra zhes rgyal rnams mtsha nang rmegi /brjod pa'i skad dod u.āoṃ na la si byin/ i phyis/ sra rnam bcad/ grags pa'am snyan pa'i skad dodarngoya sha la/ si ster/ i phyis/ sra rnam bcad/mkha'i skad dod ā ka sha bzhin ltar lta bu sogs la i/ ba/ bā/ e bapo/batra/ e ba rnams las/ e ba byin/ si byin/ mi zad pa las si 'jig ā las a ba la dbyi 'os rnam bcad phyis/ sha'i a phral/ e dang e la e'os/457

e ke sha can du gyur/ phyogs kyi skad dod dishra la/ dzasra byin/ dishra rnams kyi ka'os shra krar bsgyur/ dza'i a phral/ dzra khyad don gyis phyis/ sra rnam bcad/ āllī/ khyab pa la'o zhes pa'i byings bzhag rnam pare bcad bya'i sra'os/ rnam bcad srar bsgyur/ ku i la la ṣa ru byed de sa'os sra ṣṭhar bsgyur/ kā ra mdzad pa/ zas gtsang sras kyi skad dod shokau da ni la/ si byin/ i phyis/ sra rnam bcad/ drangs pas/klurnyisnaḥ yam̐ sha/ nīkani khrildaka/ 'illīṅgāranirjod/ niḥ bsngags barmeodagrags snyan mkha' bzhin phyogasakun khyarpāmarjade nyema'iponyen//shākya'i skad dod shākya la si byin/ i phyis/ sra rnam bcad/ seng ge'i skad dod sidha la si byin/ i phyis/ sra rnam bcad/ shra ṣā sa la yang na'os rnam bcad gong ma srar bsgyur/ zhabs kyi skad dod pa da la si byin/ si apo'os si apo du bsgyur/ a phyis/ bra nga ro/ sen mo'i skad dod na kha la si byin/ i phyis/ sra rnam bcad/ ya ba la ya ma yang na'os rjes su nga ro na yig tu gyur/ dbus kyi skad dod ā sum̐/ ā dang nga ro phyis/ dgag pa'i nañdza sngon ma'i sa ma mnyam pa la si byin/ i phyis/ sra rnams bcad/ nyu rjes 'brel gyis phyis/ snying gi skad dod skṛdra dang / padma'i skad dod padma la si byin/ i phyis/ sra rnam bcad/ mtsho'i skad dod sā ra la si byin/ si amru'os si amra du bsgyur/ a phyis/ mra nga ro/ a las a ba la dbyi'os/458

rnam bcad phyis/ gnas med pa la yang na'os dra tpar bsgyur/dzo bzhugs pa'i skad dod bi ha ra/ i a dag gis dbyi'os/ ra'i a phyis/ drangs pas/shīkyaisne rghaṃ~Xlda nni6ཿsu/ na/ma 0phroṃṭwāṃdma/sīldisdehaṃsde/ /mnyam med shākya silha'i zhabs spen snyipa khus pad 〈'bazhukhi//zhes grub/ sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛtta las/ yi ge bcu dgu ba shin tu brtan 'dzin la prastu ra lnga 'bum nyi khri bzhi stong nyis brgya gya brgyad yod pa las/ 'dir naṣṭa ste 'dren byed ces pa/ lci yang rnams ston pa la/ rtsa ba las/ gal te ma sa dza su ta ta ba rnams nyi ma rta yis stag rnam rtsen pa yi/ zhes rkang ba re la ma dang sa dang dza su ta ta dang ba rnams yod pa de la nyi ma ste bcu gnyis dang / rta ste bdun la sdod pa'am ngal gso ba dang /ujiṣṭa ste steng nas ston par byed pa yang ba'i bya ba zhes yang ba brgyad kyi grangs rnams kyi steng gcig bsnan pas/ chig 'bum bzhi khri dgu stong sum brgya so bdun pa yin zhing / yi ge bcu dgu'i steng lci ba bcu gcig bsnan pa'i phyi mo sum cu dang ldan pa stag rnam rtsen zhes bya ba'i prastu ras mdzes paḍi brgyan pa'o// // 459

༄ོshi / /byeng mtham ri 'i zla gza' 'a dzim ri mo ri nya ni ra mi / dngarsha 7sna / / nag 'gros su bkod pa rigs ldan mchod — pa'i me tog ches bya ba ba zhugs so//༄༅/ /'a5ma dbyāngs gsang ṅgesum sgyu ma'i rol gar gyis/ /mngon mtho nges legs dpal gyi 'dod dgu'i char/ /sbyin mdzad dang bo'i sangs rgyas rang lugs pa/ /bsad sgrub chos kyi rgyal bor gus pas 'dud/ /ya5 dag rtsis la 'jug pa'i gsar bu dag /tshegs med bde blag 'jug pa'i thabs 'phrul zhig /skal mnyam dag la skyes su 'bul ba la/ /yang dag mkhas rnams khrel ba mi 'tshal zhu/ /de yang rab byung bcu bdun pa'i/ /me yos la sogs 'das pa'i lo/ nyi klas bsgyur la nag zla sogs/ /'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag /'og ma2 mig bsgyur 'byung snas brgyan/ /mashi' ros bgos thob steng mar byin/ /tshes zla rnam par dag pa 'o/ /steng gatshugs 'og mar mirgi byin pas/ /phyi ma phyi ma'i zla dag 'char/ /zla dag gnas drug steng nas rim/ /brla ru sdu nni mkha' dbaṃnge sbrig /'byung 460

45 /ji5me sgyural 'o/dadakar duche/ma richim 'atrerathe: zugarngasnokhur zug thab /ba — / / da da da da ra / / lta 33 6 nga ṭaṃshā 4 707 4 mu6dzobyu 6 60 4la dus kyas brgyan byas la/ 3 /ra mkha' ra dang ra ra dus/ /mkha' ra 7 /7thig6 tna sdos dor lhag shīX /gza' yi sgru wa rnam par dag /zla dag gnas ༵ṇḍaṃ7 gnyis steng ma mi2ga /'og ma gadzugs kyis bsgyur ba la/ /steng rim bug gzugaspru 'byunge5 chus brgyan/ rdzushā/mas nastso dus kṣiṃrmi klu lani gis/ /)re6bsgril ba ril cha'i byu wa— ka /zla dag gnas lnga steng rim bzhin/ /minai phyosgarsha klu dekhring rghaṃzugs dang ni/ /gakau' zlas bsgyur la chi25 sa 29 19 4ga 'i14spre /ḍid nyad dang / /sran lag bug gzugs mcha yad kyas/ rdzu9 /brgyan la ske6nu 6 60ri 'i 60 27 4 spre 14ra ra dus mkha' ra/ / ga mtshams skar dral nya rtsu 'grub/ /snga rtur rang rang sgyur byed byin/ /phyi ma'i rtu wa tshegs med 'char/ sau / /nyin re'i rtsis la 'jurge pa'i phyir/ /gang brtsi'i / du'i gza' nyi'i rtur/ /tshes grangs gang yin de nyid kyi/ /gza' nyi'i rtakka kyāngs ma nor byin/ /gza' nyi bar ba 461
